title: Excellent Short-Form Video Editor Wanted (TikTok, Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts)
description:
We are looking for a full-time Short-Form Video Editor to join our growing team. This role is for someone experienced in short-form content who understands what captures attention in the first few seconds and has a strong instinct for creating videos that perform well on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



Requirements

- Proven experience editing short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- Strong understanding of viral content, audience retention, and social media trends

- Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro

- Must have your own Adobe Premiere Pro license/software

- Ability to create engaging edits with strong hooks, pacing, captions, sound effects, and transitions

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- Creative, innovative, and highly detail-oriented

- Open to feedback and able to implement revisions quickly

- Self-motivated and able to work independently

- Experience editing 4K video is a plus

- Using a MacBook or being able to edit Mac files is preferred

- Knowledge of graphic design (Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator) is a plus



Responsibilities

- Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- Repurpose long-form content into engaging short-form clips

- Identify compelling 
nts, hooks, and storylines from raw footage

- Create attention-grabbing captions, graphics, and visual elements

- Stay current on social media trends and recommend content ideas

- Organize project files and maintain an efficient editing workflow

- Collaborate with the team to continuously improve content performance



Pay: TBD, this will depend on your level of skill and the other people who apply to the job.



Perks:

*You can work as much as you want. I will pay you a salary, but if you work extra hours, you will get paid.

*Flexible Vacation, if you need time off, just let me know.

*Opportunity to advance/get bonuses, if you do a good job, I will give you a raise and bonuses.



TO APPLY FOR THE JOB:

1. Change the subject line to “I Want to Work for You [Insert the name of my mom who is the co-owner of Bdancewear]

2. At the top of your message, write 2-3 sentences on why you would like this position, and why you are a good fit. Do not write more than that, or else your application will be deleted.

3. Write out the name of one of the passion products I featured on my channel (check out my vlogs on my YouTube channel: Travis Marziani)

4. How many years have you been doing short-form video editing?

5. Link to a sample video that you've edited in the past.



Make sure to follow all the steps above. This is a great job opportunity with the ability to get bonuses and raises, so I will only look at applicants who really want the job. If I interview you, there will be a short call between us, and a video will be required



Do not write more than what I have asked you above. If you write more than what is requested above, I will ignore your job post.





Thank you,

Travis Marziani

I own two companies B Dancewear and Effective Ecommerce and a partner to multiple e-commerce businesses. I have been working with Virtual Assistants for over 6 years and all of my VAs have been very happy to work with me. You will be given a chance to talk with my current VA before you are hired.

To Apply for the job:

1. Change the subject line to "I Want to Work for You [Insert the name of my mom who is the co-owner of Bdancewear]"

2. At the top of your message write 2-3 sentences on why you would like this position, and why you are a good fit. Do not write more than that or else your application will be deleted.

3. How many years of experience do you have as a writer?

4. Send in your writing portfolio

This is a great job opportunity with the ability to get bonuses and raises, so I will only look at applicants who really want the job.



Thank you,

Travis Marziani

title: Sales Development Representative - AI Start-Up, Melbourne, Australia
description:
Fun and Exciting opportunity

 

About FlashFillz

We're an Australian AI company solving a problem every medical booking service practice has: when a patient cancels at the last minute, that appointment slot — and the revenue with it — usually disappears.

Our system fixes that automatically. The moment a cancellation comes in, FlashFillz texts the practice's waitlist and the first person to respond claims the slot. No phone calls. No admin. No empty chair.

The platform is built, security-audited, and running in production. We're now taking it to market across Melbourne's dental and medical sector — and we're hiring our first two SDRs to help us do it.



Why this role is different

You won't be employee number 200 reading from a call centre script. You'll be one of the first two people in our sales function, working directly with the founders. The scripts you refine, the objections you learn, the process you help build — that becomes the playbook for everyone who joins after you.



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for two people who want to build something and grow with it.



What you'll do

Call Australian dental and medical practices from a qualified, pre-researched list — we do the list building, you do the conversations. Your job is to book qualified appointments for our Melbourne-based closers. That's it. You're not closing deals or handling contracts.



You'll log every call outcome, and that data directly shapes how we sell. When you find something that works, we roll it out to the whole team.



The path forward



This is a genuine growth role, and we'll be specific rather than vague about it. Consistently hit 20 booked appointments per week for two months and you move into a Team Lead position — training our next hires, with a share of what your team books. We're building a sales organisation, and the first two people here are the ones who'll run it.



The three skills that matter most



1. Clear, confident spoken English. You'll be speaking with Australian practice managers and receptionists every day. You need to be easy to understand, warm on the phone, and comfortable when someone is busy or abrupt.



2. Cold calling resilience. Most calls end in a no. The people who succeed in this role treat that as information, not rejection, and pick up the phone again immediately.



3. Genuine organisation. Every call logged, every follow-up scheduled, every outcome recorded accurately. Our entire sales system runs on the data you capture.



Details

Full-time, working Australian business hours (approximately 6:00am–3:00pm Manila time). Base rate plus a bonus for every appointment booked that shows up. Full training on the product and the market — you don't need healthcare experience, you need to be able to hold a good conversation. 



We have the list, you make the calls, and follow up with us, record this fun journey as we build something amazing.

We're reading every application personally, this is a really fun and exciting oppotunity

* Approximately 3 short-form videos / Reels per week

* Approximately 2 long-form videos per month

* Additional editing projects may come up depending on the campaign



What You’ll Be Editing



Content may include:



* Fishing and outdoor adventure footage

* Lodge and destination content

* Guest experiences

* Scenic and lifestyle footage

* Promotional social media content

* Instagram Reels and other short-form videos

* Longer-form storytelling or promotional videos



What We’re Looking For



You should have strong experience with:



* Instagram Reels and short-form video editing

* Creating strong hooks within the first few seconds

* Pacing and storytelling

* Music selection and syncing

* Captions / on-screen text

* Clean transitions and effects

* Color correction and basic color grading

* Audio cleanup and sound design

* Editing raw footage into polished, engaging content

* Understanding current social media editing styles without making videos feel overly trendy or gimmicky



Experience editing travel, outdoor, hospitality, resort, fishing, tourism, adventure, or lifestyle content is a big plus.



Editing Software



You may use:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Final Cut Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* CapCut Desktop

* Or another professional editing platform



We care more about the quality of your work than the software you use.



Compensation



Budget is approximately $500 USD/month, depending on experience and overall fit.



We are also open to discussing an hourly arrangement for the right person.



Trial Edit



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a trial edit before final selection.



The trial will help us evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Storytelling

* Pacing

* Creativity

* Ability to follow direction

* Overall fit with the brand style



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your video editing experience

2. Your portfolio or reel

3. 3 examples of your best short-form/Reels edits

4. At least 1 long-form video example, if available

5. Your preferred editing software

6. Your current availability

7. Your expected monthly or hourly rate

8. Tell us briefly about any experience you’ve had editing travel, outdoor, hospitality, tourism, or lifestyle content



Important: Please do not send a generic application. We will prioritize candidates who send relevant examples of their actual editing work.



Application Question



Please include the word ALASKA at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full job post.



We are looking for someone who is reliable, responsive, detail-oriented, and genuinely excellent at video editing. There is potential for ongoing work for the right person.

title: Sales & CS Team Lead
description:
About Us

We're Premium Invention — an e-commerce company selling premium solar-powered security cameras to ranchers, farmers, and property owners across North America. Seven years in business, growing rapidly, and expanding our product line. Customer experience is our top priority, and our support team is becoming a revenue channel. We're hiring the person who leads that shift.



About This Role

You'll run the day-to-day of our CS team and turn it into a team that sells. This is a player-coach position: you coach agents daily, handle escalations, keep quality high, and take frontline shifts when volume demands it. You'll own the numbers that matter — conversion on pre-sale conversations, upsells, saved refunds, and reviews earned.

Our Head of CX is building the systems side — automation, retention, customer journey design. You take the floor so she can focus there. She'll be your manager and closest partner.



What You'll Own

- Daily coaching and development of every agent — with a sales lens on every customer interaction

- Pre-sale conversations on chat and
: buyers asking "will this work on my property?" and turning those into conversions

- Upsells and cross-sells inside support: accessories, bundles, plan upgrades

- Save attempts on refund and cancellation requests before revenue is lost

- End-to-end escalation handling

- QA scorecards, KPI tracking, and performance conversations with agents

- Systematically turning strong support moments into public reviews

- Sales flows and scripts for our chatbot

- A weekly voice-of-customer report to marketing and product: top objections, confusions, and feature requests straight from tickets



What This Role Requires

- 5+ years of sales experience with results you can show us — real numbers, not just "I supported the team"

- 2+ years leading or coaching a team with clear examples of how you improved performance

- Excellent spoken and written English — our customers are 50+ American property owners who value straight talk

- Comfortable learning technical products quickly. Our cameras involve SIM cards, solar charging, signal strength, and app setup. You don't need an engineering background — you need to enjoy figuring things out and explaining them simply to frustrated customers

- Experience in e-commerce or physical products is a strong plus

- Available during US business hours, with flexibility for early/late hours when team coordination requires it

- Availability: 8 hours on weekdays + half day on weekends (44 hours/week total)

- Comfortable with time tracking (Hubstaff)



Who Should NOT Apply

- Pure inbound CS agents with no sales or management experience 

- People who've only managed chatbots or automation — this role is hands-on with humans

- Managers who coach from dashboards but can't jump into a live conversation and handle it better than their team 



What We Offer

- $1,800–2,300/month depending on experience

- Performance bonuses tied directly to the revenue your team generates

- A company that promotes on proof — both personal & career growth path

- Full-time, long-term role



How to Apply

- Do not message on onlinejobs.ph 

- Complete the form: (10-15minutes)





Take your time to show us how you think and share your experience, we value your time and will carefully review each application. Strong candidates are invited to interview within 48 hours.

title: Solar Permitting Coordinator
description:
Position Summary

NRG Clean Power is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Solar Permitting Coordinator to join our growing team. In this role, you will act as the crucial link between our design team, project managers, local municipalities (AHJs), and utility companies. You will be responsible for preparing, submitting, and tracking all necessary permit applications to ensure our solar projects are approved accurately and efficiently. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with excellent communication skills and a strong ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities

Permit Preparation: Assemble and review permit application packages, including structural and electrical engineering designs, site plans, and required jurisdictional forms.



Submission & Tracking: Submit permit applications to local Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and Homeowners Associations (HOAs) via online portals, mail, or in-person delivery (expediting).



Interconnection Applications: Prepare and submit utility interconnection applications and track them through to the Final Permission to Operate (PTO) stage.



Relationship Management: Build and maintain positive working relationships with city planners, building departments, and utility representatives to facilitate smooth approvals.



Issue Resolution: Promptly address and resolve any permit rejections, plan check corrections, or requests for additional information by coordinating directly with internal design and engineering teams.



Data Management: Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all permitting activities, milestones, and expenses within the company CRM Salesforce.



Reporting: Provide regular updates to project managers and sales teams regarding pipeline status and expected approval timelines.



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Minimum [1-2] years of experience in permitting, project coordination, or administrative roles within the solar, construction, or roofing industries.



Language Skills: Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively advocate for the company with local government officials and utility representatives.



Application & Tech Proficiency: Highly adept at learning and navigating various software applications, including online municipal permitting portals, utility interconnection platforms, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.



Knowledge: Familiarity with local building codes, zoning laws, and AHJ requirements is highly preferred. Basic understanding of solar PV systems is a strong plus.



Attention to Detail: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to manage complex paperwork and catch errors before submission.

title: Appointment Setter — US Marketing Agency (HVAC Cold Calling, Long-Term)
description:
NeuroBoost Media is a Meta ads agency serving home-service businesses (HVAC, roofing, painting) across the United States. We're a small, growing team hiring dedicated appointment setters to become a core part of what we're building. This is not a temporary gig — we want people who will grow with us long-term.



SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Pacific Time (roughly 12 AM to 8 AM Philippines time). Graveyard shift — you must be able to commit to this schedule long-term.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- 100 to 150 outbound calls per day to HVAC business owners in the United States

- Follow our proven script and playbook (full training provided)

- Book qualified discovery meetings on our founder's calendar

- Log every call in our custom-built dialer tool

- Get real-time AI coaching during every call — our custom tool shows you exact lines to say, objection responses, and warnings if you're going off-script. You will never be alone on a call.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Near-native American English pronunciation — this is non-negotiable, HVAC business owners in the US need to hear an accent they trust

- Minimum 6 months of prior outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

- Stable high-speed internet, quiet home office, reliable computer, and quality headset

- Thick skin — you can handle rejection and push through 100+ dials a day without losing energy

- Someone who wants long-term stability, not a stopgap job between other work



COMPENSATION



We don't pay for showing up — we pay for work done. Here's the structure:



- Week 1 (Trial Week): $200 USD, released only after you complete 300 dials during your first week. If you don't hit 300 dials, you don't get paid for that week. This is intentional — it filters out non-serious applicants and ensures we're both committed before we invest further in each other.

- Base (Week 2 onward): $1,000 USD per month, paid weekly, contingent on maintaining a minimum of 100 dials per working day.

- Meeting Bonus: $30 USD for every qualified meeting you book.

- Retainer Sign Bonus: $300 USD for every client that signs a retainer from meetings you booked.

- Realistic top performers earn $1,800 to $2,500 USD per month total.



A qualified meeting is defined as one where the prospect (a) attends the scheduled call, (b) is the owner or decision-maker, and (c) operates an HVAC business with at least 2 trucks. Meeting bonuses are paid weekly for meetings that meet all three criteria.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT



- Script and playbook training on Day 1 before you start dialing (unpaid — this is your investment in the role, same as we invest in you)

- Access to recorded example calls

- Direct daily support from the founder

- Team Slack channel with other appointment setters

- Real-time AI coaching tool active on every call you make



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without answers to all 3 questions below will be ignored:



1. How many months of outbound cold-calling experience do you have, and in what industry or industries?



2. What are you currently doing during 12 AM to 8 AM Philippines time, and how will you commit to this graveyard schedule long-term?



3. Record a 60-second voice sample introducing yourself as if you were opening a cold call to a US HVAC business owner. Attach the audio file to your application, or upload it to a public hosting site like SoundCloud or YouTube and include the link in your application.



We respond to serious candidates within 48 hours.

title: Executive Assistant & Operations Partner | AI/Tech Skills a Plus
description:
I am looking for a highly organized, proactive, disciplined Executive Assistant & Operations Partner to become my right hand and help me bring structure, consistency, and execution to both my personal and business life.



I am an entrepreneur, father, former professional athlete, and creative thinker with ADHD. I move quickly, generate a lot of ideas, and manage multiple responsibilities and business projects at once.



I am NOT looking for someone who simply waits for me to assign tasks.



I need someone who naturally thinks ahead, takes initiative, follows up, creates systems, holds me accountable, and helps make sure important things actually get finished.



If I give you 15 things I'm thinking about, I need you to help me determine the 3 things that actually matter today, organize the rest, and help me execute.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES MAY INCLUDE:



• Managing my calendar, schedule, reminders, and appointments

• Creating and maintaining my daily and weekly priority lists

• Holding me accountable to important priorities

• Breaking larger goals into clear next actions

• Managing tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups

• Helping organize personal/family administrative responsibilities

• Organizing files, documents, notes, and information

• Conducting online research

• Drafting
s and other communications

• Preparing meeting agendas and organizing meeting notes

• Turning meetings and conversations into action items

• Tracking business projects from idea to completion

• Following up with contractors, freelancers, partners, and other contacts

• Creating SOPs, checklists, workflows, and systems

• Helping coordinate developers and other freelancers

• Organizing my business ideas without allowing every new idea to become an immediate priority

• Using AI and automation to make our operations more efficient

• Identifying problems and handling things proactively whenever possible



I want to eventually be able to ask, “What do I need to do today?” and trust that you already have the answer.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR:



You should be extremely organized, disciplined, reliable, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive.



You should be someone who:



• Takes initiative without constantly being told what to do

• Thinks 1–2 steps ahead

• Loves organization and creating structure

• Is comfortable respectfully holding me accountable

• Can work with a fast-moving entrepreneur with ADHD

• Can take many ideas and turn them into organized priorities

• Communicates clearly

• Learns quickly

• Is comfortable solving problems independently

• Has strong attention to detail

• Follows through on commitments

• Is trustworthy with personal and business information

• Wants a long-term opportunity and room to grow

• Is hungry, motivated, dependable, and genuinely cares about doing excellent work



AI / TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE IS A MAJOR PLUS:



The Executive Assistant role comes FIRST. However, I am building AI applications, SaaS products, websites, automations, and other technology businesses.



I would love to find someone who also understands some of the following:



• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Lovable

• Replit

• Cursor

• GitHub

• Zapier

• Make

• n8n

• AI agents and automation

• No-code/low-code development

• Website development

• App development

• APIs

• Python

• JavaScript

• Databases

• UI/UX

• SaaS/MVP development



You do NOT need to know all of these.



If you are an amazing Executive Assistant who also enjoys technology and can help me prototype, automate, troubleshoot, or build things, that is a major advantage.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY:



I am looking for someone I can build with long-term.



The right person could potentially grow from:



Executive Assistant ? Executive Operations Partner ? Chief of Staff / Operations Leader



I want someone who is excited about helping build something from the ground up and growing personally, professionally, and financially as our businesses grow.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your previous Executive Assistant/VA experience.

Why this particular position interests you.

An example of a time you brought organization to a chaotic situation.

An example of something important you handled proactively without being asked.

Any experience working with entrepreneurs, executives, founders, or people with ADHD.

Which AI/technology tools you currently know.

Your desired hourly/monthly compensation.

Your availability and current work schedule.

Where you would like your career to be in 3 years.



FINAL QUESTION:



Imagine it is Monday morning and I tell you:



“I have 15 things I need to do, three new business ideas I want to start, two people I forgot to respond to, paperwork I need to finish, and an important meeting Wednesday. I don't know where to start.”



Walk me through EXACTLY what you would do next.



I care more about how you think than giving me a “perfect” answer.



IMPORTANT:



Please begin your application with the words “VISION TO EXECUTION” so I know you carefully read the entire job posting.



I am looking for someone who can help turn:



VISION ? STRUCTURE ? ACTION ? COMPLETION



If you are organized, disciplined, proactive, trustworthy, technologically curious, and excited about growing alongside an entrepreneur, I would love to hear from you.

title: Inbound + Outbound Appointment Setter — US Home Services (Night Shift, Full-Time)
description:
NextGen Junk Removal & Demolition is an established and rapidly growing home services company serving Sarasota and Manatee County, Florida. We clear out properties — garages, storage units, estate cleanouts, office and construction debris — and handle small demolition work. Our customers are homeowners, property managers, and real estate professionals.

We are hiring one full-time person to manage inbound calls and lead follow-up. This is a long-term position, not a short contract.

Responsibilities

Answer all inbound calls during your shift. Callers are typically homeowners describing what they need removed. You qualify the job, confirm the location, and book an on-site estimate.

Own the follow-up pipeline. A significant share of people who receive a quote don't book immediately. You will work that list daily by phone, text, and
 until each lead is either booked or closed out. This is the highest-value part of the role.

Keep our CRM clean. Every call logged, every lead tagged with the correct source, every pipeline stage current. We make decisions off this data and it needs to be accurate.

Confirm appointments the day before and notify our crew lead of the daily schedule.

Send review requests to completed customers and follow up on them.

We run on GoHighLevel. Prior experience with it is an advantage. If you don't have it, we'll train you.

Requirements

Prior US phone experience. Call center or BPO background strongly preferred — Concentrix, Teleperformance, Alorica, TaskUs, Foundever, or similar. If you've handled inbound or outbound queues for American customers, you already have the core skill.

Clear, easily understood phone communication. A large share of our customers are retirees. You will regularly speak with people who are hard of hearing or who describe their needs vaguely. Patience and clarity are not optional in this role.

Demonstrated follow-up discipline. You will be given a list and expected to work it without supervision or reminders.

Your own computer, reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection, a quiet workspace, and a working headset.

Availability for the full shift, five days a week, consistently.

Schedule

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour unpaid break.

In the Philippines: 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM. This is a night shift.

Note: Philippine shift times move by one hour when US daylight saving changes in March and November.

Please confirm you can commit to these hours before applying. Consistent coverage is a requirement of the position, not a preference.

Saturday coverage may be added later at additional compensation, discussed in advance.

Compensation

$7.50 USD per hour — approximately $1,300/month at 40 hours per week

Paid twice monthly via Wise, on schedule, without exception

Performance review at 90 days with a raise based on results

Backup internet reimbursed

This is an independent contractor position

Training and expectations

Final candidates will complete a paid trial before a long-term offer is made.

Your first week is dedicated training, conducted by me directly. We will review recorded calls, cover our service area in detail, and run live practice calls until you're prepared to take real ones.

I don't expect proficiency in week one. I do expect you to be fully independent by month two, and I will invest the time to get you there. In exchange, I expect you to show up on time, work the list without being asked, and tell me directly when something isn't working.

Application instructions

Submit the following:

A brief summary of your phone experience. Two or three sentences. Do not send a long cover letter.

A 2-minute voice recording. Scenario: you are calling a homeowner in Florida who submitted a request to have her garage cleared. Your objective is to book a free on-site estimate. Record both sides of the conversation.

Written confirmation that you can work 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time.

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.

Hiring decision will be made this month.

Josiah Ginn

Owner, NextGen Junk Removal & Demolition

description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

title: Digital Marketing, Community & Sales Specialist – Metro Manila
description:

This is NOT just a social media posting role.



We’re looking for someone who can combine social media, content creation, AI, community building and sales — and grow with us as our Philippine activity expands.



YOUR ROLE:



• Create engaging content for Instagram,
 and TikTok

• Use AI tools, Canva and video editing tools to create high-quality content efficiently

• Turn our ideas, lifestyle, business activities and existing materials into Reels, posts, stories and other content

• Bring new content ideas and trends relevant to the Filipino audience

• Manage daily social media activity and engagement

• Respond to inquiries and follow up with leads

• Conduct sales/closing conversations with qualified leads via chat, phone or video call

• Schedule appointments and maintain organized lead follow-up

• Help us identify and build the right online community platform for our Filipino audience

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:



• Based in Metro Manila — preferably BGC, Taguig, Makati or nearby

• Excellent English communication skills

• Strong understanding of Filipino social media culture and trends

• Confident talking to people and comfortable with sales and closing conversations

• Experience with Instagram,
 and TikTok

• Strong Canva skills

• Experience creating short-form content

• Practical experience using AI tools for content creation, design, video or marketing

• Organized, reliable and proactive

• Someone who brings ideas and solutions instead of simply waiting for instructions



Experience in sales, wellness, fitness, digital marketing or community building is a strong advantage.



COMPENSATION:



Starting base salary + monthly performance bonuses based on measurable results.

title: Outbound B2B Business Development Representative
description:
We are looking for a confident, naturally talkative and highly articulate person with previous experience in B2B outbound calling, lead generation, telemarketing, appointment setting or a similar role.



This is not an inbound customer service or script-reading call centre role. We need someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, can think quickly, build rapport naturally and turn cold calls into meaningful business conversations and opportunities.



Key Responsibilities & Requirements

Make proactive outbound calls to businesses and reach owners, managers and relevant decision-makers.

Previous experience in a similar outbound calling/business development role is essential.

Speak fluent, clear and professional English with an excellent telephone manner.

Be naturally talkative, personable, confident and engaging — someone for whom conversation comes naturally.

Build rapport quickly and communicate naturally without relying heavily on scripts.

Ask intelligent questions, listen carefully and understand the prospect's business and circumstances.

Explain our business and services clearly and professionally.

Identify and qualify genuine business opportunities rather than simply making high volumes of calls.

Confidently handle objections and rejection without being aggressive or pushy.

Know when to continue a conversation, when to follow up and when to escalate a qualified opportunity.

Accurately summarise each meaningful conversation and enter clear, useful notes into the provided CRM.

Record key details including who was contacted, what was discussed, opportunities identified, objections, agreed actions and next steps.

Schedule, manage and complete follow-up calls, reviewing previous CRM notes and continuing conversations from where they finished.

Maintain an organised pipeline so potential opportunities and follow-ups are not missed.

Have good written English, attention to detail and strong computer/CRM skills.

Be self-motivated, organised and able to work towards measurable KPIs without constant supervision.



The ideal candidate can pick up the phone, confidently start a conversation with a complete stranger, earn their attention, identify an opportunity, document it properly in the CRM and know exactly when and how to follow it up.

title: Architect & Estimating VA for OWSI Flooring & Design + Gemstone Development
description:
We’re on the lookout for an Architect & Estimating Virtual Assistant who’s ready to bring talent, energy, and creativity to our growing team!



This is a joint position with OWSI Flooring & Design and Gemstone Development, two leading Utah-based companies that design and build some of the most beautiful custom homes in the state. From ground-up builds to detailed remodels, we’re looking for someone who can help us turn ideas into full, professional house plans and accurate estimates that our builders can count on.



If you’re passionate about architecture, rendering, and design – and you love collaborating with a driven, positive team – this is your chance to be part of something amazing.



Your Key Responsibilities:



~ Create full residential floor plans, elevations, and layouts using AutoCAD and other professional programs.

~ Develop high-quality, realistic 3D renders that bring spaces to life.

~ Use MeasureSquare (provided by us) to generate takeoffs and integrate data into our estimating system.

~ Confidently communicate with suppliers and subcontractors to gather bids, confirm details, and schedule work.

~ Work directly with the owner and design team on cabinetry, bathroom, and interior layouts.

~ Prepare detailed spec sheets, product lists, and design documentation for projects.

~ Support both companies with a wide range of design, estimating, and coordination tasks as needed for our overall success.



Skills & Qualifications:



~ Strong background in architectural drafting, residential design, and plan creation.

~ Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, Lumion, V-Ray, Enscape, or similar rendering software.

~ Must have and supply your own design and rendering programs.

~ Experience using MeasureSquare for takeoffs and estimating (we provide the license).

~ Familiar with USA and Utah building code standards and residential plan requirements.

~ Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

~ Professional confidence when communicating with suppliers, builders, and subcontractors.

~ High attention to detail, accuracy, and time management.

~ Must have a computer capable of rendering (GPU-ready setup preferred).

~ Familiar with Dropbox, Google Drive, and task management tools like ClickUp or Notion.

~ Must be solution-oriented — we value people who take initiative and figure things out.



Bonus Skills (Preferred but Not Required):



~ Background in interior design or finish selection.

~ Experience with cabinet layouts, millwork drawings, or custom room detailing.

~ Previous estimating experience for finish materials (tile, flooring, lighting, cabinetry, etc.).

~ Experience working with US-based builders or construction companies.



Schedule and Work Requirements:



~ Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Standard Time (Utah Time)

~ Must work live on screen with the owner and team during those hours.

~ Must be available for occasional urgent needs outside of schedule.

~ High productivity and strong results will lead to more hours, growth, and long-term opportunities.

~ Use of Hubstaff for Time Tracking is a must



About OWSI & Gemstone Development:



OWSI Flooring & Design and Gemstone Development are Utah-based companies that work together to create high-end custom homes and luxury remodels. Through OWSI, we partner with builders to supply design-driven products and finishes. Through Gemstone, we design and build one-of-a-kind custom homes across Utah.



We value hard work, honesty, creativity, and a team spirit. Our ideal teammate is confident, resourceful, and passionate about doing excellent work — someone who wants to grow with us for years to come.



How to Apply:

Please include the following in your application:



1) Subject line: “Architect & Estimating VA – Building Utah’s Best Homes!”

2) A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) telling us about your background, your experience with architectural design, rendering, and estimating, and why you’d be a great fit for our team.

3) Links to your portfolio or work samples (AutoCAD plans, renders, or similar).

4) A short written summary describing the design and rendering programs you use, along with your computer specifications.

5) Confirmation that you are available M–F, 8AM–5PM Mountain Standard Time.

title: Practice Manager
description:
FULL-TIME VIRTUAL PRACTICE MANAGER – AUSTRALIAN ALLIED HEALTH CLINIC



Location: Philippines – Work From Home

Hours: Full-Time – 38–40 hours per week (8am-5pm) 

Schedule: Australian business hours

Business: Inner Balance Health – Darwin, Australia

Position: Virtual Practice Manager / Operations Manager



ABOUT INNER BALANCE HEALTH: 

Inner Balance Health is a growing multidisciplinary allied health and rehabilitation clinic based in Darwin, Australia.



Our services include:

Physiotherapy: Neurological rehabilitation, Seniors rehabilitation, Community and home-visit physiotherapy, Hydrotherapy & Sports physiotherapy and rehabilitation

Exercise Physiology: Aged care independent and group session gym 

Remedial Massage

Clinical Pilates

Studio Reformer Pilates

24/7 Pilates

Recovery services including sauna, ice baths and compression therapy



We work with private clients as well as a wide range of Australian healthcare and funding programs including 

NDIS, DVA, Medicare/EPC, Home Care Packages, Short-Term Restorative Care, Workers Compensation, Motor vehicle, and private health insurance. 



We are growing and looking for an exceptional Full-Time Virtual Practice Manager who can take ownership of the administrative and operational side of the clinic - This will be taking over a current role. - Handovers will be provided. 



This is NOT a basic Virtual Assistant position.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a key member of our leadership team and help us build an extremely organised, structured and well-run healthcare business.



THE ROLE

- As our Virtual Practice Manager, you will work closely with the Clinic Director and Clinical Lead to ensure the clinic operates smoothly every day.

- Your job is to manage, organise, follow up, problem-solve and make sure things actually get done.

- We don't want someone who needs to be constantly told what to do.

- We want someone who notices problems, finds solutions, follows things through and takes genuine ownership of their role.

- You will help manage our reception/admin team and become the central point for many of the clinic's administrative systems and processes.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

1. DAILY PRACTICE MANAGEMENT

You will oversee the day-to-day administrative operations of the clinic, including:

* Ensuring the clinic runs smoothly each day

* Monitoring reception and administrative workflows

* Ensuring tasks are completed correctly and on time

* Following up outstanding tasks

* Identifying problems before they become bigger problems

* Escalating important issues to the Director or Clinical Lead

* Maintaining clinic calendars, schedules and operational checklists

* Keeping the Director informed without requiring the Director to micromanage

* Creating structure and accountability across the administrative team



2. RECEPTION & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

You will oversee and assist with:

* Incoming and outgoing phone calls

*
s

* New client enquiries

* Appointment bookings

* Appointment changes and cancellations

* Waitlists

* Client follow-ups

* Practitioner diaries

* Referral management

* Client forms and documentation

* Ensuring clients receive an excellent experience from their first enquiry through to completion of treatment



!!!!!   You must be extremely confident speaking English on the phone !!!!!!



You will be communicating with Australian clients, healthcare professionals, doctors, case managers, support coordinators and funding organisations.



3. CLINIKO & PRACTITIONER SCHEDULE MANAGEMENT

You will become an expert in our practice management system, **Cliniko**.



Responsibilities include:

* Managing practitioner schedules

* Monitoring appointment utilisation

* Identifying gaps in practitioner diaries

* Managing waitlists

* Following up cancellations

* Ensuring appointments are booked correctly

* Monitoring recurring appointments

* Checking client information is complete

* Ensuring referrals and funding information are recorded correctly

* Supporting practitioners with administrative issues

* Helping improve diary utilisation and clinic efficiency



Previous Cliniko experience 
sirable, but experience with another healthcare practice-management system is also valuable.



4. AUSTRALIAN HEALTHCARE FUNDING & BILLING

You will receive training, but you will ultimately be expected to become highly knowledgeable in our different health funding streams.



These include:

* NDIS

* DVA

* Medicare / EPC / Chronic Condition Management

* Workers Compensation

* Home Care Packages

* Short-Term Restorative Care

* Private Health Insurance

* HICAPS

* Private-paying clients



You will help ensure:



* Referrals are valid

* Funding approvals are current

* Correct practitioners are linked to services

* Billing information is correct

* Treatment limits are monitored

* Required documentation is received

* Funding does not expire unnoticed

* Clients and referrers are followed up when required

* Outstanding accounts are followed up

* Administrative billing processes are completed correctly



**Accuracy is extremely important.**



5. REFERRALS & EXTERNAL STAKEHOLDERS



You will help manage relationships and communication with:

* General Practitioners

* Specialists

* NDIS Support Coordinators

* Plan Managers

* Home Care Package providers

* Case Managers

* Workers Compensation insurers

* DVA

* Hospitals

* Aged-care providers

* Community organisations

* Other referral partners



This includes monitoring incoming referrals, following up missing information and ensuring communication does not get lost.



6. ADMIN TEAM MANAGEMENT



A major part of your role will be helping lead our administrative / reception team.



You will:

* Delegate tasks

* Monitor task completion

* Follow up incomplete work

* Train team members

* Help onboard new staff

* Maintain reception procedures

* Create checklists

* Conduct quality checks

* Identify recurring errors

* Provide feedback

* Improve workflows

* Help create accountability within the team



You need to be comfortable **leading people**, not simply completing your own task list.



7. SYSTEMS, SOPs & ORGANISATION



One of our biggest priorities is making Inner Balance Health extremely structured and systemised.



You will help us:



* Create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

* Maintain SOPs

* Build checklists

* Document clinic processes

* Create training resources

* Improve workflows

* Organise shared files and documents

* Maintain templates

* Build repeatable systems

* Identify inefficiencies

* Automate processes where appropriate

* Ensure staff actually follow the systems we create



We want someone who LOVES organisation.



If you see a messy process, your instinct should be: "How can I make this simpler, clearer and repeatable?"



8. STAFF ONBOARDING & TRAINING



You will help coordinate onboarding for new team members, including:

* Employment documentation

* Accounts and software access

* Training schedules

* Policies and procedures

* Practice-management software training

* Clinic services training

* Funding and billing training

* Administrative processes

* Communication systems

* Onboarding checklists

* Following up completion of required training



9. ROSTERS, TIMESHEETS & PAYROLL SUPPORT



You will assist with:



* Administrative rosters

* Staff availability

* Leave requests

* Timesheets

* Checking hours

* Payroll preparation

* Contractor information

* Staff documentation

* Following up missing information



Experience with Australian payroll or bookkeeping is highly desirable.



10. ACCOUNTS & BOOKKEEPING SUPPORT



Depending on your experience, responsibilities may include:



* Monitoring accounts

* Following up outstanding invoices

* Reconciling payments

* Preparing information for bookkeeping/accounting

* Checking invoices

* Expense organisation

* Basic reporting

* Assisting with payroll preparation

* Maintaining financial administration systems



Formal accounting qualifications are **not required**, but strong numerical skills and bookkeeping experience would be highly regarded.



11. PILATES & MEMBERSHIP OPERATIONS



Inner Balance Health also operates Pilates and recovery services.



You will help oversee administrative systems relating to:



* Studio Pilates

* Clinical Pilates

* 24/7 Pilates

* Memberships

* Recovery memberships

* Client enquiries

* Membership changes

* Payments

* Class bookings

* Client communication

* Instructor administration



12. REPORTING & KPIs



We want our Practice Manager to help us run the business using data rather than guesswork.



You will help monitor things such as:



* New enquiries

* New client conversions

* Practitioner utilisation

* Diary gaps

* Cancellations

* No-shows

* Rebooking

* Outstanding accounts

* Referral numbers

* Administrative performance

* Memberships

* Other operational KPIs



You should be comfortable using **Excel / Google Sheets** and learning how to create simple management reports.



13. RECRUITMENT SUPPORT



You may also assist with:



* Posting job advertisements

* Reviewing applications

* Shortlisting candidates

* Organising interviews

* Communicating with applicants

* Reference checks

* Preparing onboarding

* Maintaining recruitment trackers



14. WORKING DIRECTLY WITH THE DIRECTOR



You will work closely with the business owner/director.



A major goal of this position is to allow the Director to focus on:



* Leadership

* Coaching the team

* Clinical development

* Recruitment

* Financial oversight

* Strategy

* Business development

* Quality and compliance

* Growing the clinic



Rather than constantly managing small administrative problems.



You therefore need to be someone who can say: "I've handled it"



Not: "What do you want me to do?"



for every small decision.



# WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely organised

* Reliable

* Proactive

* Intelligent

* Detail-oriented

* Confident

* Calm under pressure

* A strong communicator

* Comfortable managing people

* Comfortable making decisions

* Excellent at following through

* Good at prioritising

* Able to manage multiple projects

* Naturally interested in improving systems

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to work independently

* Happy to ask questions when genuinely required

* Accountable for mistakes and willing to learn from them



Most importantly:



**You take ownership.**







ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



You MUST have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Minimum 2 years' relevant professional experience

* Previous experience in administration, operations, practice management, healthcare administration, executive assistance or team leadership

* Experience managing multiple responsibilities

* Strong computer skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Excellent organisational skills

* Confidence speaking with Australian clients over the phone

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Quiet professional work environment

* Ability to work Australian business hours

* Ability to attend video meetings

* Long-term availability



# HIGHLY DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



We would LOVE to hear from candidates with experience in:



* Australian healthcare

* Allied health

* Physiotherapy clinics

* Medical practices

* Practice management

* Medical Virtual Assistant roles

* Cliniko

* NDIS

* DVA

* Medicare

* Workers Compensation

* Home Care Packages

* Private health insurance

* HICAPS

* Bookkeeping

* Payroll

* Team leadership

* SOP creation

* Process improvement

* Recruitment

* KPI reporting



You do **not** need to know every Australian healthcare system already.



We will provide training.



However, you must demonstrate that you are capable of learning complex systems and eventually **owning them**.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Full-time long-term position

* Work from home

* Stable Australian employer

* Australian daytime working hours

* Extensive training

* Opportunity to develop expertise in Australian healthcare administration

* Direct involvement with the business owner

* Significant responsibility and autonomy

* Opportunity to grow into a senior operational leadership position

* Be part of a growing allied-health business rather than simply completing repetitive VA tasks



For the right person, we want this to become a **long-term career with Inner Balance Health.**







IMPORTANT – APPLICATION PROCESS



We are intentionally making our application process detailed because we are looking for an exceptional person.



ROUND 1 – APPLICATION



Please send:

1. Your CV / Resume

2. A short cover letter

3. Your previous relevant work experience

4. Details of any healthcare, medical, allied-health or Australian business experience that you know of 

5. Your expected hourly/monthly salary

6. Confirmation that you can work full-time Australian business hours



7. A link to your **application video** 



## VIDEO APPLICATION IS MANDATORY - applications without video will be overlooked/ discarded. 

**Applications without a video will NOT progress to Round 2.**



Please record a **3–5 minute video** introducing yourself.



You do NOT need professional editing. We want to hear directly from you.



In your video, please answer:



**1. Tell us about yourself and your professional background.**



**2. Why do you believe you have the skills to be the Practice Manager Inner Balance Health needs?**



**3. Tell us about a previous role where you were responsible for keeping a business, team or department organised. What did you personally manage?**



**4. Give us an example of a problem you identified and solved without waiting for your manager to tell you what to do.**



**5. Have you ever managed or supervised other staff? If yes, tell us how you managed accountability and performance.**



**6. Tell us about your experience with healthcare administration, billing, practice-management software, bookkeeping, payroll or similar systems.**



**7. If you started with us and found that our administrative systems were disorganised, what would you do in your first 30 days?**



**8. Why are you looking for a long-term position, and why does this particular role interest you?**



**9. What do you know about the Australian health care system?, especially when discussing Private Physiotherapy clinic health care? **



Please upload the video to **Loom or Google Drive** or another accessible platform and include the link with your application.



Make sure we have permission to view it.



# ROUND 2 – INTERVIEW



Only applicants who demonstrate the required communication, experience, initiative and leadership potential through their written application **and video** will be selected for a second-round video interview.



Further stages may include a practical skills assessment and final interview.



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You are looking for a temporary role

* You cannot work Australian business hours

* You are uncomfortable speaking to clients on the phone

* You require constant supervision

* You regularly need to be reminded to complete tasks

* You dislike managing people

* You struggle with detailed administrative work

* You are applying to dozens of VA jobs without reading the job description

* You are unwilling to complete the video application



---



## HOW TO APPLY

Please use the subject/title:

**"IBH PRACTICE MANAGER – [YOUR NAME]"**

In the **first sentence of your application**, please write:

**"I have read the entire Practice Manager job description and understand that a video application is required."**



Then include your:

* CV

* Cover letter

* Relevant experience

* Expected salary

* Australian-hours availability

* Video link



**Incomplete applications will not progress to the next stage.**



We are excited to find someone exceptional who wants to grow with Inner Balance Health and become a genuinely important part of our team.

title: Accounts Manager / Bookkeeper
description:
About Us:

Coalfields Climate Control is a growing HVAC and refrigeration contracting business based in the Hunter Valley, NSW, Australia. We install, service, and maintain air conditioning and refrigeration systems for residential and commercial clients.



The Role:

We're looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Manager / Bookkeeper to keep our finances accurate, our quotes turning around quickly, and our client relationships running smoothly. This is a part-time, remote role covering bookkeeping, job quoting, and client-facing account communication.



Training Provided:

Full training will be provided on our systems - no prior familiarity with our specific processes required.



Key Responsibilities:

Bookkeeping:

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping in Xero (invoicing, reconciliations, accounts payable/receivable)

Process and track payments, follow up on overdue accounts

Support payroll processing and superannuation payments

Maintain accurate financial records and assist with monthly reporting



Quoting

Prepare client quotes for AC install and service jobs using our standard pricing/markup structure

Required Qualifications

title: Etsy Digital Product Designer & Shop Builder – Small Business Forms & Template Bundles
description:
I am building a new Etsy shop focused on digital products that help small service-based businesses run more professionally and efficiently.



I am looking for a creative, organized, and experienced person who can help me build the shop from the ground up, including product research, template creation, branding, mockups, Etsy listings, and SEO.



The shop will offer both individual business forms/templates and larger coordinated bundles or complete operational systems. Customers may be able to purchase one specific document they need or save by purchasing a larger package containing multiple related forms.



The initial business niches will include:



Professional Organizing

Residential Cleaning

Pet Sitting / Dog Walking

Mobile Auto Detailing

Photography

Home Staging

Event Planning



Additional small-business niches will be added over time.



Types of Products We Will Create



Products may be sold individually, as smaller themed bundles, or as complete business systems.



Examples include:



Client intake forms

Lead inquiry forms

Consultation questionnaires

Client assessments

Service agreements

Contract templates

Proposal templates

Estimate and quote templates

Pricing guides

Service menus

Welcome packets

Client onboarding forms

Client preparation guides

Policies and procedures

Scheduling forms

Service checklists

Project checklists

Client communication templates

 templates

Follow-up forms

Cancellation and rescheduling policies

Payment policy forms

Client feedback forms

Review request templates

Referral forms

Offboarding documents

Internal workflow templates

Business trackers

Client management forms

Business organization templates



For example, a professional organizer may be able to purchase a Client Intake Form individually, a Client Onboarding Bundle containing several related documents, or a much larger Professional Organizer Business Forms Bundle containing most of the documents needed to manage clients from inquiry through project completion.



The goal is to give customers options at different price points while also creating larger, higher-value bundles.



Your Responsibilities



You will help:



Research each business niche and determine which forms and templates business owners are actively looking for

Identify opportunities for both individual products and bundles

Create professional editable templates, primarily in Canva

Develop coordinated collections so individual products can later be combined into bundles

Create clean, attractive, easy-to-use business documents

Maintain consistent branding and formatting across product collections

Create Etsy listing images and professional mockups

Prepare customer instruction PDFs and Canva template links

Create Etsy SEO titles, descriptions, and 13 tags

Research competitors and Etsy search opportunities

Recommend new products based on demand and gaps in the market

Help organize the Etsy shop into logical sections and product categories

Help develop larger premium bundles from individual products



I want the product catalog built strategically so that one form can become several selling opportunities.



For example:



Client Intake Form ? Client Onboarding Bundle ? Complete Business Forms Bundle



This will allow us to create a large Etsy catalog while also offering customers multiple purchasing options.



The Person I Am Looking For



You should be very comfortable using Canva and have a strong eye for professional, attractive business-document design.



Etsy experience is strongly preferred, especially experience with:



Digital products

Etsy SEO

Etsy keyword research

Canva templates

Small-business documents

Printable forms

Business systems

Client onboarding materials



Strong written English is important because many of these products will contain customer-facing business language.



You should also be extremely organized. We will be creating many related products, and documents need to be designed so they can work both individually and as part of larger coordinated bundles.



I am especially interested in someone who can research, think strategically, and suggest products, rather than waiting for me to provide every idea.



Product Research Is Important



I do not want someone who only knows how to make attractive Canva templates.



I want someone who can help answer questions such as:



What forms does a residential cleaning business actually need?

What documents are photographers searching for?

What forms are selling individually on Etsy?

Which products should be combined into bundles?

Which business niches have good demand but less competition?

What important forms are competitors leaving out?

How can we create a better or more complete product?



The goal is to create products that solve real operational problems for small-business owners.



Original Work Only



All work must be original and created specifically for this shop.



I do not want:



Copied Etsy listings

Copied competitor templates

Resold PLR products

Copyrighted designs

Templates purchased elsewhere and slightly modified



Any fonts, graphics, photos, icons, or design assets used must be appropriate for commercial use.



For contracts, legal forms, waivers, or other documents that could create legal obligations, templates should be clearly presented as customizable business templates and not represented as attorney-prepared legal advice unless they have actually been reviewed by a qualified attorney.



Long-Term Opportunity



This is not intended to be a one-time project.



My goal is to build a large Etsy digital-product shop containing potentially hundreds of listings across multiple small-business niches.



The shop will include:



Individual Forms ? Small Bundles ? Client Systems ? Complete Business Bundles



If we work well together, there will be ongoing work creating additional products, adding new industries, improving listings, creating bundles, researching keywords, and expanding the shop.



I am looking for someone who is interested in helping me build and grow the business long term.



To Apply



Please include the following:



A short introduction about your experience.

Examples of Canva templates, business documents, Etsy digital products, or forms you have created.

Details about any Etsy shops you have helped create or manage.

Your experience with Etsy SEO and keyword/product research.

Your experience creating digital products.

Your hourly rate and/or project rate.

How many hours per week you are available.

Which niche you would recommend we launch first: professional organizing, residential cleaning, pet sitting, mobile detailing, photography, home staging, or event planning.

Give me 5 individual digital products you would create first for that niche.

At the very top of your application, write “DIGITAL FORMS” so I know you read the entire posting.



Please do not send a generic application.



I am looking for someone who understands how to build a digital-product catalog strategically, where products can be sold individually and then combined into increasingly valuable bundles and complete business systems.

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter / HR Specialist | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



You're not just filling seats. You're protecting the standard every hire either raises or lowers.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the Company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



This is not a transactional recruiting role.



We're looking for an Executive Recruiter who operates as both a strategic hiring partner and trusted advisor — to clients, to leadership, and to the candidates moving through the process. You'll manage full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles while supporting the HR operations that keep the internal team running well.



You'll work directly with clients to understand their business and what a great hire looks like — then go build it. The judgment calls you make directly shape the teams clients trust us to build. We need someone who takes that seriously.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best recruiters we've worked with share a few traits:



They protect the bar. When a candidate is almost right, they don't talk themselves into a yes — they know a weak hire is never the safe option, just a delayed and more expensive problem.



They're honest even when it costs them. If a role brief is unclear, they push back. If a candidate isn't the right fit, they say so — directly, kindly, and early.



They're genuinely curious. They don't run the same interviewscript for every role — they study the business, ask questions other recruiters miss, and keep getting sharper at reading people over time.



They build systems, not just pipelines. Every hiring cycle produces something better than the last — tighter screening, cleaner processes, sharper evaluation criteria.



Who Thrives Here



People who care deeply about quality — in who they hire, in how they advise clients, and in how they work. You find satisfaction in identifying the right person. You take it personally when a weak candidate slips through. You're organized, direct, and comfortable making judgment calls without needing consensus.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is built yet. For the right person, that's the opportunity to build the systems that scale with the business, not just manage what already exists.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where clients need to hire well across multiple roles, industries, and seniority levels — and where the quality of every hire reflects directly on our company.



That looks like:



Managing full-cycle recruitment for executive, leadership, technical, and specialized roles — from intake through offer, owning every step



Leading intake calls with clients — understanding their business, pushing back when a brief isn't clear enough to hire well against, and providing strategic hiring recommendations when needed



Proactively sourcing and headhunting candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, networks, and AI-powered tools — not waiting for applications



Conducting structured interviews that assess mindset, ownership, communication, and cultural fit — not just credentials



Presenting candidates with clear, honest hiring recommendations so clients make better decisions faster



Writing and posting culture-fit job descriptions across all platforms that attract the right candidates and filter out the wrong ones



Supporting HR operations — onboarding, contractor documentation, records management, and internal policy compliance



Tracking recruitment metrics and pipeline health — surfacing what's working and what needs to change



Building and improving recruitment SOPs, interview guides, scorecards, and onboarding checklists



Using AI tools to accelerate sourcing, screening, and communication without cutting corners on quality



What We're Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to; clients and candidates always feel heard



Strong full-cycle recruitment experience — executive, technical, and specialized roles across multiple clients or industries



Proven client communication and stakeholder management skills — you run intake calls, push back on vague briefs, and advise with confidence



Sharp interviewing and candidate assessment ability — you probe for specifics and can tell the difference between someone who sounds good and someone who actually is



Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Recruiter, or equivalent) — daily use, not occasional



Strong proactive sourcing and headhunting skills — you build pipelines, you don't wait for them



Proficiency in ATS platforms and HR tools (Workable, ClickUp, or equivalent)



High integrity and sound judgment — honest calls, confidential information handled without exceptions



Self-directed once you understand the environment — but asks the right questions early



Nice to Have



Experience in executive search, agency recruitment, or outsourcing environments



Background in MSP, IT services, or operations-heavy environments



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand how we hire, our clients, our tools, and how the business operates. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly — and significant latitude to shape how we hire and build the team.



We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like

At three months:



You've run multiple full-cycle searches end-to-end. Your candidate assessments are sharp, honest, and already what leadership and clients rely on. You know the business well enough to push back on a vague brief.



At six months:



Hiring is faster and more consistent. JDs are stronger. Screening is tighter. Onboarding is more structured. Recruitment metrics are visible and being used to improve the process.



At twelve months:



We hire better because of the systems you built. Weak candidates don't make it through. Strong ones move quickly. Clients trust your judgment — and we're investing in your continued growth.



How We Work



You won't be micromanaged. We trust our people to do great work and give them the space to do it. Meaningful work means making decisions — and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn and move forward.



We're a growing MSP — not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you.



This Role Is Not for You If:



You treat hiring as a numbers game — more applications, faster fills



You talk yourself into candidates who are almost right because the pipeline is thin



You present candidates without a clear, honest recommendation behind them



You need a fully built system handed to you



You're uncomfortable pushing back on clients or leadership when the direction isn't right



You've never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don't intend to start



There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.



What We Offer



Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay via Wise direct deposit

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Executive Support Specialist
description:
Executive Support Specialist

US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time



The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You’re not here to answer
s and schedule meetings. You’re here to make sure the clients you support never have to think twice about whether something is handled.



We’re looking for an Executive Support Specialist who operates like a second brain — someone who anticipates needs before they’re voiced, manages complexity without being asked, and treats the client’s time as the most valuable resource in the business.



You’ll own administrative operations, client communication, and organizational systems across a fast-moving environment. You’ll also be expected to use AI tools actively — not occasionally — to work faster, produce better outputs, and eliminate manual work that shouldn’t exist in the first place.



The Mindset We’re Looking For



The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:



They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution

They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it

They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality

They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting

They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas

They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it



Who Thrives Here



People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.



We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.



What You’ll Do



You’ll walk into a client’s world that has real moving parts — relationships, internal deadlines, communication threads, administrative backlogs, and calendar complexity. Your job is to bring order, anticipate what’s next, and make sure the client is always walking into rooms prepared — and to use AI tools to do all of it faster and better than it’s been done before.



That looks like:



Managing the client’s calendar end-to-end — scheduling, rescheduling, prioritizing conflicts, and making sure every meeting has a purpose and a brief before it happens

Handling inbound communication across
, phone, and messaging platforms — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs the client’s attention

Using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to draft communications, summarize threads, generate reports, and prepare briefing materials faster than manual methods allow

Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and surfacing anything at risk before it becomes a problem
