Managing inquiries and interactions with professionalism and warmth — resolving what can be resolved, escalating what can’t, and always following through

Maintaining organized, accurate records across CRM systems, shared drives, and administrative databases — so information is findable, current, and reliable

Coordinating meetings, travel, and logistics across time zones with the kind of detail orientation that means surprises don’t happen

Supporting social media scheduling, market research, and competitor analysis when needed — using AI tools to accelerate research and content production



What We’re Looking For



Excellent conversational English — clear, natural, and easy to listen to. A strong accent is completely fine; what matters is that clients never have to work hard to understand you and walk away from every interaction feeling heard

Proven experience in an executive support, virtual assistant, or administrative role — you know what it takes to support a high-output client and you’ve done it before

Active, confident use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or equivalent) — you use them daily to produce better work faster, not as a novelty you tried once

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace — you don’t need training on the basics, you need a challenge

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent) — you can maintain records, track interactions, and generate reports without hand-holding

Strong written English communication — your
s are clear, professional, and require no revisions before they’re sent

Experience with social media management and scheduling tools — you can plan, post, and monitor across platforms without supervision

High accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors before they leave your desk, not after

Strong organizational and time-management skills — you manage multiple priorities simultaneously and nothing slips through

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask the right questions early to get there

Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — in a fast-moving environment, plans change; you adapt without losing 
ntum

Long-term mindset — you want to build trust over time, not treat this as a stepping stone



Nice to Have



Experience with AI-powered workflow automation tools (Make, Zapier, n8n, or equivalent)

Experience supporting C-suite or senior leadership in a remote environment

Familiarity with project management tools (ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or 
)

Basic bookkeeping (QuickBooks or Xero)

Experience with market research and competitor analysis



How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We’re honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.



In your first weeks and months, you’ll have real hands-on support from the team. We’ll work closely with you to understand how our clients operate, our tools, our standards, and how information flows across the business. We expect questions — and we’ll give you the time to learn.



As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape how they support clients and manage their work.



We don’t want to over-direct people who don’t need it. But we also don’t believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other’s trust through real work — then we get out of the way.



What Success Looks Like



At 3 months:



The client’s calendar is clean, communication is handled, and nothing is falling through the cracks

You’re already using AI tools to produce outputs faster than expected

Your systems are making things more organized than they were before you arrived



At 6 months:



You’re anticipating needs before they’re voiced

The client spends less time on administration and more time on what only they can do

You’ve identified repetitive tasks and automated or streamlined them using AI tools — without being asked



At 12 months:



You’re an indispensable part of how the business operates

The client trusts your judgment completely

You’ve built AI-powered systems and habits that would be immediately felt if they disappeared


 is investing in your continued growth



How We Work

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
If your instinct when something breaks is to fix the pipeline before fixing the symptom — this role was built for you.



To apply please fill out the application form here: 
/bepartofourteam.



About the company



We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.



The Role



You're not here to deploy code and move on. You're here to make sure the systems that deliver that code are reliable, secure, automated, and continuously improving.

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer who thinks in pipelines, not tasks. You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our development and client environments running — CI/CD pipelines, Linux systems, cloud platforms, monitoring, and security. When something breaks, you find the root cause. When something works, you ask how to make it more reliable, more automated, and less dependent on human intervention next time.



The Mindset We're Looking For



The best DevOps engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

They treat manual processes as technical debt. If something requires a human to do it repeatedly, their instinct is to eliminate that dependency — not just document it

They take ownership. From the 
nt an infrastructure problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's resolved, documented, and hardened against happening again

They think in systems. They don't just fix what's broken — they ask what else could break, and why, and build accordingly

They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and deployment risks are shared openly — before being asked for

They keep learning. The DevOps landscape moves fast. Twelve months from now they know more than they do today — because they made sure of it



Who Thrives Here



People who are technically sharp, operationally minded, and genuinely excited by the challenge of building infrastructure that just works. You don't wait to be handed a list of things to automate — you find them. You're comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful under pressure, and you care more about system reliability than staying in a defined lane.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. For the right engineer, that's not a warning — it's the opportunity to build things the right way from the ground up.



What You'll Do



You'll walk into an environment where development pipelines, Linux infrastructure, cloud systems, and client integrations all need an engineer who can own them end-to-end. Your job isn't just to keep things running — it's to make them run better, more reliably, and with less human intervention every month.

That looks like:



Designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that make deployments fast, reliable, and repeatable — so shipping code is a non-event, not a risk

Managing and administering Linux servers (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) across development and client environments — knowing these systems well enough to troubleshoot them at any layer

Administering web servers (Nginx, Apache) and databases — keeping them performant, secure, and maintainable

Implementing client-requested integrations — understanding what's being asked, translating it into a reliable technical solution, and delivering it cleanly

Conducting root cause analysis on production errors — not just fixing what's visible, but understanding what allowed it to happen and building the safeguard that prevents it

Building scripts and automation (Bash required; Python and PHP a plus) that eliminate repetitive manual work from the team's daily operations

Monitoring infrastructure, resource utilization, and security events — building alerting systems that catch problems before they become i

Designing and enforcing DevSecOps practices — making security a built-in part of the pipeline, not an afterthought

Working with cloud platforms and virtualization — managing hypervisors and cloud service providers with the confidence of someone who's done it in production



What We're Looking For



Proven experience in Linux server administration (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian) — you know these systems well enough to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize them without a guide

Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've built and maintained real pipelines, not just used them; you know what makes a deployment safe and what makes it a liability

Strong version control administration — Git, remote repositories, branching strategies, code review workflows; you manage these with intention, not just habit

Web server administration experience — Nginx and Apache, configuration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

Database administration experience — you can manage database servers, optimize queries, and keep data environments healthy

Bash scripting proficiency (required) — you write automation that works, that others can read, and that makes the team faster; Python and PHP experience is a plus

Solid cloud computing and virtualization experience — working with hypervisors and cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, or equivalent) in real production environments

Infrastructure and event monitoring experience — you build alerting systems that surface the right information at the right time, not noise

Understanding of DevSecOps — you treat security as part of the build, not something bolted on at the end

Strong diagnostic skills — you find the root cause of a production issue, not just the fastest path to closing the ticket

Self-directed once you understand the environment — but you ask smart questions early to get there

Honest communicator — you surface risks and blockers clearly and early, even when the news isn't good

Long-term mindset — you want to build something that lasts, not move on when things get complex





How Onboarding Works (And How That Changes)



We're honest about how we work with new tea
mbers.

In your first weeks and months, you'll have real hands-on support from the team. We'll work closely with you to understand our infrastructure, our standards, our tools, and how we operate. We expect questions — and we'll give you the time to learn.

As you show what you can do — and you will — that involvement steps back quickly. Trust grows fast here. People who demonstrate ownership, judgment, and quality work earn autonomy quickly. People who consistently deliver end up with significant latitude to shape the infrastructure, the pipelines, and how we build.

We don't want to over-direct people who don't need it. But we also don't believe in throwing someone in without context and calling it autonomy. We earn each other's trust through real work — then we get out of the way.





What Success Looks Like



At three months: You have a clear picture of the infrastructure landscape — what's healthy, what's fragile, and what needs to be rebuilt. At least one significant manual process has been automated. Your documentation is already what the team references.

At six months: Deployments are more reliable and less stressful than when you joined. Monitoring is catching problems before they become i
. The team is spending less time on reactive firefighting and more time building.

At twelve months: The infrastructure is measurably more stable, secure, and automated than before you joined. You've built systems the team depends on — and you're already identifying the next layer of improvement. The company is investing in your next step.





How We Work



We trust our people to do great work and we give them the space to do it. There's real work to be done — clients and internal teams depend on the infrastructure you manage — but we understand that doing meaningful work means making decisions, and sometimes those decisions won't be right on the first try. That's how we find the right path. We don't punish thoughtful mistakes. We learn from them and move forward.

We're a growing MSP, so not every pipeline is optimized and not every process is documented yet. That's part of why we need someone like you — to help us build the infrastructure, automations, and systems that make us better as we grow.





This Role Is Not for You If:



You need a defined list of tasks to know what to work on

You deploy the fix without asking what caused the failure

You treat documentation and runbooks as someone else's job

You're comfortable with fragile systems as long as they're currently running

Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus

You're looking for a low-pressure remote role with predictable, well-defined work

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.





What We Offer





Competitive salary based on experience

100% remote — no corporate commute, ever

Weekly pay

Tech and internet allowance

Paid vacation leave

HMO

Access to the latest AI tools (Claude, Code, and more) to work smarter and automate more

Career growth

title: Cold Caller
description:
We're hiring ONE appointment setter. Not a batch, not a

pool. One seat, one person, long term.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You call business owners and financial advisors in the US

and Canada from a list we build and enrich for you. You

introduce the offer, qualify them against written

criteria, and book a meeting on our client's calendar.



Then you stay with that prospect. You confirm the meeting,

you remind them, and when someone reschedules or doesn't

show up, you call them back personally and get the meeting

back on the calendar. That last part is the most important

part of this job. Most setters stop at the booking. You

won't.



Roughly 100 to 150 dials a day. We use a dialer, a CRM,

and a script you'll be trained on before your first call.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- The list. You never prospect or scrape your own leads.

- The script, and training on it before you dial.

- The dialer, CRM, and phone system.

- Direct access to me. I train and brief every setter

  personally. You will not be handed off to a manager.



SCHEDULE



Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

(9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine Time).



This is a graveyard shift. Please be honest with yourself

about this before applying. If you can't hold this

schedule consistently, this role will not work for you and

we'll both waste our time.



PAY



$700 USD per month base, paid twice monthly.

Plus $25 USD for every appointment you book that actually

shows up.



Consistent performers land 8 to 12 showed appointments a

month, which puts realistic total pay at $900 to $1,000.



REQUIREMENTS



- Clear, confident spoken English. Neutral accent

  preferred but a clear one matters more than a neutral

  one.

- A working headset with a noise-cancelling mic.

- Stable internet, minimum 20 Mbps, with a backup

  connection or a plan for outages.

- A quiet room. No roosters, no tricycles, no family in

  the background. Business owners hang up on background

  noise.

- Willing to be recorded and coached on your calls weekly.



Experience in BPO, telemarketing, or appointment setting

is a plus. It is not required. If you've never done this

and you can hold a conversation with a stranger, apply

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING SPECIALIST (TECH-FOCUSED) - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Google Ads Manager
description:
We run a local clinic where every conversion starts with a phone call.

We're not looking for someone to manage campaigns. We're looking for someone who thinks in calls — who understands that in our market, the quality of who calls matters more than how many people call.

If you've only optimized for volume, this probably isn't the right fit.

What you'll be doing



Manage and optimize Google Ads Search campaigns

Identify and eliminate wasted spend from search terms

Improve call quality — not just call volume

Review and improve call tracking and attribution

Align ads and landing pages with real caller intent

Diagnose whether problems come from traffic quality, tracking gaps, landing pages, or call handling



What matters to us



Fewer junk calls, higher percentage of qualified calls

Higher booking rate per call

Clear thinking and fast decisions

Direct communication — no fluff



What we're looking for

Proven experience with Google Ads Search for local lead generation

Experience with call-driven accounts where not every caller is a qualified lead

Strong grasp of search terms, negative keyword strategy, match types, and geo and device performance

Ability to act, not just analyze



A strong plus

Experience in verticals where caller qualification is a core problem — legal, dental, home services, financial services, or similar. You don't need to know our industry. You need to have solved this type of problem before.



To Apply

Send us a brief note covering:

title: Video Editor — Motion Graphics for Long-Form YouTube + SaaS Launch Videos | Part-Time 30 hrs/week
description:
Hi, I'm Hudson — an Australian founder. I build software and document the whole thing on YouTube.



I'm hiring ONE editor, part-time, 30 hours a week, long-term. The same guaranteed volume every week. This is not project-by-project work.



There is no test project, paid or unpaid. I'm hiring on your past work, your attention to detail, and how you answer the questions at the bottom.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



1. Long-form YouTube. This is the main job. Build-in-public videos, tutorials, breakdowns, 8 to 20 minutes. They have to stay interesting the whole way through. That is the actual skill I'm paying for.



2. SaaS launch and product videos. 60 to 90 seconds, high polish, for the software I'm building.



3. Short-form vertical cuts. Some pulled out of the long-form, some filmed standalone. This is what keeps your week full and the work consistent rather than feast-or-famine.



THE QUALITY BAR



Go and watch the hero video on the Kleo 3.0 launch page. OnlineJobs strips links out of job posts, so type the address into your browser yourself. It is: kleo dot so slash 3



That is the standard. Specifically, here is what I mean by it:



- Kinetic typography that lands on the beat, one word at a time, with the key word in a brand colour while the rest stays white

- Clean UI mockups that animate in 3D space and settle

- Real depth. The speaker is masked and layered into the graphics, with some cards passing behind her and others sitting in front. She is inside the graphics, not pasted on top of them

- Dark gradient interstitials with a soft brand glow, used as punctuation between sections

- Cards and testimonials that stagger in on their own timing, hold, and leave cleanly

- Split layouts where the speaker drops to a rounded picture-in-picture beside the information

- Cutting and sound design that keep the pace up without turning it into a meme edit



Note that the whole video is one person at one desk. No b-roll is carrying it. Every bit of watchability is motion graphics. That is exactly what I need, because that is how I film.



If you can't build the things in that list in After Effects, this role isn't for you. Please don't apply — I'll only say no, and we both lose the time.



WHAT I NEED



- Strong After Effects. Premiere or Resolve for the assembly is fine

- Motion graphics you built yourself, not bought templates

- The ability to hold a viewer's attention through a 15 minute video

- Reliable weekly turnaround and clear communication in English

- A real 30 hours a week, consistently



WHAT YOU GET



- US$700 to US$1,000 per month depending on what your portfolio actually shows

- 30 hours a week, every week, long-term

- Paid on time every time, via Wise, PayPal or GCash

- Organised briefs. Footage, brand kit, script, references and timestamped notes in one folder. You will never be chasing me for an asset

- Your rate reviewed at 3 months



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. How you answer it is most of my decision.



1. Start your message with the word TANGERINE



2. Send 2 or 3 links to videos you personally edited. Public links only — YouTube, Vimeo, or your own site. No Google Drive, no Dropbox, no WeTransfer, no downloads. For each one, tell me exactly which parts you made



3. Send one link that is specifically motion graphics work. If your best motion graphics sits inside a longer video, give me the timestamp



4. Pick one effect from that Kleo hero video (kleo dot so slash 3) and tell me in a few sentences how you would build it. I'm not looking for a perfect answer. I want to see how you think



5. Tell me what you edit in, and how many hours a week you can genuinely commit



6. Tell me your monthly rate for 30 hours a week



Short is fine. Two great links and six honest answers beat ten paragraphs.



I read every application and I reply either way.



Hudson

title: ERPNext Developer and AI Integration Specialist
description:
About Us

We are a growing automotive group based in Fredericksburg, Virginia, operating two businesses under one roof. My Car Business Services is our independent dealership and My Car Care Services is our auto repair shop. We are building a unified AI-native platform to replace our current spreadsheet-based operations and run both businesses from one system.



We move fast, we invest in technology, and we are serious about AI. This is not a generic CRM project. We are building something custom, the architecture is already designed, and we need someone who can own the execution.



What You Will Be Building

A unified ERP and AI platform on ERPNext and Frappe Framework covering all operations across both businesses. The system replaces 200+ Google Sheets tabs and becomes the single source of truth for inventory, sales, BHPH loans, repair jobs, HR, payroll, accounting, marketing, and customer management.



On top of the ERP you will integrate AI agents that automate the work humans currently do manually. Inbound voice calls, lead follow-up, content generation, job application screening, inventory updates, financing decisions, and OBD2 vehicle health alerts.







Your Responsibilities



Phase 1 — Foundation (Weeks 1-4, go-live Week 4)

Provision Frappe Cloud and Google Cloud Platform infrastructure using Terraform

Set up Google Workspace SSO for all users

Build core DocTypes: Vehicle (14-stage lifecycle), Recon Task, QC Checklist, Parts and Vendors

Migrate vehicle and vendor data from Google Sheets

Build ClickUp-style task views (List, Kanban, Calendar) for the Recon team

Set up role-based workspaces for Executive, Sales, Recon, HR, Accounting, and Body departments

Build Extended Lead DocType with SLA timers and CRM pipeline

Deploy first Claude API content generation agent

Build Mobile PWA for field use

Set up Playwright MCP automated test suite



Phase 2 — Operations depth (Weeks 5-8, UAT Week 8)

Build auction intelligence module with full margin model (ADJ MMR, fees, floor-plan 30/60/90)

Build BHPH loan servicing extending Frappe Loan Management (payment schedules, repo workflow)

Set up direct lead capture from CarGurus,
/Meta, Google, website, and third-party sources

Build customer portal for BHPH payments, service appointments, and document uploads

Integrate OBD2 vehicle health feed (Teltonika FMB003 device) with service alert routing into My Car Care

Set up multi-entity accounting with GL separation between dealership and repair shop

Deploy Vertex AI Document AI OCR for titles, invoices, and auction slips

Build marketing module with Claude-driven content generation agents



Phase 3 — AI and hardening (Weeks 9-11, final go-live Week 11)

Build HR, payroll, and time/attendance modules across 4 pay plan structures

Deploy KPI and SOP DocTypes per role

Set up BigQuery analytics warehouse via Datastream and Looker Studio executive dashboards

Deploy Vertex AI Search universal search across all modules

Build and deploy Twilio + Claude AI inbound/outbound sales agent (voice and SMS)

Security hardening, load testing, and full team training

Final go-live



Required Skills



ERPNext / Frappe Framework

Proven experience building custom Frappe apps with DocTypes, controllers, hooks, and workflows

Experience with Frappe Cloud or self-hosted ERPNext deployments

Comfortable with Frappe's permission model, role-based access, and multi-company setup

Familiarity with Frappe's REST API, webhooks, and background workers



AI and Automation

Experience integrating Claude API or OpenAI API into real production applications

Experience building voice or SMS agents using Twilio, Vapi, Bland AI, or similar tools

Comfortable with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, or n8n

Experience with prompt engineering for production AI workflows



Google Cloud Platform

Hands-on experience with GCP services: Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Secret Manager, Cloud Build

Comfortable with Terraform for infrastructure as code

Experience with Google Workspace SSO integration



General Technical Skills

Strong Python skills — Frappe backend runs on Python

Comfortable with JavaScript and Vue.js for frontend customization

Experience with GitHub version control and CI/CD pipelines

Strong written English for documentation, weekly reports, and client communication



Nice to Have

Experience with the Frappe Assistant Core MCP server or AI-native ERPNext tooling

Familiarity with Claude Code or Cursor for AI-augmented development

Experience with Playwright MCP for automated browser testing

Background in automotive, dealership, or repair shop operations

Experience with BHPH (Buy Here Pay Here) loan servicing workflows

Knowledge of Twilio for voice and SMS integrations



How to Apply — Required Items







Your application must include all four of the following:



At least one example of a custom Frappe or ERPNext app you have built. Describe the DocTypes, what it does, and who uses it in production.

At least one example of an AI integration you have built and deployed. Describe the tool, the workflow, and the real-world outcome.

Your honest assessment of the 11-week timeline for a project of this scope. Do you think it is achievable and why? Be specific.

Your availability in Philippine Standard Time, how many hours per day you can commit, and your expected hourly rate in USD.



What We Offer

A complete technical proposal, architecture documents, and phase plan ready from day one — you are not figuring out what to build

Direct access to decision-makers — no layers of approval or slow communication

A project that is a strong portfolio piece covering ERPNext, AI agents, voice automation, multi-entity accounting, and OBD2 IoT integration

Flexible remote working arrangement — you manage your own schedule within the committed hours

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: |

IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren

title: Digital Marketing & CRM Assistant
description:
Digital Marketing & CRM Assistant

Initial Role Snapshot – Australian Pet Welfare Foundation

Purpose of the role

The Digital Marketing & CRM Assistant will provide day-to-day development, implementation and administration across APWF’s digital fundraising, supporter communications, CRM, website and social media activities.

APWF is currently strengthening its digital fundraising systems and preparing to significantly increase its lead-generation activity. A number of CRM workflows, templates, supporter journeys, donation pages and campaign systems are currently being developed or refined.

The successful candidate will therefore join at an important transition point: helping complete and implement this work over the coming months and then progressively taking responsibility for its ongoing management.

The Business Manager will retain responsibility for strategy, priorities, campaign direction, key messaging and approvals. The Digital Marketing & CRM Assistant will help translate those plans into accurate, functioning campaigns, workflows and systems.

This is primarily a digital implementation, CRM and marketing coordination role, rather than a senior marketing strategy or copywriting position.

Current development phase: next 2–4 months

APWF has engaged an external digital marketing agency to establish a new lead-generation and supporter acquisition program.

At the same time, significant internal work is underway to improve the systems that will support this growth.

Current projects include:

• two petition-based lead-generation campaigns

• landing pages and supporter sign-up forms

• automated
 sequences and supporter journeys

• developing and refining CRM workflows and automations

• improving CRM tagging and segmentation

• reviewing and cleaning inactive and low-engagement contacts from the database

• improving database structure and data integrity

• updating APWF's general online donation experience

• developing more targeted donation pages and journeys for particular audiences and campaigns

• connecting campaign forms, CRM records,
s and donation journeys

• associated social media campaigns

• testing links, forms, automations and supporter journeys

• developing reusable templates

• documenting workflows and processes



These activities are at different stages of development.

The successful candidate will work with the Business Manager and, during the initial period, APWF's external digital agency to help complete, test and implement this work.

Ideally, the candidate will have sufficient previous experience to also make practical suggestions about how templates, workflows, automations, segmentation or processes could be improved.

A key objective is to build strong internal capability so systems established during this development period can subsequently be managed effectively in-house.

Ongoing responsibilities

CRM and supporter journeys

APWF currently has approximately 6,000 contacts and expects this database to grow through new lead-generation activity.

Responsibilities will include:

• maintaining supporter and donor records in Keela

• applying and reviewing campaign, interest and preference tags

• creating and maintaining CRM segments

• managing forms, fields and data capture

• building and updating automated workflows

• helping develop supporter journeys for different audiences

• reviewing contact engagement and database quality

• maintaining consistent CRM structures and naming conventions

• identifying duplicate, inaccurate or incomplete records

• logging supporter and donor interactions

• monitoring data integrity

• identifying opportunities to simplify or automate routine processes

 marketing and campaigns

• Build, format, test and schedule newsletters and fundraising
s.

• Implement campaign sequences and automated
 journeys.

• Create and adapt reusable campaign and newsletter templates.

• Apply appropriate tags and audience segments.

• Check links, forms, personalisation, segmentation and formatting before campaigns are sent.

• Maintain campaign schedules and deadlines.

• Assist with regular newsletters, fundraising appeals, Gifts in Wills campaigns, lead-generation campaigns and other supporter communications.

• Review campaign implementation and identify errors or opportunities for improvement.

Digital fundraising

• Maintain and update fundraising and campaign pages in Raisely.

• Assist with developing donation pages tailored to particular campaigns or supporter audiences.

• Connect forms, donation pages,
 journeys and CRM records.

• Test donation and supporter pathways.

• Update campaign content and assets.

• Troubleshoot broken links, workflow errors or other implementation problems.

• Assist with fundraising administration and donor receipting.

• Work with the Business Manager or external specialists where more complex technical issues require escalation.

Donor and supporter administration

• Update donor and supporter records.

• Respond to routine supporter and donor enquiries.

• Update contact and communication preferences.

• Record interactions accurately in the CRM.

• Assist with routine fundraising administration.

• Escalate sensitive, unusual or higher-level donor matters to the Business Manager.

Website

• Make routine updates to APWF's Framer website.

• Add media coverage, publications, research papers and submissions.

• Update campaign and fundraising information.

• Update links, documents, images and downloadable resources.

• Create or update straightforward pages from supplied content.

• Check website content and links for accuracy.

• Support the connection of website pages with campaign forms and fundraising journeys.

Social media and digital content

• Assist with scheduling approved social media content.

• Upload and update campaign content across relevant channels.

• Adapt supplied copy and assets for different platforms where required.

• Make straightforward edits to Canva templates and existing creative.

• Maintain consistent campaign links and calls to action.

• Assist with Meta Business Suite administration and scheduling.

Systems, documentation and continuous improvement

• Maintain campaign trackers, workplans and deadlines.

• Develop and update procedures, checklists and simple SOPs.

• Organise campaign assets and digital files.

• Document workflows and system configurations.

• Identify recurring problems and suggest practical improvements.

• Look for opportunities to improve efficiency or automate manual processes.

• Test changes before implementation.

• Follow tasks through to completion and communicate progress or issues clearly.

Systems

Core platforms

• Keela CRM

• Raisely

• Framer

• Canva

• Meta Business Suite

• Microsoft 365, including Excel

Useful additional experience

• Zapier or similar integration tools

•
 marketing automation

• CRM integrations

• website CMS platforms

• digital fundraising platforms

• lead-generation campaigns

• online forms and landing pages



Candidate profile

We are looking for someone who is:

• highly organised and accurate

• digitally confident and comfortable learning new systems

• comfortable working across several platforms at the same time

• experienced with CRM data, segmentation and workflows

• able to understand how different parts of a digital campaign connect

• capable of working from a workplan while also using initiative

• able to investigate and solve straightforward technical or workflow problems

• comfortable testing systems and checking their own work

• proactive about identifying errors, gaps or opportunities for improvement

• able to manage several campaigns and deadlines simultaneously

• able to work independently and take ownership of tasks

• confident providing feedback and suggesting better ways of doing things

• comfortable asking questions and escalating issues when appropriate

• professional when handling donor, supporter and organisational information

• interested in animal welfare and evidence-based work





Preferred experience

Approximately 2–4 years' relevant experience across one or more of:

• CRM administration

• digital marketing coordination

•
 marketing

• marketing automation

• digital fundraising

• lead-generation campaigns

• fundraising or not-for-profit marketing

• supporter or donor services

• digital campaign administration

Previous experience helping to build or improve CRM workflows, automated
 journeys, segmentation, templates or digital fundraising processes would be particularly valuable.

Charity or fundraising experience would be highly regarded but is not essential.

Role relationship

The position will report to APWF's Business Manager.

The Business Manager will retain responsibility for strategy, campaign priorities, key content development, messaging, approvals and overall oversight.

The Digital Marketing & CRM Assistant will initially work alongside the Business Manager and external agency to help complete systems currently under development.

Over time, the expectation is that they will take increasing ownership of the routine implementation, testing, administration and maintenance required to keep APWF's digital fundraising and supporter systems running effectively.

title: Purchasing Agent/Procurement Account Representative
description:
Purchasing Agent/Procurement Account Representative 

McKenzie Freight Solutions LLC

Remote | Immediate Start

About McKenzie Freight Solutions

McKenzie Freight Solutions provides procurement, logistics, and supply chain services to independently owned retailers throughout The Bahamas.

We are rapidly deploying an internal operations platform to support our procurement, pricing, warehouse, logistics, finance, and customer management workflows.

This is NOT an eCommerce website.

Our Procurement Account Representatives build customer orders over the phone by pricing the products retailers already purchase every week. The platform supports product pricing, landed costs, quotations, invoicing, supplier purchasing, warehouse coordination, logistics, customer communications, and operational reporting.

We are assembling our founding operations team and are looking for professionals who enjoy building long-term customer relationships while helping independently owned retailers reduce their procurement costs.



Compensation

Launch Sprint: $3.00 USD/hour

Ongoing Operating Rate: $4.00 USD/hour

Procurement Account Representatives who successfully complete the launch period, demonstrate excellent attendance, professionalism, communication, product knowledge, and consistently follow procedures with minimal operational errors will be eligible to transition to the ongoing operating rate following Cycle 1.

Estimated Hours

20–40+ hours during the launch sprint depending on call volume.



Immediate 48-Hour Launch Sprint

Applicants must be available to begin immediately.

We are launching a live wholesale procurement platform serving independently owned retailers throughout The Bahamas.

Training, operating procedures, call scripts, and the procurement platform will be provided before contacting customers.



About the Role

This is NOT a cold calling position.

There is no outbound cold prospecting.

Our Independent Marketing Representatives have already visited retailers in person, verified each business, and introduced McKenzie Freight Solutions.

During those visits, retailers were informed that they would be assigned a dedicated Procurement Account Representative to assist them with pricing, quotations, and their first purchase order.

You will be assigned a portfolio of retailers and will work with the same customers during recurring weekly purchasing cycles.

Your responsibility is not to pressure customers into making a purchase.

Your responsibility is to understand each customer's business, listen carefully to what they need immediately, prepare accurate product quotations, demonstrate potential savings, and build long-term procurement relationships.

You must be highly detail-oriented. Every customer conversation results in the creation of a purchase order, so accuracy in product selection, quantities, package sizes, case packs, and customer information is essential.



Customer Relationship Management

Each Procurement Account Representative will manage an assigned portfolio of retailers.

You are expected to become familiar with your customers and understand:

Their business

Their weekly purchasing patterns

Preferred brands

Value-brand alternatives

Retail package sizes

Foodservice package sizes

Typical order quantities

Frequently purchased products

New product requests

Your goal is to become your customer's trusted procurement representative throughout each weekly purchasing cycle.



Product Knowledge

Applicants should be comfortable learning and discussing products commonly purchased by Caribbean retailers, including:

Grocery

Beverages

Household products

Cleaning supplies

Paper products

Foodservice products

Applicants should understand or be willing to quickly learn:

Retail package sizes versus foodservice package sizes

Case pack configurations

Cases per pallet

Brand-name products

Comparable value-brand alternatives

Training will be provided.



Responsibilities

Contact your assigned retailers by phone and WhatsApp.

Introduce yourself as their dedicated Procurement Account Representative.

Build long-term customer relationships.

Listen carefully to the customer's immediate purchasing needs.

Price-check products the customer already purchases.

Search requested products within the procurement platform.

Compare wholesale pricing with approved suppliers, including Jetro, Costco, Sam's Club, and other available supplier pricing.

Discuss estimated landed costs and potential savings.

Recommend appropriate brand or value-brand alternatives when available.

Accurately build detailed customer purchase orders within the procurement platform.

Verify products, quantities, package sizes, and case pack configurations before issuing quotations and invoices.

Submit Source Item Requests for products not currently available in the Product Universe.

Generate a tentative, non-binding invoice for the products the customer is prepared to purchase during the current purchasing cycle.

Send invoices and secure payment links through WhatsApp.

Schedule follow-up conversations for future purchasing cycles.

Maintain accurate customer notes and purchasing history.



Required Skills

Excellent spoken English.

Professional phone etiquette.

Strong customer service skills.

Excellent communication and listening skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Ability to accurately build customer purchase orders.

Ability to identify and compare products across multiple suppliers.

Typing accuracy.

Basic computer skills.

Reliable internet connection.

Quiet work environment.

USB headset with microphone.

Positive attitude.

Ability to learn product knowledge quickly.

Ability to follow operating procedures accurately.

Sales experience is preferred but not required.



Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

Grocery

Wholesale

Procurement

Retail

Foodservice

Distribution

Customer Service

Call Center

Hospitality

Knowledge of grocery products, wholesale purchasing, foodservice products, and consumer packaged goods (CPG) is a significant advantage.



What We Are Looking For

Applicants must:

Enjoy helping customers solve procurement challenges.

Build long-term customer relationships.

Be dependable and punctual.

Be highly detail-oriented.

Enjoy researching products and identifying the correct items for customers.

Learn quickly.

Develop strong product knowledge.

Understand that accuracy is more important than speed.

Work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Follow procedures accurately.

Represent McKenzie Freight Solutions professionally.

Be available to begin immediately.



How to Apply

Please
 the following to:



Resume

Voice recording (if available)

Customer service or procurement experience

Grocery, wholesale, or foodservice experience (if applicable)

Earliest available start date

Internet speed

Hours available during the launch sprint

Confirmation that you can begin immediately


 Subject:

Procurement Account Representative Application – [Your Name]

Qualified applicants will be contacted for interviews immediately.

We are actively hiring and expect to make offers as soon as qualified candidates are identified.

title: Google Ads Specialist – Australian B2B / Industrial Lead Generation
description:
Safe Lifting Australia is an established Australian industrial crane, lifting and engineering services business based in Western Australia.



We are looking for an experienced Google Ads specialist to work directly with our management team on an ongoing part-time basis.



This is not a general VA, social media or generic digital marketing role. Your primary expertise must be Google Search Ads and lead generation.



What we need



Our objective is not simply to increase clicks or website traffic. We need to generate qualified enquiries from Australian industrial businesses requiring crane and lifting services.



You will initially audit our existing Google Ads campaigns and then help restructure, improve and expand them.



Our target services include:



Overhead crane servicing and repairs

Crane breakdowns

10-year and 25-year major inspections

Crane compliance and third-party inspections

DWP / remaining-life assessments

New and replacement electric hoists

Pneumatic hoists

Explosion-proof / Ex-rated hoists

Crane upgrades and modernisation

Vehicle crane inspections

Other specialist industrial lifting services



Our primary market is Western Australia, including Perth, Kalgoorlie, Karratha, Port Hedland, Geraldton and Bunbury.



We also intend to develop campaigns targeting Darwin and the Northern Territory.



Your responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Auditing our existing Google Ads account

Keyword and competitor research

Building and restructuring Google Search campaigns

Geographic campaign targeting

Search-term analysis

Strong negative-keyword management

Writing and testing advertisements

Bid and budget optimisation

GA4 and Google Tag Manager

Conversion tracking

Tracking phone calls and website enquiries where appropriate

Reviewing landing pages and recommending improvements

Monitoring campaign performance

Providing concise reporting focused on qualified leads and cost per qualified lead, rather than vanity metrics



We want someone who actively manages campaigns rather than simply accepting Google's automated recommendations.



Experience we're looking for



Ideally you will have:



Strong hands-on Google Search Ads experience

Experience generating leads for B2B or service businesses

Experience with Australian clients is highly desirable

Strong GA4/GTM and conversion-tracking knowledge

Excellent written English

Good analytical skills

Experience managing meaningful Google Ads budgets

Ability to explain your decisions clearly to management



Experience with industrial, engineering, mining, construction, trades or other high-value B2B services would be particularly valuable.



Hours



We expect approximately 8 hours per week ongoing once campaigns are established.



During the first 2–4 weeks, additional paid hours (by agreement) may be available to properly audit the existing account, restructure campaigns, establish tracking and build new campaigns.



This is intended to be a long-term relationship with the right person.



When applying



Please include:



How many years you have personally managed Google Ads.

Examples of 2–3 lead-generation campaigns you have managed, including industry, approximate monthly ad spend and results.

Whether you have managed Google Ads for Australian businesses.

Your experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.

Your normal hourly rate.

Your current weekly availability.



Small practical question:



Imagine you are advertising an Australian company that services and inspects overhead industrial cranes.



Please provide:



10 keywords you would consider targeting;

10 negative keywords you would consider using; and

a short explanation of how you would structure the initial Google Ads campaigns.



We are not looking for a long report. A short answer demonstrating how you think about search intent is sufficient.



Please start your application with the words "INDUSTRIAL PPC" so we know you have read the entire job advertisement.

title: Lead Generation & Appointment Setting VA — U.S. Cleaning Company
description:
About Us



Sanctuary Premier Services is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company serving Maryland, Washington, DC, and the surrounding DMV area.



We’re looking for an experienced Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Virtual Assistant who knows how to FIND opportunities—not just wait for leads to come in.



Our ideal candidate is proactive, organized, confident communicating with U.S.-based prospects, and experienced generating leads for a cleaning company, home-service business, property-service company, or similar local business.



This is NOT primarily an administrative VA position. Your main goal is to help us generate qualified opportunities and turn those opportunities into booked cleaning services.



What You’ll Do



Residential Lead Generation



* Find people actively looking for residential cleaners in our service areas

* Identify opportunities through
 groups and other online/community platforms

* Respond to and follow up with existing leads

* Qualify prospects based on location, home size, service needed, frequency, and timeline

* Direct qualified prospects to our online booking system

* Follow up with prospects who received information but haven’t booked



Commercial Lead Generation



* Research property managers, realtors, Airbnb/short-term rental operators, offices, medical practices, churches, apartment communities, and other commercial prospects

* Identify decision-makers and accurate contact information

* Conduct cold outreach via
, phone, LinkedIn, and other approved channels

* Follow up consistently

* Schedule qualified calls/walkthroughs with ownership



Lead Management



* Maintain an organized lead tracker/CRM

* Document every contact attempt and follow-up

* Track leads through stages:

    New ? Contacted ? Qualified ? Quote/Appointment ? Follow-Up ? Booked/Lost

* Provide a weekly KPI report showing outreach, responses, qualified leads, appointments, bookings, and results



Who We’re Looking For



You MUST have:



* Previous lead-generation and/or appointment-setting experience

* Excellent written AND spoken English

* Experience conducting cold outreach

* Strong follow-up skills

* Experience working with a CRM or lead-tracking system

* Reliable high-speed internet

* A reliable computer and quiet environment for calls

* Ability to work independently without being constantly supervised



Strongly preferred:



* Previous experience with a U.S. cleaning company

* Home-services lead generation experience

* Commercial cleaning prospecting experience

* Experience communicating with property managers/realtors

* Cold-calling experience

* Google Workspace experience

* 
/community lead generation

* LinkedIn prospecting

* Familiarity with BookingKoala or similar booking software



What Success Looks Like



We’re NOT measuring success by how many names you copy into a spreadsheet.



We care about:



* Qualified leads generated

* Conversations started

* Appointments/walkthroughs booked

* Follow-ups completed

* Residential bookings

* Recurring clients acquired

* Commercial opportunities created

* Revenue generated from your pipeline



Quality matters more than meaningless activity.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience



10–15 hours/week initially



There will be opportunities for increased hours and performance-based bonuses as the company grows and you demonstrate results.



This position may grow into a larger sales/lead-management role for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Please begin your application with the exact phrase:



“Sanctuary Gives Time Back.”



Applications that do not begin with this phrase will not be considered.



Please include:



1. Your resume.

2. A 60–90 second video or voice introduction. Tell us about yourself and your lead-generation experience.

3. Tell us specifically whether you’ve worked for a cleaning company, home-service business, property-management company, or similar U.S. business.

4. What lead-generation channels have you personally used?

5. Approximately how many qualified leads or appointments did you generate in your most successful previous role?

6. What CRM systems have you used?

7. Are you comfortable making outbound phone calls to U.S. prospects?

8. Tell us about one lead that required multiple follow-ups before converting.

9. What is your desired hourly rate?

10. How many hours per week are you currently available?



IMPORTANT: Do not send us a generic AI-generated cover letter. We’re much more interested in your actual experience, communication skills, and results.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow WITH the company—not simply complete tasks.



If you’re proactive, persistent, professional, and genuinely good at finding opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.
salary: $6-8 per Hour, up to $480 per month
