title: In-House SEO Strategist — Local + AI Search for a US Cleaning Brand
description:
Read every word. There's a challenge near the bottom that d
 whether we ever talk. Skim it and you're already out — an SEO who doesn't read carefully isn't an SEO we want.



We're Greater Phoenix Cleaning. We clean homes and businesses across Phoenix, Arizona, and we're building this into a multi-seven-figure company with locations opening across the United States. We already know how to sell and how to clean. Now we're going all-in on owning search — traditional AND AI — and we want one person to own it completely.



This is not a "post a few blogs and tweak title tags" job. This is the keys to our entire organic growth engine.



THE MISSION

Take Greater Phoenix Cleaning to 300+ inbound organic leads per month. Dominate the Google Map Pack in every ZIP code we serve, go deeper neighborhood by neighborhood for our ideal customer, and make us the business that shows up whether someone types it into Google, says it into Maps, or asks an AI assistant "who's the best cleaner near me." Then hand us the repeatable playbook to do it again in every city we open. You'll be honest that this is a 12–18 month compounding build, not a magic switch — and then you'll go build it.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The best of the best. An SEO nerd in the best possible way — someone who lives, eats, sleeps, and breathes search. The profile:

- 10+ years in SEO, and it's the ONLY thing you do. Not "SEO + web design + ads." Pure SEO obsession.

- Deep expertise across Local SEO, GEO / location-based SEO, AI Search Optimization (AEO/GEO), and Google Business Profile optimization.

- You've ranked local service businesses to the top of the map pack and page one, with proven, measurable growth in rankings, organic traffic, leads, and engagement. Cleaning companies = ideal. Home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, pest, landscaping, roofing) = strong. Everyone else with real proof = welcome.

- You're on the bleeding edge of AI search RIGHT NOW — Google AI Overviews, answer engines, LLM/generative search — and you already optimize for AI-generated results, not just the ten blue links.

- You go to SEO masterminds. You have (or had) an SEO mentor. You sharpen constantly — because whoever stopped learning in 2022 is already obsolete.

- Happy, hungry, humble, sharp. Good energy. Coachable ego. Zero laziness — anywhere.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Full SEO audits of our website, technical health, and entire local presence.

- Keyword and competitor research — local, long-tail, and neighborhood-level.

- On-page and technical SEO: site structure, content optimization, schema markup, page speed, internal linking.

- Local ranking signals: Google Business Profile optimization, business listings and citation management, NAP consistency, and review velocity strategy.

- GEO / location-based SEO: unique, genuinely valuable service-area and neighborhood landing pages across every ZIP we serve.

- AI Search Optimization / Answer Engine Optimization: optimize our content and entities so we surface in AI Overviews, generative results, and AI assistant answers.

- A relentless content engine — blogs and pages that are actually valuable, never thin junk.

- Real reporting. We keep score here: leads, rankings, traffic, engagement — not vanity metrics.

- The repeatable system we roll out to every new city.



WHY THIS BEATS AGENCY LIFE

We're anti-corporate. No clients to juggle, no account managers watering down your work, no politics. ONE brand, your full focus, real budget, and a team that actually ships what you recommend — fast. You'll work directly with the owner. Perform, and you help architect the SEO engine for a national franchise. We build leaders here, and we pay for results.



THE PAY

Base of $1,500/month, plus a performance bonus tied directly to the results you create:

- +$250/month once we sustain 100+ organic leads/month

- +$500/month once we sustain 200+ organic leads/month

- +$1,000/month once we sustain 300+ organic leads/month (the mission)

That's up to $2,500+/month total for hitting the target you were hired to hit — and for someone who proves they're truly elite, we'll go higher. We pay for results here, not for logging hours.



THE HONEST PART

We're demanding and we move fast. We'll give you resources and get out of your way — and in return we expect ownership, honesty about timelines, and relentless execution. If you want to coast, we're not it. If you want one brand you can take to the absolute top and point to for the rest of your career — welcome home.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the real test — most SEOs will fail it, and that's the point)



We're hiring an expert, so prove you're one. Generic copy-paste proposals get deleted unread. Do all of this:



1. Start your message with the word PAGEONE in all caps. No PAGEONE, no reply — we'll know you skimmed. (First test: passed or failed.)



2. Go look at our website (
) and our Google Business Profile. In 5–8 sentences, tell us the single biggest thing you'd fix in your first 30 days to move our map pack rankings — and WHY. Be specific. This is what separates the real ones from the fakers.



3. Show us proof. Send at least one business you personally ranked — the URL, the keyword(s), and the before/after (screenshots, Ahrefs/SEMrush data, or a case study link). Cleaning or home-service examples move to the top of our pile.



4. Tell us your exact SEO stack (the tools you use) and one specific way you're optimizing for AI search / answer engines in 2026 that most people aren't.



5. Tell us the last SEO mastermind, course, mentor, or community you were part of — and one thing it changed about how you work.



Do all five and you're ahead of 95% of applicants. We read every application that starts with PAGEONE.



Let's take this brand to the top.



— The Greater Phoenix Cleaning Team

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: AI-Native Web Builder for Quiz Funnels (Consumer Subscription Apps) — Conversion-Obsessed
description:
ABOUT US

We're an AI-first venture studio building a portfolio of consumer subscription wellness apps — weight loss, GLP-1, menopause, walking, yoga. We move fast and we build everything with AI.



WHAT WE'RE HIRING FOR — READ THIS CAREFULLY

We build "web2app" quiz funnels: the exact style used by BetterMe (Genesis), Noom, Simple, and Welltech (WalkFit, Yoga-Go). If you don't know these apps, go look at them on your phone before you apply.



Here is the model:

Paid ad (Meta/TikTok) ? a long, personalized quiz of 30-50 steps ? a "here's your personalized plan" reveal ? a paywall where the user pays ON THE WEB (Stripe/Paddle) ? then they download the app with the subscription already active.



The quiz is not filler. Every question is a micro-commitment, and the answers feed a personalized result that makes the person feel the plan was built specifically for them. The whole thing is a conversion machine built on psychology: micro-commitments, personalization, social proof, loss aversion, sunk cost, and "processing theater" loading screens ("calculating your plan...").



THIS IS NOT B2B SAAS FUNNELS

Please do NOT apply if your experience is B2B SaaS lead-gen — book-a-demo funnels, MQLs, lead magnets, HubSpot/GoHighLevel booking flows, ClickFunnels webinar funnels. That is a completely different craft. This is consumer, direct-to-subscriber, long-form quiz-to-paywall. We get a lot of SaaS-funnel applicants and they are not a fit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build long-form quiz funnels (30-50+ steps) end-to-end, using AI to do the heavy lifting

- Build the branching logic, the personalized result/reveal screens, and the three-tier paywall (1 / 3 / 12 month) with a post-purchase upsell

- Wire up the tracking: Meta CAPI + TikTok server-side events, UTM pass-through, deep links, and step-level drop-off analytics

- A/B test and iterate relentlessly — we optimize on conversion, not opinions



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is one role: an AI-native builder who can produce the entire web funnel with AI. We care about two things above all:



1. AI-NATIVE / VIBE CODER. You build web things by directing AI — Claude, Claude Cowork, and tools like Base44, Lovable, Cursor. You do NOT need to be a senior engineer. You need to be able to make AI build a real, working, well-designed funnel and know when the result is right. If you still hand-code everything from scratch and don't use AI, you're not who we're looking for.



2. CONVERSION. You can look at a funnel and explain WHY it converts or exactly where it leaks. You obsess over the small details that move the number. This is non-negotiable.



You do NOT need to have built a web2app funnel before. If you have — show us. If you haven't but you're AI-heavy and you understand conversion — apply.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY (applications that skip steps get deleted)

Start your message with the word: COPPER



Then answer these three:



1. Which AI tools do you build web projects with (e.g. Claude, Claude Cowork, Base44, Lovable, Cursor)? Send me ONE live link to something you built mostly with AI, and tell me roughly how much of it was AI vs. you hand-coding.



2. Go spend 5 minutes inside the BetterMe or Simple quiz funnel on your phone. Tell me ONE thing you would change to increase conversion, and why.



3. In 3-4 sentences: how would you approach building a 40-step weight-loss quiz funnel end-to-end with AI — which tools, in what order, and how would you handle the paywall and tracking?

Pay is performance-based — strong performers earn more as the brand scales

To apply: send your resume, a portfolio with results/data, and include the secret word "MONEY" at the top of your application so I know you read this fully



If every winning ad shouldn't have to come from the founder, and you want to be the person who changes that — apply.



Mini-task (do this to stand out):



Pick one ad from a competitor dog supplement brand — Dog Is Human, Zesty Paws, or any DTC pet supplement running on Meta — and give me a quick teardown. Keep it short (5–8 bullets or a few short paragraphs). I want to see:



The hook — what's the first 3 seconds doing, and why does it stop the scroll?

The angle — what desire or problem is it targeting? Who's the avatar?

The mechanism — how does the ad explain why the product works?

What's working — what would you steal?

What's weak — what would you test differently or do better?



Don't overthink the format. I'm not looking for a polished deck — I'm looking for how you think, whether you actually watched the ad closely, and whether you can turn research into an angle. This is the exact work you'd be doing day one.



Bonus points if you pull a real customer quote from Reddit, an Amazon review, or a YouTube comment and show how you'd turn it into a hook.

title: Full-Time Remote WordPress Web Developer & Social Media Manager
description:
Synera Practice Solutions, Inc. is seeking an experienced WordPress Web Developer and Social Media Manager based in the Philippines to manage the online presence of several affiliated companies.



Our companies operate in healthcare, business services, logistics, retail, and consumer products. We need a dependable professional who can maintain and improve multiple websites, manage our social media pages, create digital content, and keep each company’s online presence professional and active.



This is a fully remote position. No travel or on-site work is required. Our U.S.-based team will provide the photographs, videos, company information, and other materials needed to complete assignments.



Mandatory WordPress and SiteGround Experience



This is not an entry-level WordPress position. Applicants must already have professional, hands-on experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting live WordPress websites.



The selected contractor must have:



At least two years of professional WordPress experience.

Strong working experience with WordPress and Elementor.

Experience managing multiple live WordPress websites.

Existing experience using SiteGround web hosting.

Experience working inside SiteGround Site Tools.

Experience creating and restoring SiteGround backups.

Experience using SiteGround staging environments.

Experience managing domains, DNS records, SSL certificates,
 accounts, and website files through SiteGround.

Experience with SiteGround caching, performance tools, and the Speed Optimizer plugin.

Experience migrating WordPress websites to or from SiteGround.

Experience troubleshooting plugin conflicts, broken pages, form failures,
-delivery problems, hosting issues, and website errors.

Basic working knowledge of HTML and CSS.



Applicants who have only used website templates without managing the technical side of WordPress and SiteGround may not be considered.



Primary Responsibilities

WordPress Website Development and Management

Build, redesign, maintain, and improve company websites using WordPress and Elementor.

Manage our websites through SiteGround hosting.

Create service pages, landing pages, promotional pages, recruiting pages, contact forms, and lead-generation funnels.

Update company services, staff information, hours, images, videos, contact information, and announcements.

Keep every company website current, functional, and professionally presented.

Improve website speed, mobile responsiveness, navigation, and user experience.

Manage WordPress themes, plugins, updates, backups, security, and user access.

Manage domains, DNS records, SSL certificates, staging websites, website files, and
 settings through SiteGround.

Create and test website backups before completing major changes.

Troubleshoot broken pages, website errors, forms, plugins,
 notifications, integrations, and other technical issues.

Connect websites with scheduling systems, customer relationship management platforms,
 marketing software, payment platforms, and other business tools.

Make HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or basic PHP adjustments when necessary.

Maintain a separate and consistent visual identity for each company.

Perform basic on-page SEO, including page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, keywords, and image optimization.

Monitor website traffic, contact-form submissions, and lead activity.

Recommend website improvements that may increase calls, appointments, sales, and customer inquiries.

Social Media Management

Manage assigned Instagram,
, LinkedIn, TikTok, Google Business Profile, and other social media accounts.

Develop a separate social media strategy for each company.

Create and maintain monthly content calendars.

Write professional captions, educational posts, promotional announcements, company updates, recruiting posts, and calls to action.

Design original graphics, flyers, carousels, stories, advertisements, and promotional materials.

Edit company-provided footage into reels, short-form videos, interviews, service demonstrations, and behind-the-scenes content.

Schedule and publish approved content consistently.

Monitor comments, messages, reviews, and customer inquiries.

Forward important inquiries to the appropriate U.S.-based team member.

Maintain the correct tone, audience, and brand identity for each company.

Track reach, engagement, website traffic, leads, and campaign performance.

Provide clear monthly website and social media performance reports.

Branding and Digital Marketing Support

Create and maintain brand guidelines for each company.

Organize logos, graphics, photographs, videos, website files, and digital assets.

Create digital advertisements,
 graphics, brochures, presentations, recruiting materials, and promotional campaigns.

Support company launches, new services, hiring campaigns, events, and seasonal promotions.

Regularly review websites and social media accounts for outdated or incorrect information.

Recommend new content ideas, campaigns, website improvements, and marketing opportunities.

Maintain an organized list of pending requests, approvals, deadlines, and completed assignments.

Required Qualifications

At least two years of professional WordPress development and website-management experience.

Demonstrated experience managing WordPress websites hosted through SiteGround.

Strong experience with Elementor.

A portfolio containing live WordPress websites you personally built, redesigned, or managed.

Experience managing multiple websites or brands simultaneously.

Experience with SiteGround Site Tools, backups, staging, DNS, SSL,
, caching, and website migration.

Understanding of website security, performance optimization, hosting, domains, and troubleshooting.

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.

Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar software.

Experience managing business social media accounts.

Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools.

Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile.

Understanding of basic SEO and local search optimization.

Strong written English.

Strong visual judgment and attention to detail.

Ability to manage several assignments and meet deadlines.

Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

Ability to follow brand guidelines and complete revisions promptly.

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Backup internet access.

A dependable computer capable of website development, graphic design, and video editing.

A quiet and professional remote work environment.

Ability to securely handle passwords, account access, internal documents, and confidential company information.



A college degree is not required. Your portfolio, technical ability, WordPress experience, SiteGround knowledge, communication, creativity, organization, and reliability are more important.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following areas is helpful:



Healthcare or medical marketing

Local SEO and lead generation

Multi-location businesses

E-commerce websites

Paid social media advertising

 marketing and automation

Short-form video editing

Recruiting and employment marketing

Regulated industries

Website accessibility and compliance

HIPAA-aware healthcare marketing practices

Managing U.S.-based clients from the Philippines

Work Schedule and Communication



This is a full-time remote position requiring approximately 40 hours per week.



The selected contractor must:



Be available during agreed working hours that overlap with U.S. Central Time.

Attend scheduled video meetings when required.

Respond to routine communications during the same business day.

Communicate immediately when a website, hosting account, social media account, or campaign has a serious issue.

Provide regular progress updates.

Use our approved project-management or task-tracking system.

Submit content for review before publishing when approval is required.

Clearly communicate delays, missing information, technical problems, or access issues.

Maintain accurate records of completed website and social media work.



Some evening or overnight working hours in the Philippines may be required because of the time difference.



First 30-Day Responsibilities



During the first 30 days, the selected contractor will be expected to:



Review all existing WordPress websites.

Review each website’s SiteGround hosting configuration.

Confirm that backups, SSL certificates, security tools, staging environments, and performance settings are properly configured.

Review installed themes and plugins.

Identify unnecessary, outdated, or conflicting plugins.

Test all contact forms and
 notifications.

Review website speed, mobile responsiveness, security, and overall functionality.

Review all assigned social media accounts.

Identify broken links, outdated information, missing pages, inactive accounts, and branding inconsistencies.

Organize website logins, SiteGround access, domains, social media access, and digital assets.

Prepare a prioritized list of recommended improvements.

Develop a 30-day website and social media action plan.

Create an initial content calendar for each company.

Establish a tracking system for requests, approvals, deadlines, and completed work.

Ownership, Security, and Confidentiality



The selected contractor must agree to:



Keep company information, passwords, website credentials, customer information, and internal business information confidential.

Use secure methods for storing and accessing company credentials.

Use two-factor authentication when available.

Never share company access with another person without written authorization.

Create backups before completing significant website changes.

Avoid making major changes directly to a live website when a staging environment should be used.

Return all company information and account access upon request.

Provide editable source files for graphics, videos, and other completed work.

Confirm that completed and paid work belongs to the applicable company.

Use only properly licensed images, graphics, videos, music, fonts, templates, and other materials.

Avoid displaying company work, confidential information, or customer information in a public portfolio without written permission.

Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio quality, WordPress expertise, SiteGround experience, technical ability, and the final scope of responsibilities.



Applicants must provide:



Their expected monthly compensation in Philippine pesos or U.S. dollars.

Any software or subscription expenses they expect the company to provide.

Their earliest available start date.



We are looking for a long-term contractor who will be dedicated to our group of companies, not someone seeking occasional freelance projects.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your résumé.

A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience.

A portfolio containing live WordPress websites you personally built, redesigned, or currently manage.

An explanation of exactly what you completed on each website.

A description of your experience using SiteGround.

Examples of SiteGround tasks you have personally completed.

Links to business social media pages you currently manage or previously managed.

Examples of graphics, advertisements, reels, videos, landing pages, or campaigns you created.

Your expected monthly compensation.

Your available working hours in Philippine Time.

Your available working hours in U.S. Central Time.

Your internet speed and backup internet plan.

Your computer specifications.

Your earliest available start date.

Two professional references or client testimonials, when available.



To confirm that you carefully reviewed the entire posting, begin your application with:



“WordPress + SiteGround”



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you professionally worked with WordPress and Elementor?



2. Describe your experience using SiteGround Site Tools, staging websites, backups, DNS records, SSL certificates, caching,
 settings, and website migration.



3. Provide links to at least three WordPress websites you personally built or currently manage. Explain exactly what you completed on each website.



4. How would you organize several company websites and social media accounts without allowing any brand to become neglected, outdated, or inconsistent?



5. What would you complete during your first 30 days in this position?



6. What steps do you take to protect client passwords, website access, files, and confidential business information while working remotely?



Applications without demonstrated WordPress experience, SiteGround experience, a portfolio, compensation expectations, and answers to the required questions may not be considered.



Contractor Relationship



This is a fully remote outsourced contractor position. The selected contractor will be responsible for maintaining their own work location, computer, internet service, backup internet access, taxes, and ordinary working equipment unless otherwise agreed in writing.

title: # Experienced Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Operations VA ONLY APPLY
description:
# Experienced Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Operations VA



We are looking for an **Experienced Credit Repair Specialist / Credit Operations VA** to support the credit repair and credit education side of our business.



This is **not a general VA role**. I need someone who already has hands-on credit repair experience and can bring immediate value.



## Important Requirement



You must have at least **1 year of real credit repair experience**.



If you do not have at least 1 year of credit repair experience, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who reads carefully, follows detailed instructions, asks smart questions, and can work with minimal hand-holding once the workflow is explained.



## About the Business



You may see a few business names:



* **TABB Enterprises** = overall LLC

* **Vantage One Solutions** = umbrella business brand

* **Ground Zero Credit** = credit education, credit repair, and Skool community brand



Most of your work will support **Ground Zero Credit**.



## Main Responsibilities



You will help with:



* Credit Repair Cloud / CRC client setup

* Client onboarding

* Document checklist review

* Credit report organization

* Credit report analysis

* Dispute workflow support

* Bureau response tracking

* Furnisher response tracking

* CFPB / FTC complaint support when appropriate

* Client notes and update summaries

* SOPs, checklists, and workflow documentation

* Basic Skool/community support later if needed



## Credit Repair Experience Needed



You should already understand how to review credit reports and identify issues such as:



* Inquiries

* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Late payments

* Repossessions

* Bankruptcies

* Duplicate accounts

* Bureau differences

* Date inconsistencies

* Balance inconsistencies

* Personal information issues



I need someone who can look at a file and explain what stands out, what documents are needed, what should be reviewed first, what should not be disputed, and what the next step should be.



## Tools / Skills Preferred



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Credit Repair Cloud

* DisputeFox

* Credit Dispute Manager

* Metro 2 basics

* FCRA basics

* FDCPA basics

* CFPB complaints

* FTC identity theft reports

* Bureau disputes

* Furnisher/direct disputes

* Google Drive / Google Docs

* SOP creation



## Very Important



We do **not** make up fake claims, fake FTC reports, fake identity theft reports, or unsupported disputes.



Everything must be based on real facts, real documents, actual reporting issues, or a legitimate consumer concern.



## Schedule



This role starts part-time:



**5 to 10 hours per week**

    $5.00 per hour



Hours may increase if the fit is strong.



## Paid Trial Assignment



Before moving forward, you may be asked to complete a small paid mock credit report review.



You will be asked to explain:



* What you notice

* What issues you find

* What documents are needed

* What questions you would ask the client

* What you would do first

* What should be escalated to Brian

* What should not be disputed

* Suggested next steps



This is to see how you think and whether you can bring immediate value.



## How to Apply



To show that you read this full post, start your application with:



**GROUND ZERO CREDIT - I READ THE FULL POST**



If your application does not start with that exact phrase, it will not be reviewed.



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years of credit repair experience do you have?

2. What credit repair software have you used?

3. Have you used Credit Repair Cloud? If yes, what tasks did you perform?

4. Have you reviewed full credit reports before?

5. What types of accounts have you worked with? Collections, charge-offs, repos, bankruptcies, inquiries, late payments?

6. Have you prepared bureau disputes, furnisher disputes, CFPB complaints, or FTC reports?

7. How would you organize a new client file before preparing disputes?

8. Are you comfortable completing a paid mock credit report review?

9. What is your hourly rate?

10. How many hours per week are you available?



Please be specific. Generic applications will not be considered.



I am looking for someone who can follow instructions, think through credit files, and help build a clean credit operations system from the ground up.

title: Full-Time Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter
description:
# Full-Time Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter



**Company:** Unity Staffing Services, LLC

**Location:** Remote

**Schedule:** Full-time

**Reports to:** Founder/Lead Recruiter



## About Unity Staffing Services



Unity Staffing Services, LLC is a recruiting firm specializing in connecting qualified professionals with career opportunities, with a strong focus on engineering and technical positions. We are seeking a dependable, organized, and results-driven Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter to support our candidate sourcing and screening efforts.



## Position Summary



The Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter will be responsible for finding qualified candidates for assigned job openings, conducting structured prescreening interviews using questions provided by Unity Staffing Services, and scheduling qualified candidates for a follow-up call with the Lead Recruiter.



The ideal candidate understands how to search for passive and active candidates, review resumes carefully, communicate professionally, and follow a defined recruiting process. This person must be comfortable working independently, managing multiple open positions, and maintaining accurate candidate records.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Candidate Sourcing



* Source candidates for engineering, technical, and other assigned positions.

* Search for candidates using LinkedIn, job boards, resume databases, social media, professional organizations, referrals, and other approved sourcing channels.

* Create and use Boolean search strings based on each position’s requirements.

* Review job descriptions and candidate resumes to identify potential matches.

* Evaluate candidates against the required education, experience, certifications, technical skills, location, compensation, and other must-have qualifications.

* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for active and future positions.

* Avoid submitting candidates who do not meet the stated minimum requirements.



### Candidate Outreach



* Contact prospective candidates using approved
, LinkedIn, phone, and text-message templates.

* Clearly explain the general opportunity and determine the candidate’s initial interest.

* Follow up with candidates according to the company’s outreach process.

* Respond to candidate inquiries professionally and promptly.

* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the initial recruiting process.



### Candidate Prescreening



* Conduct phone or video prescreening interviews using questions provided by the Lead Recruiter.

* Ask every required screening question and document the candidate’s complete responses.

* Confirm the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, work authorization, location, availability, compensation expectations, and interest in the opportunity.

* Ask appropriate follow-up questions when a response is unclear, without changing or skipping the required screening process.

* Identify potential concerns, inconsistencies, employment gaps, or missing qualifications.

* Provide an accurate screening summary without exaggerating or changing the candidate’s answers.

* Refer candidates who meet the established requirements to the Lead Recruiter for further evaluation.



### Scheduling and Follow-Up



* Schedule qualified candidates for a call with the Lead Recruiter using the company’s approved scheduling process.

* Send scheduling links, confirmations, and appointment reminders.

* Confirm that candidates have received the necessary information before their calls.

* Follow up with candidates who have not scheduled or who miss an appointment.

* Notify the Lead Recruiter promptly of cancellations, rescheduling requests, or important candidate concerns.



### Recruiting System and Recordkeeping



* Enter and update candidate information in Zoho Recruit or the company’s designated applicant tracking system.

* Upload resumes and maintain complete, organized candidate profiles.

* Record sourcing activity, outreach attempts, screening notes, candidate responses, and scheduled appointments.

* Move candidates through the correct recruiting stages.

* Protect confidential candidate, client, and company information.

* Provide regular reports on sourcing activity, screens completed, qualified candidates, and scheduled calls.



## Required Qualifications



* Previous experience in recruiting, candidate sourcing, talent acquisition, or a related role.

* Experience finding candidates through LinkedIn and online job boards.

* Ability to review resumes and compare candidate experience with job requirements.

* Experience conducting candidate prescreens or phone interviews.

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions, scripts, screening questions, and recruiting procedures.

* Ability to manage multiple job openings and candidate pipelines simultaneously.

* Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional remote work environment.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle candidate information responsibly.

* Comfortable using applicant tracking systems, spreadsheets,
, video conferencing, and scheduling software.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience sourcing engineering, manufacturing, construction, power, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, or other technical professionals.

* Experience using Zoho Recruit or another applicant tracking system.

* Experience creating Boolean search strings.

* Experience sourcing passive candidates on LinkedIn.

* Familiarity with technical job descriptions, professional licenses, and engineering terminology.



## Performance Expectations



The Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter will be evaluated based on:



* Number of qualified candidates sourced

* Quality and accuracy of candidate matches

* Number of completed prescreening interviews

* Number of qualified candidates scheduled with the Lead Recruiter

* Accuracy and completeness of screening notes

* Candidate response and follow-up times

* Attendance rate for scheduled candidate calls

* Accuracy of applicant tracking system records

* Consistent compliance with the company’s sourcing and screening procedures



Activity goals may vary by position based on the difficulty of the search and candidate availability.



## Important Role Boundaries



The Recruiting Sourcer/Recruiter will identify, contact, and prescreen candidates using company-provided requirements and questions. The Lead Recruiter will make final qualification decisions, conduct the next-stage interview, approve candidate submissions, communicate with clients, and manage offers or negotiations unless otherwise authorized.



The Sourcer/Recruiter must not submit candidates to clients, promise interviews or employment, negotiate compensation, or make commitments on behalf of Unity Staffing Services without authorization.



## Ideal Candidate



You may be a strong fit for this position if you are:



* Persistent and resourceful when searching for difficult-to-find candidates

* Comfortable making calls and speaking with candidates

* Detail-oriented when reviewing resumes and recording screening answers

* Able to distinguish required qualifications from preferred qualifications

* Consistent with follow-up and scheduling

* Coachable and willing to learn technical and engineering terminology

* Professional, dependable, and able to work independently

* Focused on candidate quality rather than simply producing a high number of resumes



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief response addressing the following:



1. How many years of recruiting or candidate-sourcing experience do you have?

2. What types of positions have you sourced for?

3. Which sourcing platforms and applicant tracking systems have you used?

4. Describe your experience conducting candidate prescreening interviews.

5. Provide an example of a difficult position you successfully sourced for.

6. Are you comfortable making candidate calls and following a structured screening questionnaire?

7. What is your availability to begin working full-time?

8. What are your compensation expectations?



Selected applicants may be asked to complete a short paid sourcing exercise to demonstrate their resume-review, Boolean-search, and candidate-matching skills.

description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Role



SALARY

Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is a long-term leadership role. You are not here to answer questions. You are here to ensure clients stay, progress, and succeed. You own retention, stability, and client momentum.



Client retention outcomes are directly linked to your performance reviews and income growth.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company serving 4,000+ clients since 2019.



We sell an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system helping creators go viral and generate income using short-form content and AI tools.



Most clients are 45+ beginners. They are motivated but often overwhelmed. They need clarity, structure, accountability, and calm leadership.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 7.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

- You can work your hours in one block or split them, as long as you consistently meet the job requirements.

- You will serve clients during your assigned 7.5-hour shift within our main coverage window (8am ET–2am ET)

- Must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET).



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage 40–50 clients after ramp-up (with systems and internal support in place).

- Run structured kickoff calls.

- Set clear expectations from day one.

- Own the client relationship end-to-end.

- Prevent churn and refund requests.

- Identify frustration early and de-escalate calmly.

- Handle difficult conversations professionally.

- Hold clients accountable to next steps.

- Follow up when clients go quiet.

- Ensure clients always know what to do next and why it matters.

- Respond within 24 hours (weekdays).

- Track progress clearly in CRM.

- Lead renewal conversations.

- Identify upsell opportunities when appropriate.

- Collect testimonials and referrals.

- Clients should never feel lost. You are responsible for clarity and momentum.



Preventable churn caused by communication gaps, missed follow-ups, or expectation mismanagement reflects on CSM performance. You are not responsible for factors outside your control.



HOW YOU WIN



- Clients stay in the program.

- Renewals remain strong.

- Refunds are rare.

- Clients feel clear and stable.

- Difficult situations are handled calmly.



REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with very clear pronunciation for U.S.-based clients.

- Confident on Zoom.

- Strong emotional intelligence.

- Calm under pressure.

- High ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations.

- Proactive and organized.

- Reliable internet and professional home setup.

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success or Account Management

- High-ticket program

- Knowledge of social media monetization.

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.).



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here: 
/to/Su5De9Qc



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 50 wpm minimum (65+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a 
nt to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 50 wp
ans you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

title: GoHighLevel Systems Specialist | Workflows, AI Agents & Agency Admin | Full-Time Remote | US Eastern Hours
description:
Be the technical engine behind a growing sales and marketing agency. Legacy Sales Engineering is hiring an experienced GoHighLevel Systems Specialist to own our GHL platform end to end: building custom workflows, deploying AI agents, setting up sub-accounts, and running the agency administration that keeps every client system humming.



This is a full-time, long-term seat for someone who already knows GoHighLevel deeply and wants a stable home to put that skill to work.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Build and maintain custom automation workflows with clean conditional logic: if/then branches, wait steps, goal events, and trigger logic that holds up under real volume.



Deploy and configure GHL AI agents: Conversation AI for multi-channel chat, Voice AI for calls, and Workflow AI actions inside automations. Set personas, knowledge bases, objectives, and escalation rules.



Set up and manage sub-accounts and reusable snapshots so new clients can be launched quickly and consistently.



Handle full agency administration: user and permission management, calendars, pipelines, forms and surveys, funnels,
 and SMS setup, reputation and review automation, and integrations.



Connect third-party tools through Make, Zapier, webhooks, and APIs when a native integration does not exist.



Document your builds with clear Loom walkthroughs so any system can be understood and handed off cleanly.



WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



Proven, hands-on GoHighLevel experience in live agency or multi-client environments. This is not an entry-level role and we will test for it.



A real command of the workflow builder, sub-account and snapshot architecture, and the current GHL AI stack.



Experience with integrations: Make or Zapier, webhooks, and basic API concepts.



The ability to translate a business process into a reliable automation without a step-by-step spec.



Strong written and spoken English, since you will document systems and communicate with our team directly.



A GoHighLevel certification is a strong plus. Real proven builds matter more, and you will show them.



THE SCHEDULE AND SETUP



This is a full-time, 40 hour per week salaried position, Monday through Friday, working US Eastern time hours. You will need a reliable computer, strong high-speed internet, and reliable power.



COMPENSATION



Salaried at 200 US dollars per week  for full-time, 40 hours per week. Paid weekly. This is a stable, long-term role with room to grow as the agency grows.



HOW WE HIRE



After a short screening chat, every serious candidate completes a paid hands-on skills test: you will build a real workflow and an AI agent in a GHL sub-account and walk us through it on a Loom. It takes about two hours and it is the fastest way for a real specialist to stand out from the crowd.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short note telling us your GoHighLevel experience, a link to any portfolio, case studies, or Loom walkthroughs of systems you have built, and where you saw this post listed. Tell us about the most complex GHL automation you have personally built. We respond to every serious applicant.

* LinkedIn and social media graphics

*
 marketing materials

Our customers include Directors of hospitals, healthcare facilities, and engineers. Our materials need to look clean, modern, professional, credible, and sophisticated — not flashy, cluttered, or overly sales-oriented.



I need someone who can take rough information, existing documents, photos, logos, written content, and basic ideas and turn them into polished, professional materials without needing detailed instructions for every design decision.



Because much of our work is within healthcare facilities, some projects may involve researching and creating materials related to **The Joint Commission (TJC) and DNV accreditation standards ** and ASHRAE, including standards and requirements relevant to HVAC systems, ventilation, indoor air quality, testing and balancing, and facility compliance. Prior knowledge of these standards is not required, but you must be comfortable researching technical information, following reliable sources, and turning complex information into clear, professional marketing and educational materials.

Strong Microsoft PowerPoint presentation and design skills

Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, formatting, tables, sorting/filtering, charts, and organizing data

Excellent Canva skills

Strong graphic design and layout judgment

Excellent written and spoken English

Excellent attention to detail

Ability to follow and maintain a consistent company brand

Ability to create reusable templates

Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines

Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT when helpful

This position will begin at approximately 5–10 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours and responsibilities if we work well together.

title: Podcast Content & Social Media Assistant
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a creative and reliable Podcast Content & Social Media Assistant to help produce and distribute The Next Nova, a business podcast featuring founders, CEOs, and e-commerce leaders discussing growth, innovation, leadership, and the realities of building companies.



The podcast is presented by Vexnova.



The core podcast production workflow is already established in Riverside, and the visual brand direction, logos, colors, and overall design style are already in place.



I'm looking for someone who can take each completed recording and turn it into a polished, consistent package of podcast and social content.



The goal is simple:



I handle the conversations and recording. You help turn each episode into finished, publish-ready content.



Responsibilities

Riverside Podcast Editing

Edit podcast recordings directly within Riverside.

Remove unnecessary pauses, mistakes, dead space, and weak sections.

Create a polished conversational flow while keeping the discussion natural.

Apply existing podcast layouts, branding, logos, intros, outros, and other elements.

Create the final full-length video version of each episode.

Ensure audio, speaker framing, captions, and visual presentation are clean and consistent.

Short-Form Video Content

Review each podcast episode and identify the strongest moments, insights, stories, and quotes.

Create approximately 3–6 short-form clips per episode using Riverside.

Select clips that can stand alone and capture attention quickly.

Add captions, titles, hooks, and established branding.

Format clips appropriately for platforms such as LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

Graphics & Brand Execution

Create episode thumbnails, guest graphics, quote cards, and promotional assets.

Work within established Vexnova and The Next Nova brand elements rather than developing a new brand identity.

Maintain consistency in fonts, colors, logos, layouts, and overall visual style.

Make thoughtful design decisions while staying within the existing brand system.

Use tools such as Canva or similar graphic-design platforms when needed.

Social Content

Identify podcast insights that could become compelling social content.

Draft captions and supporting copy for episode releases and short-form clips.

Suggest strong quotes, hooks, and angles for LinkedIn posts.

Help turn each podcast episode into multiple pieces of useful content rather than simply promoting the full episode.

Content Organization

Maintain an organized library of episodes, clips, graphics, and final assets.

Track each episode from recording through editing and publication readiness.

Keep content organized by guest and episode.

Help maintain a consistent publishing workflow.



Typical Episode Deliverables



For each podcast recording, the expected deliverables will generally include:



One edited full-length episode in Riverside

One episode thumbnail / guest graphic

3–6 short-form video clips

1–2 quote or promotional graphics

Suggested captions or social copy

Organized final assets ready for publishing



What I'm Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



Experience using Riverside, particularly its editing and clip-creation tools.

Experience editing podcasts, interviews, or conversational video content.

Strong judgment about what makes an effective short-form clip.

Canva or similar graphic-design experience.

Strong attention to visual consistency.

Good written English.

Familiarity with LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Spotify and business-oriented content.

The ability to work independently within an established brand system.

Strong organization and dependable communication.



I'm not looking for someone who simply cuts video at timestamps I provide.



I want someone who can watch a conversation and recognize:



"That's the strongest 45-second clip."

"That statement would make a great LinkedIn post."

"That's the quote we should feature on the episode graphic."

"This section doesn't add enough value and should be removed."

"The opening needs to be tighter to keep someone's attention."





Tools



The primary tools for this role will be:



Riverside — podcast editing, video production, captions, and short-form clips

Canva or similar — thumbnails, guest graphics, quote cards, and other supporting graphics

Existing Vexnova / The Next Nova brand assets and templates



You will not be expected to develop a new visual identity from scratch.



Nice to Have



Experience with:



Business or entrepreneurship podcasts

E-commerce, technology, or AI content

LinkedIn content creation

YouTube thumbnails and video optimization

AI-assisted content repurposing



I'm looking for someone who can grow into a long-term role helping manage the content operation for The Next Nova.

title: Short-Form Video Editor – AI-Powered Content (CapCut + Google Flow) | Health & Wellness Brand
description:
About Us



Miss Yerba is a fast-growing women's health & wellness supplement brand selling across Europe and the US. We produce high volumes of short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts. Our production system is AI-assisted — meaning we don't need a traditional video editor. We need someone who can follow a clear, repeatable workflow using modern AI tools to produce polished short-form videos at scale.



The Role



You'll be responsible for producing our daily short-form video content using a structured, step-by-step workflow that we've already built out. This is not creative guesswork — we have Loom walkthroughs, prompt documents, templates, and organized Google Drive folders ready for you.



Your daily workflow looks like this:



Receive a short prompt + assets (avatar image, base video)

Paste these into Google Flow to generate the video

Screenshot the old video's on-screen text

Send the screenshot to ChatGPT or Claude to get a rewritten version

Place the new on-screen text into our custom CapCut template

Export the final video and upload it to the correct Google Drive folder



That's it. Clean, repeatable, structured.



What We're Looking For



Experience with CapCut (comfortable using templates, adding text overlays, basic editing)

Comfortable working with AI tools (Google Flow, ChatGPT, Claude — or willing to learn fast)

Highly organized and structured — you follow SOPs, not your gut

Reliable and consistent — we need someone who delivers every day, not "when inspired"

Available 5–7 days per week (flexible on hours, but output must be daily)

Strong attention to detail — correct folders, correct text, correct formatting

Good English communication (you'll receive instructions and docs in English)



Tools You'll Use



Google Flow (AI video generation)

CapCut (editing + templates)

Google Drive (file organization)

ChatGPT / Claude (text rewriting)

Loom (for training walkthroughs)



Hours & Availability



Flexible schedule. What matters is consistent daily output. We'll agree on a weekly video target. Time zone: CET (Netherlands), but you can work on your own schedule as long as deadlines are met.



Salary



To be discussed based on experience and availability.



How to Apply



IMPORTANT: In the subject line of your application, include the word "matevideo". Applications without this word will be automatically rejected.



In your application, please include:



A short introduction about yourself

Your experience with CapCut (and any AI tools if applicable)

Your availability (days per week + hours per day)

A link to any short-form video work you've done (even personal projects count)



We have a complete onboarding system with Looms, SOPs, and prompt docs ready — so if you're a fast learner who thrives with structure, this role is built for you.
