title: Full-Time QuickBooks Bookkeeper & Invoicing Specialist
description:
Small Colorado trucking business is looking for a highly organized and dependable QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper to take daily ownership of our invoicing and bookkeeping.



This is a hands-on, ongoing position. You will be responsible for creating every customer invoice and keeping our QuickBooks records accurate and current each business day. We need someone who notices missing information, asks questions promptly, and follows every transaction through to completion.



DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



Invoicing and accounts receivable:



Review completed jobs, work orders, service records, and customer information



Create every customer invoice in QuickBooks Online



Confirm that services, parts, quantities, prices, discounts, taxes, and payment terms are correct



Attach supporting documents when required



Send invoices to customers on time



Correct inaccurate or rejected invoices



Record and apply customer payments accurately



Monitor unpaid and overdue invoices



Send approved payment reminders and follow up on outstanding balances



Maintain accurate customer records



Report missing information, discrepancies, and overdue accounts immediately



Bookkeeping and QuickBooks maintenance:



Categorize daily income and expenses



Enter bills, receipts, credits, refunds, fees, and other transactions



Match downloaded banking transactions to the correct records



Identify duplicates, errors, and uncategorized transactions



Keep the chart of accounts and customer/vendor records organized



Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts



Maintain organized digital receipts and supporting documents



Review QuickBooks daily and resolve outstanding issues



Keep the books current so management can rely on the information



Reporting:



Provide a daily summary of invoices created, invoices sent, payments received, overdue accounts, and unresolved issues



Provide weekly accounts-receivable and cash-flow updates



Prepare monthly Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, and Accounts Receivable reports



Help prepare clean and complete records for our accountant and tax professional



Complete other related bookkeeping and administrative duties as assigned



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



At least two years of hands-on QuickBooks Online bookkeeping experience



Strong experience creating and managing customer invoices



Experience with accounts receivable, accounts payable, transaction categorization, and reconciliations



Excellent accuracy and attention to detail



Strong written and spoken English



Professional customer communication



Reliable attendance and consistent weekday availability



Ability to work independently, follow written procedures, and meet daily deadlines



Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and backup internet or power plan



Ability to protect confidential customer and financial information



Experience supporting a U.S.-based service business is strongly preferred



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time position requiring approximately 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday. You must have dependable daily availability and overlap with our Mountain Time business hours.



All completed work orders received by the daily cutoff must be invoiced that same business day. The exact schedule and cutoff time will be discussed during the interview.



TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “Performance Bookkeeper” so we know you read the complete posting.



Please answer all of the following:



How many years have you used QuickBooks Online?



What bookkeeping responsibilities did you personally handle?



Approximately how many invoices did you create and manage each day or week?



How do you verify that an invoice is accurate before sending it?



How do you handle missing or conflicting information on a work order?



Describe your experience with bank and credit-card reconciliations.



What financial reports have you prepared?



What hours can you consistently work in Mountain Time?



What is your desired hourly rate?



Describe your computer, internet connection, and backup plan for outages.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to an interview and may be asked to complete a brief paid QuickBooks skills assessment using sample information.



This position requires honesty, confidentiality, accuracy, and dependable daily communication. Do not contact our customers, vendors, or employees outside the authorized application and work process.

title: Schedule Manager Virtual Client Support
description:
# Bilingual Scheduling & Client Support Coordinator — Tennessee Operations



**Southern Domestic Diva**

**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Department:** Tennessee Operations

**Employment:** Full-Time — 40 Hours Per Week

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time**

**Compensation:** **$5 USD per hour**



---



## POSITION OVERVIEW



Southern Domestic Diva is seeking a highly organized, dependable, and client-focused **Bilingual Scheduling & Client Support Coordinator** to support our Tennessee operations.



This is a frontline operations role responsible for:



* Scheduling

* Client communication

* Quoting

* Sales follow-up

* Crew communication

* Operational follow-through

* Client retention

* Documentation and task tracking



Our Tennessee service lines include:



* Residential cleaning

* Vacation rental cleaning

* Commercial cleaning

* Limited construction and post-construction cleaning



Construction work is offered but currently represents a smaller portion of our Tennessee operations.



This position requires **excellent written and verbal English**, with especially strong written communication for text messaging and
.



**Spanish is strongly preferred** for crew communication, but professional English communication is the higher priority.



This position supports **Tennessee operations only**.



---



# PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE



The Scheduling & Client Support Coordinator helps keep Tennessee operations organized, responsive, and properly documented.



The person in this role must ensure:



* Clients receive fast responses.

* Jobs are scheduled correctly.

* Crews receive complete information.

* Quotes are returned quickly.

* Sales opportunities are followed up.

* One-time clients are given opportunities to rebook.

* Operational issues are communicated to the correct manager.

* Client concerns are followed through to resolution.

* Important activity is documented in Asana and AutoMaid.



This position requires someone who can move quickly without becoming careless.



---



# 1. SCHEDULING & AUTOMaid



Scheduling is one of the most important responsibilities of this position.



Manage Tennessee schedules in **AutoMaid** for:



* Residential cleaning

* Vacation rental cleaning

* Commercial cleaning

* Occasional construction/post-construction cleaning



Responsibilities include:



* Entering new jobs.

* Updating appointments.

* Processing schedule changes.

* Managing reschedules.

* Preventing double-bookings and overlaps.

* Reviewing upcoming schedules for potential problems.

* Maintaining accurate client information.

* Maintaining property information.

* Recording access instructions.

* Recording parking instructions.

* Recording client preferences.

* Maintaining service notes.

* Making sure crews have the correct job information before arrival.



### Scheduling Standard



The goal is **98%+ scheduling accuracy**.



Scheduling errors that could have been prevented through proper review, documentation, or communication are unacceptable.



---



# 2. CLIENT COMMUNICATION



**Text messaging is the primary communication channel for this position.**



You will communicate directly with Tennessee clients regarding:



* New service inquiries

* Scheduling

* Rescheduling

* Appointment confirmations

* Quotes

* Service questions

* Arrival details

* Follow-up

* Service concerns

* Rebooking

* Recurring service

* Payment-related communication when assigned



Responsibilities include:



* Responding promptly during business hours.

* Using clear and polished written English.

* Maintaining professional grammar and tone.

* Keeping communication concise and easy to understand.

* Using phone calls when a situation requires faster or clearer resolution.

* Using
 for professional or detailed communication when appropriate.

* Maintaining a professional Southern Domestic Diva client experience.



Client-facing communication should be ready to send without requiring management to rewrite every message.



---



# 3. QUOTES & SPEED-TO-LEAD



You will monitor incoming inquiries throughout the workday from:



* JotForm

* Website inquiries

* Other approved lead sources



### Quote Response Standard



Complete inquiries should receive a quote within:



**10–20 minutes during business hours**



**20 minutes is the maximum target response time.**



Responsibilities include:



* Monitoring new inquiries throughout the day.

* Reviewing incoming information quickly.

* Determining whether enough information is available to quote.

* Contacting the client immediately if additional information is needed.

* Preparing quotes using approved company pricing and processes.

* Entering quote information into AutoMaid.

* Updating client information accurately.

* Tracking each opportunity through a clear outcome.



Every lead should eventually be classified as:



* **Booked**

* **Follow-Up Needed**

* **Lost**

* **No Response**



Speed-to-lead is a key performance requirement.



---



# 4. SALES FOLLOW-UP & WEEKLY SALES MEETING



This role is responsible for helping convert qualified leads and one-time customers into booked or recurring business.



Attendance at the **weekly sales meeting is required**.



Responsibilities include:



* Reviewing new leads that have not booked.

* Reviewing open quotes.

* Following up with prospects.

* Reviewing one-time clients for rebooking opportunities.

* Offering recurring service when appropriate.

* Using multiple follow-up channels when appropriate.

* Tracking every follow-up touch in Asana.

* Recording outcomes.

* Creating clear next actions.

* Preparing sales activity before the weekly sales meeting.



Possible follow-up channels include:



* Text message

*

* Phone

* LinkedIn

*



The expectation is **professional persistence**, not one message followed by silence.



---



# SUGGESTED FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCE



### Initial Quote



Send within **10–20 minutes**, with 20 minutes as the maximum target during business hours.



### Follow-Up #1



Within **1 business day** if the prospect has not booked.



### Follow-Up #2



Approximately **3 business days later**.



Use another appropriate communication channel when possible.



### Follow-Up #3



Approximately **7 days after the quote**.



Continue appropriate follow-up until:



* The prospect books.

* The prospect declines.

* The opportunity is lost.

* The prospect becomes unresponsive after the approved follow-up process.

* Management determines follow-up should stop.



### One-Time Clients



After service:



* Confirm satisfaction.

* Ask about their next cleaning.

* Discuss recurring service when appropriate.

* Document the outcome.



---



# 5. CREW COMMUNICATION



Communicate important scheduling and job information to Tennessee crews.



Responsibilities include:



* Schedule changes

* New job information

* Client preferences

* Property instructions

* Service instructions

* Access details

* Parking instructions

* Special requests

* Relevant client updates



### Spanish Communication



Spanish is strongly preferred for crew communication.



Approved translation tools may be used when appropriate.



However, you remain responsible for ensuring every message is:



* Accurate

* Clear

* Professional

* Easy for the crew to understand



You will also:



* Respond to basic scheduling questions from crews.

* Respond to routine job-related questions.

* Escalate operational problems when management involvement is required.



---



# 6. PROFITABILITY & CREW IMPROVEMENT FOLLOW-THROUGH



The **Project Manager** is responsible for reviewing job profitability and identifying when a job or crew falls below the company's established profit target.



The Scheduling & Client Support Coordinator is responsible for communication and follow-through after the issue is identified.



Responsibilities include:



* Communicating with the Project Manager regarding identified profitability issues.

* Understanding what improvement is required.

* Communicating the issue clearly to the applicable crew.

* Explaining expected improvements.

* Discussing practical efficiency or performance improvements.

* Documenting the conversation.

* Tracking agreed follow-up actions.

* Escalating repeated or unresolved issues to the Project Manager.



### Important Boundary



This coordinator does **not independently establish profitability standards or make financial management decisions**.



The Project Manager identifies and owns the profitability issue.



The coordinator helps ensure the required communication and follow-through happen.



---



# 7. UNPAID CLIENTS & FINANCE COMMUNICATION



The **Finance Manager** retains responsibility for financial oversight and account decisions.



This coordinator supports client communication when an unpaid account is identified.



Responsibilities include:



* Communicating with the Finance Manager regarding outstanding balances.

* Contacting clients regarding unpaid balances when directed.

* Sending professional payment reminders.

* Documenting client communication.

* Recording payment-related updates.

* Relaying relevant information back to the Finance Manager.

* Notifying management when an unpaid balance may affect an upcoming service.



### Financial Boundary



This role does **not** manage:



* Accounting

* Bookkeeping

* Payroll

* Financial reporting

* Bill payment

* Bank reconciliation

* Financial policy

* Independent account decisions



---



# 8. CLIENT COMPLAINTS & RETENTION



Help manage service concerns professionally and protect client relationships.



Responsibilities include:



* Receiving client complaints.

* Remaining calm and professional.

* Gathering accurate information.

* Documenting the concern.

* Communicating the issue to the appropriate manager.

* Coordinating approved re-cleans.

* Coordinating approved corrective actions.

* Following up with the client after resolution.

* Helping retain the customer when possible.



The goal is not simply to acknowledge complaints.



The goal is to help move each issue toward a clear resolution.



---



# SYSTEMS & TOOLS



You should be comfortable using or learning:



* **AutoMaid** — scheduling, client information, quotes, and job details

* **Asana** — task management and documentation

* **Homebase** — team and crew communication as assigned

* **Microsoft Outlook** —
 and calendar communication

* **Company text messaging platform** — primary client communication channel

* **JotForm**

* Website lead sources

* Approved AI and translation tools when appropriate



---



# KEY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be measured using clear operational standards.



Expected results include:



* **100% of complete new inquiries quoted within 10–20 minutes during business hours**

* **20 minutes maximum target response time**

* **98%+ scheduling accuracy in AutoMaid**

* **100% of qualified lead follow-up documented in Asana**

* **100% of active quoted opportunities tracked to a clear next step or final outcome**

* Prompt client text responses during business hours

* Consistently professional written English

* Accurate client and property notes

* Proper crew communication

* Weekly sales meeting attendance

* Sales activity and follow-up numbers prepared before meetings

* One-time client rebooking opportunities reviewed consistently

* Profitability-related communication completed when assigned

* Unpaid-client communication completed when assigned

* Client complaints properly documented and escalated

* Approved re-clean and retention follow-up completed



---



# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Candidates must have:



* Excellent written English

* Excellent spoken English

* Strong grammar and professional communication

* Strong text-message communication skills

* Strong
 communication skills

* Customer service ability

* Strong organizational skills

* High attention to detail

* Fast response habits

* Ability to manage multiple conversations at the same time

* Ability to follow established processes

* Accurate documentation habits

* Ability to work independently

* Good judgment

* Reliable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Backup internet

* Reasonable backup plan for power interruptions

* Consistent availability during required working hours



---



# STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* English and Spanish communication

* Scheduling

* Dispatch

* Customer service

* Client support

* Commercial cleaning

* Residential cleaning

* Vacation rental cleaning

* Janitorial services

* Facility services

* Service-business operations

* Sales follow-up

* Lead conversion

* AutoMaid

* Asana

* Homebase

* Outlook

* JotForm

* Text-based customer support



### Language Priority



Spanish is strongly preferred.



However:



**Excellent English is more important than Spanish fluency.**



A candidate with outstanding English and solid operational skills may be stronger than a bilingual candidate with weak client-facing English.



---



# WORK SCHEDULE



This is a **full-time, 40-hour-per-week position**.



### Monday–Friday



### 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time



You must be consistently available and actively working during these hours.



**Do not apply if you cannot reliably work this schedule.**



---



# COMPENSATION



### $5 USD Per Hour



### 40 Hours Per Week



This is a full-time remote position.



---



# IMPORTANT ROLE BOUNDARIES



This is a **Scheduling, Operations, and Client Support position for Tennessee operations only.**



## This role DOES NOT include Human Resources responsibilities.



This position does not handle:



* Employee onboarding

* Employee records

* Employee documentation

* Payroll

* HR administration

* Hiring decisions

* Termination decisions

* Formal employee discipline

* Company-wide HR policy



Those responsibilities are handled internally by Southern Domestic Diva.



## This position does not replace the Project Manager.

* Profitability review

* Operational management decisions

* Significant crew-performance issues

* Major operational escalations



## This position does not replace the Finance Manager.

* Financial oversight

* Account decisions

* Accounting

* Payment policy

* Financial reporting



The coordinator's role is to **communicate, document, follow up, and escalate appropriately**.



---



# THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR EVERYONE



## DO NOT APPLY IF:



* You cannot work **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday**.

* You struggle with professional written English.

* You regularly make spelling or grammar mistakes in client-facing communication.

* You respond slowly to new leads.

* You dislike sales follow-up.

* You are uncomfortable communicating with clients by text.

* You refuse to make phone calls when necessary.

* You need repeated reminders.

* You frequently forget follow-ups.

* You cannot manage multiple conversations.

* You do not document your work.

* You disappear during scheduled work hours.

* You have unreliable internet without backup.

* You are looking for a low-responsibility data-entry job.



This role requires **speed, accuracy, communication, organization, and follow-through**.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications may not be reviewed.



## Step 1 — Attention-to-Detail Test



The **FIRST LINE** of your application must say:



**Accurate Schedules. Happy Clients.**



---



## Step 2 — Introduction



In **150 words or less**, tell us:



* Who you are

* Where in the Philippines you are located

title: Elite Video Editors for OmeTV
description:
The work: Editing OmeTV footage into short viral clips. You get 30-60 min recorded sessions, you watch them, find the best moments, and cut each moment into two files: a full edit (vertical crop, sound effects timed on the reactions, background music, zooms, captions, clean coloring) and a fast raw cut of the same moment.



The style: High pacing, tight cuts, movement, the viewer must stay locked in from the first second to the last. But balanced, not overdone, a clip stuffed with effects is as bad as a boring one. Perfect rhythm, not chaos. And every clip must tell a story, beginning, punchline, payoff. If you can't make a story out of a video, don't apply.



What you must know: Short-form editing properly: cropping to 9:16 without stretching faces, timing sound effects, word-by-word captions, keeping quality crispy. CapCut is enough if you know what you're doing.



What we give you: All the footage (always more than you can finish) and exact documents on how we want everything.



The pay: Per clip, rate set based on your performance. No hourly, no tracker, no schedule, the more you produce the more you earn. Around $800-1,200 a month. Paid on the 1st and 15th, always on time.



Requirements: Full-time work, not a side gig, if you can only give 2-3 hours a day, don't apply. Fast stable internet and a PC that handles editing smoothly.



Every clip goes through review and only approved work is paid, but don't stress it, we approve everything as long as the quality is there, in practice 90-100% of clips pass. We choose very few people and we keep the ones who deliver.

title: Assistant to the Broker
description:
Executive Virtual Assistant to Broker/Owner

Residential Real Estate | Commercial & Investment Real Estate | Property Management Growth | Coaching



Century 21 Fairways Real Estate & Property Management



Position Overview



Century 21 Fairways is seeking an exceptional Executive Virtual Assistant to support an active Broker/Owner, real estate producer, property management executive, investor, and real estate coach.



This is a high-level position for someone who can become the right hand to a busy entrepreneur operating multiple real estate revenue streams.



The position supports four primary areas:



Residential Real Estate Sales

Commercial & Investment Real Estate

Property Management Business Development

Real Estate Coaching & Personal Brand



The Broker already has transaction coordination support for properties once they are under contract. Therefore, this position is heavily focused on the activities that happen before the contract and outside the transaction: lead generation, database management, client follow-up, listing preparation, scheduling, research, marketing coordination, presentations, business development, and executive organization.



The goal is simple:



Keep the Broker focused on appointments, relationships, listings, negotiations, coaching, leadership, and revenue-producing activities.



1. RESIDENTIAL REAL ESTATE SUPPORT



Assist with the Broker's active residential sales business.



Seller & Listing Support

Respond to and organize potential seller leads.

Schedule listing appointments.

Research properties before appointments.

Prepare property profiles.

Gather tax, deed, parcel, and public-record information.

Research comparable sales as directed.

Assist in preparing listing presentations and CMAs.

Prepare seller meeting folders and materials.

Confirm listing appointments.

Maintain listing appointment follow-up.

Coordinate photography, marketing, signs, lockboxes, and listing-launch activities.

Maintain listing marketing checklists.

Coordinate open-house marketing and scheduling.

Update sellers and maintain communication as directed.

Track listing expiration dates and upcoming opportunities.

Buyer Support

Organize buyer inquiries.

Maintain buyer information in the CRM.

Schedule buyer consultations.

Maintain buyer follow-up campaigns.

Track active buyer needs.

Match potential opportunities with buyers and investors in the database.

Keep the Broker informed of high-priority buyer opportunities.



Once a property is under contract, the transaction is transferred to the Transaction Coordinator for contract-to-close management.



2. COMMERCIAL & INVESTMENT REAL ESTATE



Assist with commercial properties, multifamily properties, investment sales, development opportunities, businesses, and other commercial assignments.



Responsibilities include:



Schedule owner and investor meetings.

Research properties before meetings.

Prepare ownership and property profiles.

Gather tax, parcel, zoning, public-record, and available market information.

Organize rent rolls.

Organize leases and tenant information.

Organize income and expense statements.

Assist with preliminary investment analysis.

Assist with Broker Opinions of Value.

Prepare property presentations.

Assist with offering memorandums and marketing packages.

Maintain active commercial listing information.

Track prospective buyers and investors.

Maintain buyer prospect lists for each listing.

Schedule property tours.

Track confidentiality agreements and information requests.

Follow up with investors after tours and presentations.

Maintain communication with prospective sellers.

Track potential future listings.



The VA should help ensure that every commercial opportunity has a next action and follow-up date.



3. INVESTOR & PROPERTY OWNER MEETING PREPARATION



Before meetings with investors, landlords, developers, commercial owners, or residential sellers, prepare a concise meeting package.



This may include:



Property overview

Ownership information

Tax information

Property history

Current rents

Rent roll

Lease information

Income and expenses

Comparable properties

Market information

Estimated rental information

Potential management opportunity

Potential sale opportunity

Missing information/questions



After the meeting:



Enter detailed CRM notes.

Send follow-up correspondence.

Request missing documents.

Schedule the next contact.

Prepare proposals.

Track the opportunity until a decision is made.

4. PROPERTY MANAGEMENT BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



This person will play an important role in helping grow the Century 21 Fairways property management portfolio.



Prospecting



Identify and develop relationships with:



Individual landlords

Multifamily investors

Apartment building owners

Commercial property owners

Developers

Out-of-state investors

Real estate agents with investor clients

Attorneys

Lenders

Estate representatives

Housing organizations

Investors purchasing Western Pennsylvania properties

Lead Management

Respond to property management inquiries.

Qualify prospective clients.

Gather property information.

Explain available management services.

Schedule consultations with the Broker.

Prepare property-management presentations.

Prepare proposals.

Follow up after presentations.

Maintain prospects in the CRM.

Create long-term nurture campaigns.

Track signed management agreements and potential units.



The VA should constantly look for crossover opportunities.



A commercial seller may also need management.



A residential investor may purchase another rental.



A property-management owner may d
 to sell.



A residential seller may own investment property.



Every relationship should be viewed as a potential long-term real estate relationship, not simply a single transaction.



5. REAL ESTATE COACHING BUSINESS

Responsibilities may include:

Organize coaching prospects and members.

Schedule coaching sessions.

Coordinate webinars and virtual meetings.

Organize weekly training programs.

Prepare presentation materials.

Prepare worksheets and handouts.

Coordinate
 campaigns.

Past clients

Attorneys

Vendors

Appropriate category

Notes

Source

Next follow-up date



A lead without a next action is an unfinished lead.



7. EXECUTIVE CALENDAR & DAILY ORGANIZATION



The Executive VA will help manage the Broker's professional schedule across multiple businesses.



Responsibilities include:



Schedule appointments.

Confirm meetings.

Coordinate Zoom calls.

Organize listing appointments.

Schedule property tours.

Schedule owner consultations.

Schedule coaching appointments.

Maintain follow-up reminders.

Prepare meeting materials in advance.

Maintain daily priorities.

Identify scheduling conflicts.

Protect designated prospecting and revenue-producing time.

Keep outstanding items visible until completed.

Today's Appointments | Preparation Needed | Calls to Return | Leads to Follow Up | Decisions Needed | Deadlines | Revenue Opportunities



8. MARKETING COORDINATION

Residential listing marketing

Commercial listing marketing

Property-management marketing

Coaching marketing

 campaigns

Database campaigns

Social media scheduling

Flyers

Open-house promotions

Offering memorandums

Presentations

Newsletters

Educational content

Coaching promotions

Video content

Testimonials

Client success stories



Basic Canva experience is preferred.



9. WEEKLY EXECUTIVE REPORT



Provide one concise weekly report covering all four business areas.



Residential



New leads, listing appointments, buyer appointments, listings coming to market, follow-ups and opportunities.



Commercial & Investment



New prospects, owner meetings, potential listings, active listings, buyer activity, tours and follow-ups.



Property Management



New owner leads, appointments, proposals, agreements pending, new clients and potential units.



Coaching



New leads, memberships, upcoming classes, content completed, marketing campaigns and follow-ups.



Executive Priorities



The report should conclude with:



Top 5 Revenue Opportunities for Next Week



This is critical. The VA should not simply report what happened; the VA should help identify where the Broker's attention will produce the greatest return.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong executive-assistant skills.

Real estate experience strongly preferred.

Excellent CRM/database skills.

Strong organizational ability.

Professional telephone skills.

Sales and business-development mindset.

Strong follow-up habits.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to research properties and companies.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets.

Ability to learn real estate technology.

Ability to manage multiple businesses and priorities simultaneously.

Comfortable communicating with executives, investors, property owners, clients, agents, attorneys, lenders, and vendors.

Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

High level of confidentiality and professionalism.

PREFERRED TECHNOLOGY EXPERIENCE



Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:



AppFolio

MoxiWorks

MoxiPresent

MoxiEngage / CRM systems

Canva

Google Workspace

Microsoft Excel

Zoom

Commercial real estate databases

 marketing platforms

Coaching/course platforms

AI productivity tools

THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are not looking for someone who simply waits for a task list.



We are looking for someone who thinks:



What needs to happen next?



Who needs followed up with?



What does the Broker need for tomorrow's appointment?



Which leads are getting cold?



Where is there an opportunity we haven't followed up on?



What can I take off the Broker's desk?



Which activity has the greatest potential to generate revenue?



The right candidate will be proactive, organized, persistent, professional, resourceful, technologically capable, and comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.



THE ULTIMATE PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION



The Executive Virtual Assistant should allow the Broker/Owner to spend the majority of her working time doing what only she can do:



Meeting clients.



Winning listings.



Meeting investors and property owners.



Selling property-management services.



Negotiating deals.



Building relationships.



Coaching and teaching.



Leading the company.



Creating new revenue opportunities.



Everything else should be organized, prepared, tracked, delegated, or followed up by the support team.



This position should ultimately become the central organizational hub around the Broker's production, relationships, opportunities, and personal business development.

title: Astrology Writer and Expert

knowledge shines through every piece.

 newsletters,

and scripts for video content

2. As an Expert:

Who This Role Is NOT For:

immediately

Streamlined systems — We have clear processes; you'll help make them even better

Making revisions when necessary

YouTube SEO

Video titles and descriptions

Increasing click-through rate (CTR)

Audience retention

YouTube Shorts strategy

Content planning

Studying YouTube analytics

Growing subscribers and views

Understanding what makes lifestyle/travel/family content perform well



Our goal is to find someone who can eventually become an important part of growing the channel with us.

Experienced with lifestyle, family, vlog, or travel-style editing

A good storyteller, not just a technical video editor

Creative and able to bring ideas to the table

Good at identifying interesting moments from raw footage

Able to make videos engaging without over-editing them

Reliable and consistent

Good at communicating

Able to meet deadlines

Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

description:
ABOUT US



Bridged Financial Solutions is a fully remote boutique accounting, tax, and advisory firm. We serve a growing client base across tax preparation, fractional CFO engagements, bookkeeping, and back-office operations. Our team of 10 operates with a high degree of autonomy on a cloud-first stack. We are lean, fast-moving, and hold ourselves to institutional-quality standards.

You will serve as the connective tissue between the principal, the client service team, and our clients. You will work closely with our Accounting Senior Manager to coordinate production workflows, ensure clean handoffs, and keep the team running on schedule. You will hold the team accountable, manage day-to-day operations, own the client-facing operational experience, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



If you are a systems thinker who gets energy from bringing order to complexity, building repeatable processes, and taking full ownership of your domain — this role was built for you.

Client Experience

- Manage client-facing communications for operational matters — status updates, document requests, portal guidance

mber is serving them



Team Coordination

- Run a weekly internal ops check-in — agenda, notes, follow-up tracking

- Hold tea
mbers accountable to deadlines without requiring principal involvement

- Support onboarding of new tea
mbers on firm tools and workflows



Billing and Admin

- Support the billing workflow — engagement tracking, renewal reminders, exception flags

- Manage recurring admin tasks: calendar coordination, document organization, file hygiene

- Track client engagement status and surface issues to the principal proactively



---



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required

- 3+ years in an operations, practice management, or senior administrative role — professional services or accounting-adjacent preferred

- Experience managing workflow tools at a team level (not just personal task management)

- Strong written English — you will represent the firm externally

- High accountability orientation — you follow up, you close loops, you do not wait to be reminded

- Comfortable operating with autonomy and making judgment calls independently



Strongly Preferred

- Familiarity with QuickBooks Online

- Experience with proposal or billing platforms (Ignition or similar)

- Prior experience supporting a CPA, fractional CFO, or accounting firm

- Exposure to US-based professional services environments



This role is NOT for you if:

- You need detailed daily direction to prioritize your work

- You treat "it wasn't on my list" as a valid reason for something falling through the cracks

- You confuse task completion with problem ownership

- You are looking for a light VA role with limited responsibility



---



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



Double (practice management), QuickBooks Online, Ignition, Google Workspace, Slack



---



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Day 30: Full command of our tools and workflows. Independently managing daily ops and team task tracking. Client portal responsiveness maintained without principal involvement.



Day 60: SOPs documented for at least 3 recurring firm processes. Weekly ops cadence running on autopilot. First billing cycle fully supported without escalations.



Day 90: Principal's operational involvement reduced by 50%+. Practice Manager is the first point of contact for all team operational questions. At least one workflow improvement identified and implemented.



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, you must complete the following — incomplete applications will not be reviewed:



1. Complete the DISC assessment on OnlineJobs.ph and include your results with your application.



2. Answer this question in 150–300 words:



"Describe a time you identified a process that was breaking down in your team or organization. What specifically was failing, what did you do about it, and what was the result?"



Do not use AI to write your answer for you — we can tell the difference, and it will disqualify your application. We are looking for your actual thinking, not polished filler.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our team members can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will be joining a fast-growing B2B software platform built to help home-service and local small businesses streamline operations, win more customers, and grow. From real-time booking pages to automated quoting and modern CRM tools, it gives service companies the systems they need to run smarter and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

The company is scaling its sales team, and this is a real seat on that team — not a call-centre desk. You will work directly with Account Executives, marketing, and leadership, and your feedback will shape messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy.



Job Overview

We are looking for a full-time, remote Sales Development Representative to be the first point of contact with prospective customers. You will run outbound outreach, qualify inbound leads, and book high-quality product demos for the Account Executive team.

Your mission is pipeline. You will become deeply expert in how home-service businesses operate — where they lose money, where they lose customers, and where the solution fixes it — and you will be able to explain that in a way an owner immediately recognizes as their own problem.

This is a quota-carrying, individual contributor role with a clear, earned path to Account Executive for the person who performs.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (North America) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM PHT



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary: PHP 40,000 – 45,000 per month

Commission: Uncapped commission on qualified meetings and pipeline, paid on top of base

Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

• Outbound outreach — Run high-volume, high-quality outreach by phone,
, and social channels to identify and engage potential customers

• Lead qualification — Qualify inbound leads and assess fit based on business type, needs, and readiness to adopt the platform

• Value articulation — Clearly explain what MioCommerce does and how it improves day-to-day operations for home-service businesses

• Demo booking — Book high-quality, well-qualified product demos for Account Executives — booked meetings that show up and convert

• CRM discipline — Keep lead data accurate, current, and organized in HubSpot; log every touch

• Hit the number — Meet and exceed monthly KPIs for outreach volume, qualified meetings, and pipeline generated

• Collaboration — Work with marketing and sales to sharpen messaging, targeting, and lead quality — and bring what you hear on calls back to the team

• Product depth — Learn the product deeply enough to educate prospects and spot opportunities others would miss



What We Are Looking For

Required:

• At least 3 years of experience in an SDR or outbound sales role, with B2B SaaS experience

• Native-level written and verbal English communication

• Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and Slack

• Persistence and self-motivation — you pick up the phone without being told to

• Comfortable with high-volume outreach, testing new angles, and iterating quickly

• Ability to identify customer pain points and connect them to a solution in plain language

• Coachable and genuinely interested in learning modern sales technique

• Track record of hitting or exceeding quota, with numbers you can talk through

Nice to Have:

• Experience selling to SMBs or home-service businesses (cleaning, HVAC, landscaping, pest control, plumbing, and similar)

• Experience with sales engagement or dialer tools (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Aircall, JustCall)

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) for research, personalization, and prep

• Experience at an early-stage or fast-growth SaaS company

• Exposure to lead sourcing and list-building (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar)

Who Thrives in This Role

• You are competitive with yourself — you track your own numbers before anyone asks for them

• You are unbothered by rejection; a no just moves you to the next dial

• You learn fast and retain it — you do not need the same thing explained twice

• You are curious about business. You want to understand why a service company with 12 trucks is losing bookings, not just recite a script

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarize, you do not ramble

• You take ownership. When something is in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You want the AE seat, and you are willing to earn it in this one first

This May Not Be the Right Fit If

• You are looking for inbound-only or purely customer-service work

• You are uncomfortable making a high volume of calls to business owners

• You need a fully built playbook handed to you before you can start

• You have never carried a quota



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Uncapped commission paid on top of base

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth:

• Clear, defined path from SDR to Account Executive

• Long-term, stable client placement

• Clear KPIs and structured onboarding

• Regular coaching and performance feedback

• Direct influence on messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply

Please
 the following to 

• Updated resume

• Short video (1–2 minutes), recorded in one take and unscripted, covering: (1) the B2B SaaS product you sold and who you sold it to, and (2) your best quarter as an SDR and the numbers behind it

Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

Able to follow a sales process

Interested in a long-term position with room to grow

Experience That Is a BIG PLUS



You do not have to have all of these, but please let us know if you have experience with:



Tax Industry Experience

Understanding taxes, tax preparation businesses, tax professionals, or the tax industry is a major plus.



Tax Software Experience

If you have previously sold, supported, or used professional tax software, we definitely want to hear about it.



GoHighLevel (GHL)

We currently use GoHighLevel (GHL) to manage our leads and sales process. Previous GHL experience is a big plus.



 Leads

Experience working with inbound leads generated through
/Meta advertising is also valuable.



B2B Sales

Experience selling products or services to business owners is preferred.



Compensation



$4–$7 USD per hour + COMMISSION



Your starting hourly rate will depend on your experience, sales ability, and relevant background.



In addition to your hourly pay, you will have the opportunity to earn commission on sales you close.



We want someone who is motivated by performance and wants the opportunity to make more money as they produce results.



What Success Looks Like



We aren't looking for someone who simply makes calls and checks leads off a list.



We want someone who thinks:



“How can I turn this lead into a customer?”



That means:



Following up when someone doesn't answer

Calling leads more than once

Sending texts

Keeping conversations going

Asking good questions

Understanding why someone hasn't purchased

Handling objections

Building relationships

Asking for the sale

Following up until there is a clear YES or NO

Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our sales team.



If you perform well, consistently close sales, and help us grow, there may be opportunities for additional hours, increased responsibilities, higher compensation, and advancement within our sales team.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



Tell us about yourself and your previous sales experience.

How many years of phone sales experience do you have?

Have you sold products or services to business owners before? If yes, explain.

Do you have any experience with taxes, tax preparation, or tax software? Please explain.

Have you used GoHighLevel (GHL) before? If yes, tell us what you used it for.





IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “I CAN CLOSE.”



If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we may not review it. This lets us know you took the time to read the entire job posting.



Final Question



Imagine you receive a new
 lead who requested information about our tax software. You call them, but they don't answer.



Tell us exactly what you would do next and how you would follow up with that lead over the next several days.



We're looking for someone who is hungry, dependable, good with people, and knows how to turn opportunities into sales.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO — Full-Time Remote
description:
# Executive Assistant to CEO — Full-Time Remote (Philippines)



**Southern Domestic Diva & Southern Diva Living**



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Position:** Executive Assistant to CEO

**Employment:** Full-Time — 40 Hours Per Week

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time**

**Compensation:** **$6 USD per hour**



---



## POSITION OVERVIEW



Southern Domestic Diva & Southern Diva Living are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable **Executive Assistant to the CEO**.



This is a high-trust position for someone who can protect the CEO's time, manage important communications, coordinate follow-through, support sales and customer administration, organize events and travel, and proactively identify opportunities for business and brand growth.



We operate in the **commercial and residential cleaning industry**. Previous experience with a commercial cleaning, janitorial, residential cleaning, facility-services, property-services, or similar service-based company is **strongly preferred**.



Experience using **Xero and Stripe** for invoicing and payment administration is also strongly preferred.



This is **not a basic data-entry or general Virtual Assistant position**.



We need someone who can think, prioritize, communicate professionally, maintain confidentiality, solve problems, and follow through without requiring constant supervision.



---



# YOUR PRIMARY MISSION



Your responsibility is to help the CEO operate efficiently and ensure important details do not fall through the cracks.



You will be expected to:



* Protect the CEO's time.

* Keep the CEO organized and prepared.

* Manage important communications.

* Track commitments and deadlines.

* Follow up until there is a clear outcome.

* Support sales proposals and customer follow-up.

* Assist with invoices and payment follow-up.

* Maintain accurate information in Asana.

* Coordinate events and travel.

* Identify speaking, podcast, partnership, and visibility opportunities.

* Anticipate problems before they become emergencies.

* Bring solutions and recommended next steps.



**We are looking for an Executive Assistant who takes ownership—not someone who simply waits for instructions.**



---



# CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



## 1. CEO Calendar & Schedule Management



Manage and protect the CEO's calendar, including:



* Client meetings

* Sales meetings

* Internal meetings

* Speaking engagements

* Conferences

* Networking events

* Business appointments

* Travel

* Focus time

* Personal appointments when requested



Responsibilities include:



* Scheduling and confirming meetings.

* Preventing scheduling conflicts.

* Coordinating reschedules.

* Confirming attendees, locations, and meeting links.

* Adding necessary information to calendar appointments.

* Preparing reminders.

* Ensuring the CEO has the information needed before meetings and events.



**Performance Standard: Zero preventable scheduling errors or missed meetings.**



---



## 2. CEO
 & Communication Management



Assist with managing the CEO's Outlook inbox and business communications.



Responsibilities include:



* Reviewing incoming
s.

* Identifying urgent and priority communications.

* Organizing messages requiring CEO attention.

* Drafting professional responses.

* Sending approved communications on behalf of the CEO.

* Following up on unanswered communications.

* Keeping important conversations from getting buried.

* Maintaining professional communication across
, text, phone, and approved business channels.



You must be comfortable communicating with:



* Clients

* Prospects

* Property managers

* Vendors

* Business partners

* Event organizers

* Podcast hosts

* Community organizations

* Sales contacts

* Internal team members



**Excellent written and spoken English is required.**



---



# 3. Sales Proposals & Follow-Up



Support the CEO and sales team with proposal administration and follow-through.



Responsibilities include:



* Sending approved proposals.

* Following up after sales meetings.

* Tracking proposals in Asana.

* Maintaining organized prospect information.

* Tracking follow-up dates.

* Documenting next steps.

* Organizing business cards and sales contacts.

* Following up until there is a clear outcome.

* Escalating opportunities requiring CEO involvement.

* Attending weekly sales meetings.

* Preparing proposal and follow-up KPIs.



We expect **professional persistence**.



A proposal should not disappear because nobody remembered to follow up.



---



# 4. Commercial Cleaning Industry Support



Previous experience with a **commercial cleaning company is strongly preferred**.



Relevant backgrounds include:



* Commercial cleaning

* Janitorial services

* Residential cleaning

* Facility services

* Property services

* Building services

* Other recurring field-service businesses



Experience with the following is valuable:



* Commercial cleaning accounts

* Property managers

* Facility managers

* Cleaning crews

* Field employees

* Customer communication

* Service scheduling

* Recurring accounts

* Proposals and bids

* Sales follow-up

* Quality-control communication

* Customer complaints

* Coordinating between clients, office staff, salespeople, and field crews



You do not need to know our entire operation on Day 1.



You **do** need to learn quickly, take accurate notes, retain information, and understand how the pieces of the business connect.



---



# 5. Xero — Customer Invoice Administration



Previous **Xero experience is strongly preferred**.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating customer invoices.

* Sending approved invoices.

* Locating customer invoices.

* Reviewing invoice status.

* Confirming customer information.

* Assisting with routine invoice administration.

* Following up professionally regarding outstanding invoices.

* Documenting customer communication.

* Escalating invoice discrepancies to the appropriate person.



You should understand the difference between routine invoice administration and accounting.



### Financial Responsibility Boundary



This position is **not responsible for:**



* Company bookkeeping

* Payroll

* Financial reporting

* Paying company bills

* Bank reconciliation

* Company financial management



Those responsibilities remain with company leadership and/or accounting personnel.



---



# 6. Stripe — Payment Administration



Previous **Stripe experience is strongly preferred**.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating or sending approved payment links.

* Reviewing customer payment status.

* Assisting with routine payment questions.

* Following up on outstanding customer payments.

* Documenting payment-related communications.

* Escalating disputes, refunds, discrepancies, or unusual situations to management.



Accuracy, professionalism, and confidentiality are required when working with payment information.



---



# 7. CEO Brand Growth, Speaking & Public Relations



This position is expected to help **create opportunities**.



You will proactively research opportunities for the CEO, including:



* Podcasts

* Speaking engagements

* Conferences

* Panels

* Business events

* Networking opportunities

* Community events

* Award nominations

* Media opportunities

* Strategic relationships



Responsibilities include:



* Researching qualified opportunities.

* Maintaining a rolling opportunity pipeline.

* Identifying application deadlines.

* Conducting professional outreach.

* Submitting applications.

* Sending approved bios and headshots.

* Coordinating speaker information.

* Following up with organizers.

* Tracking responses.

* Documenting next steps.



We do not want someone simply waiting for opportunities to arrive.



**Part of your responsibility is helping find them.**



---



# 8. Southern Diva Living Brand Partnerships



Support Southern Diva Living with brand affiliations, partnerships, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching potential partners.

* Conducting approved outreach.

* Coordinating sponsorships.

* Tracking affiliate relationships.

* Managing discount codes.

* Tracking partnership requirements.

* Communicating with brand contacts.

* Tracking deliverables and deadlines.

* Following up on outstanding items.



Every active partnership should have a documented:



* Contact

* Status

* Commitment

* Deadline

* Deliverable

* Next action



---



# 9. Event & Sponsorship Coordination



Coordinate administrative and logistical requirements for events, conferences, sponsorships, speaking engagements, and networking opportunities.



Responsibilities include:



* Registering the CEO for events.

* Completing event portals and forms.

* Processing approved sponsorship registrations.

* Submitting logos.

* Submitting headshots.

* Submitting bios.

* Providing advertisements and links.

* Confirming tickets.

* Confirming guest counts.

* Confirming arrival times.

* Confirming locations.

* Confirming setup requirements.

* Confirming dress requirements when applicable.

* Coordinating promotional materials and giveaways.

* Tracking event deadlines.

* Maintaining event preparation checklists.



**The CEO should arrive prepared.**



Important event requirements should not become last-minute surprises.



---



# 10. Travel Coordination



Coordinate approved CEO business travel.



Responsibilities include:



* Researching flights.

* Booking approved flights.

* Researching and booking approved hotels.

* Coordinating ground transportation.

* Coordinating rental cars when needed.

* Organizing confirmation numbers.

* Preparing itineraries.

* Adding travel details to the calendar.

* Organizing relevant event information.



Travel information should be accurate, organized, and easily accessible before departure.



---



# 11. Asana & Executive Project Management



**Asana will be the primary task-management and accountability system for this position.**



Responsibilities include:



* Creating tasks.

* Setting deadlines.

* Tracking CEO commitments.

* Tracking sales follow-ups.

* Tracking proposals.

* Tracking customer follow-ups.

* Tracking event requirements.

* Tracking partnerships.

* Tracking speaking opportunities.

* Updating task status.

* Documenting outcomes.

* Following up on overdue items.

* Escalating items requiring CEO decisions.



You are expected to **close loops**.



When you identify a problem, whenever possible bring:



**Problem ? Options ? Recommended Solution**



Do not simply forward problems to the CEO that you could reasonably help solve.



---



# 12. Light Personal Executive Support



Occasionally assist with reasonable personal executive-support requests.



Examples may include:



* Reservations

* Appointments

* Online orders

* Household items

* Pet items

* Personal-care products

* Routine purchases

* Other reasonable administrative requests



Personal information must be handled with **strict confidentiality and discretion**.



---



# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Candidates must have:



* Excellent written English

* Excellent spoken English

* Professional business communication skills

* Strong organization

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong follow-through

* Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities

* Good judgment

* Professional discretion

* Strong research skills

* Problem-solving ability

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines

* Ability to learn new systems quickly

* Confidence communicating with U.S.-based clients and business professionals

* Reliable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Backup internet

* Reasonable backup plan for power interruptions

* Quiet and professional remote workspace

* Consistent availability during required working hours



---



# PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Candidates with several of the following will receive additional consideration:



* Executive Assistant experience

* Commercial cleaning experience

* Janitorial industry experience

* Residential cleaning experience

* Facility-services experience

* Property-services experience

* Xero

* Stripe

* Asana

* Microsoft Outlook

* Microsoft 365

* AutoMaid

* Homebase

* Canva

* Sales proposal administration

* Customer invoice administration

* Accounts-receivable follow-up

* Event coordination

* Travel coordination

* Business development

* Speaking or podcast outreach

* Brand partnerships



Spanish is helpful but **not required**.



---



# SYSTEMS & TECHNOLOGY



You should be comfortable using or learning:



* **Asana**

* **Microsoft Outlook**

* **Microsoft 365**

* **Xero**

* **Stripe**

* **AutoMaid**

* **Homebase**

* **Canva**

* **ChatGPT**

* **Microsoft Copilot**

* Company phone and text systems



We encourage responsible use of AI to increase productivity.



AI may assist with:



* Research

* Drafting

* Organization

* Brainstorming

* Translation

* Summarization



However:



**AI does not replace judgment, fact-checking, attention to detail, or accountability.**



---



# WORK SCHEDULE



This is a **full-time position requiring 40 hours per week.**



### Monday–Friday



### 8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time



You must be consistently available and actively working during these hours.



**Do not apply if you cannot reliably work this schedule.**



Candidates should disclose any other jobs or ongoing client commitments that could interfere with this schedule.



---



# COMPENSATION



### $6 USD Per Hour



### 40 Hours Per Week



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



Strong performance, reliability, increased responsibility, and demonstrated ability to operate independently may create opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement.



---



# PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS & KPIs



Performance will be measured based on results and reliability.



Key standards include:



* Zero preventable scheduling errors.

* Priority communications handled promptly during business hours.

* Asana maintained accurately and consistently.

* Assigned proposals tracked with clear next steps.

* Sales follow-ups completed by deadline.

* Invoice follow-ups properly documented.

* Active opportunities have clear next actions.

* Weekly sales KPIs prepared.

* Speaking, podcast, award, event, and partnership pipeline maintained.

* Event and sponsorship requirements completed on time.

* Partnership commitments completed by deadline.

* Travel logistics confirmed before CEO departure.

* CEO commitments properly tracked.

* Open tasks consistently followed through to completion.



**Being busy is not the same as producing results.**



---



# DO NOT APPLY IF



This role is not a fit if:



* You cannot consistently work **8:00 AM–4:00 PM U.S. Central Time, Monday–Friday**.

* You have another full-time job that conflicts with these hours.

* You regularly miss deadlines.

* You need repeated reminders.

* You disappear during scheduled working hours.

* You have unreliable internet without backup.

* You struggle to communicate professionally in English.

* You are uncomfortable communicating with clients and business professionals.

* You are uncomfortable following up with people.

* You wait for instructions before taking obvious next steps.

* You frequently forget assignments.

* You cannot manage multiple priorities.

* You resist learning new technology.

* You are looking for a low-responsibility data-entry position.

* You applied without reading the entire job description.



We do not expect perfection.



We expect **integrity, accountability, attention to detail, communication, and follow-through.**



---



# HOW TO APPLY



**Generic applications will not be considered.**



Follow the instructions below carefully.



## Step 1 — Attention-to-Detail Test



The **FIRST LINE** of your application must say exactly:



**Protect the CEO's Time**



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be reviewed.



---



## Step 2 — Introduction



In **150 words or less**, tell us:



1. Who you are.

2. Where in the Philippines you are located.

3. How many years of Executive Assistant/VA experience you have.

4. Why you believe you are a strong candidate for this position.



---



## Step 3 — Commercial Cleaning Experience



Tell us whether you have worked for a:



* Commercial cleaning company

* Janitorial company

* Residential cleaning company

* Facility-services company

* Property-services company



If yes, explain:



* Type of company

* Your position

* Length of employment

* Main responsibilities

* Commercial or residential accounts supported

* Experience communicating with clients

* Experience communicating with cleaning crews or field employees



If you have no cleaning-industry experience, state that clearly.



---



## Step 4 — Xero & Stripe Test



Answer each question separately:



1. How many years/months have you used **Xero**?

2. What tasks did you personally perform in Xero?

3. How many years/months have you used **Stripe**?

4. What tasks did you personally perform in Stripe?

5. Have you personally created and sent customer invoices?

6. Have you professionally followed up on overdue invoices?

7. Have you worked with recurring customer payments?



**Do not simply write "Xero — Expert" or "Stripe — Expert."**



Explain what you actually did.



---



## Step 5 — Written Communication Test



Write a short professional
 to a hypothetical podcast host introducing our CEO and asking whether the podcast is currently accepting guest applications.



Keep the
 professional and concise.



---

title: Client Care & SEO/GEO Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
At Helen Oliveri Real Estate, we believe exceptional client service and a powerful digital presence go hand in hand. Every conversation is an opportunity to build trust, and every piece of digital content is an opportunity to help clients find us when they need real estate expertise.



We are looking for a tech savvy, highly organized, dependable Client Care & SEO/GEO Digital Marketing Assistant who combines outstanding communication skills with a strong understanding of SEO, GEO, Google, digital content, and online visibility.



This is not strictly an administrative or receptionist position. While you will be an important point of contact for our clients and assist with phones, scheduling, showings, and client communications, a significant part of this role will involve working alongside our tech and marketing team to strengthen our brokerage's digital footprint.



The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between client communication and technical digital marketing tasks throughout the day. You may be scheduling a showing or assisting a client one moment and optimizing a blog, researching keywords, working on Google visibility, or helping improve content for AI search engines the next.



**Schedule:** Thursday through Monday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST with a 30 minute lunch, with Tuesday and Wednesdays off. 



Digital Marketing, SEO, GEO & Google Responsibilities



* Assist our tech and marketing department with ongoing SEO and GEO initiatives designed to increase the brokerage's visibility across traditional search engines and AI powered search platforms.

* Assist with researching, writing, editing, publishing, and optimizing SEO focused blog content.

* Understand and implement on page SEO fundamentals, including keyword placement, titles, headings, internal linking, metadata, content structure, image optimization, and search intent.

* Assist with **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies to improve how our brokerage and content are discovered, understood, cited, and surfaced by AI powered search and answer platforms.

* Conduct keyword, topic, competitor, and search intent research to identify opportunities for new content.

* Assist with maintaining and optimizing our Google Business Profiles and other Google properties.

* Help create, optimize, publish, and monitor Google Business Profile content and updates.

* Understand the importance of local SEO, Google Maps visibility, citations, reviews, business information consistency, and location based search.

* Assist with analyzing search performance and identifying opportunities to improve rankings, traffic, engagement, and conversions.

* Work within Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, Google Workspace, and other digital marketing platforms.

* Research changes and emerging best practices involving Google Search, local SEO, GEO, AI search, and digital marketing.

* Assist the tech department with website content updates, digital research, data organization, testing, and other technology related projects.

* Use AI tools thoughtfully and efficiently while maintaining accuracy, quality, brand voice, and human oversight.

* Follow established SEO, GEO, content, and publishing processes while looking for opportunities to improve them.



Client Care & Administrative Responsibilities



* Answer incoming phone calls with professionalism, warmth, and confidence.

* Make outbound calls to clients, prospective clients, vendors, and agents to provide updates, coordinate appointments, answer questions, and deliver an exceptional client experience.

* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, texts, and
s.

* Schedule showings, appointments, and other real estate related activities.

* Coordinate calendars and assist with client communications throughout the buying and selling process.

* Build genuine relationships with clients through outstanding communication and thoughtful follow up.

* Serve as a coordinator for our VIP Client Program and client appreciation events.

* Help ensure every client feels informed, valued, and cared for from their first conversation through closing and beyond.

* Assist with listings, showings, lockbox coordination, and transaction support.

* Complete administrative, research, and data entry tasks with exceptional accuracy.

* Support agents and staff with day to day office operations.

* Maintain organized systems and consistently follow established processes.

* Take ownership of responsibilities and follow through until every task is completed.

* Assist with additional technical, marketing, client care, and administrative projects as needed.



Technical Skills We're Looking For



We are specifically looking for someone who is comfortable with technology and genuinely interested in search, Google, SEO, GEO, and digital marketing.



The ideal candidate has experience with or a strong working knowledge of:



Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**

Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI search**

Google Business Profile**

Google Search Console**

Google Analytics**

Google Workspace**

Local SEO and Google Maps optimization

Keyword and search intent research

Blog and website content optimization

On page SEO

AI tools and AI assisted content workflows

Website content management systems

Digital research and performance analysis



Experience with additional SEO, website, analytics, AI, or digital marketing platforms is a strong plus.



**Please be prepared to discuss your SEO, GEO, Google, digital marketing, and technology experience during the interview process.**



We're Looking For Someone Who Is



* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills and a clear, professional speaking voice.

* Comfortable communicating with clients by phone throughout the workday.

* Technically capable and comfortable learning new software, platforms, and digital tools.

* Experienced with SEO, digital marketing, Google, website content, or a closely related field.

* Curious about AI search and GEO and motivated to stay current as search technology evolves.

* Analytical and capable of researching a problem rather than waiting for someone else to provide the answer.

* An excellent writer and editor who understands the difference between simply creating content and creating content strategically for search.

* Detail oriented and able to spot errors in content, data, links, business information, and digital listings.

* Friendly, positive, personable, and naturally enjoys helping people.

* Exceptionally reliable, punctual, and committed to showing up prepared every day.

* Someone who follows through on commitments without requiring constant reminders.

* Highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.

* Able to switch between technical work and client facing responsibilities without sacrificing accuracy or professionalism.

* A proactive problem solver who takes initiative.

* Adaptable, dependable, and capable of working independently while meeting deadlines.

* A true team player who can be trusted with important client interactions as well as important digital projects.



Why Join Helen Oliveri Real Estate?



Helen Oliveri Real Estate is an independent real estate brokerage known for exceptional client experiences, innovative marketing, technology, and a commitment to staying ahead of an evolving real estate industry.



Our approach to marketing extends far beyond simply posting homes online. We are continually working to strengthen our presence across Google, traditional search engines, local search, AI powered search, and emerging digital platforms.



In this position, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of real estate, technology, digital marketing, SEO, GEO, Google, and client experience.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in being dependable, enjoys technology, loves solving problems, and wants to continue developing their digital marketing skills while being part of a high performing team.



If you're the type of person who can provide an exceptional client experience, research why a page isn't performing well on Google, optimize a blog for search, learn a new piece of software, and confidently tackle a technical problem, we'd love to meet you.



**Please Note:** The wage is clearly listed. Please do not apply if it does not align with your expectations.



## When Applying



Please send us an **audio or video recording** that includes the following:



**1. Provide our phone greeting:**



"Good morning. Thank you for choosing Helen Oliveri Real Estate. How may I help you?"



**2. Give us a brief introduction.**



Tell us who you are, what interested you most about this position, and why you believe your combination of communication and technical skills would make you a strong fit.



**3. Tell us about your SEO and Google experience.**



Briefly describe your experience with SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, local SEO, blogging, GEO, AI search, or other digital marketing tools.



**4. Answer this scenario:**



If you noticed that a blog or webpage was not performing well in Google Search, what would you review or investigate to determine why?



**5. Tell us how you approach new technology.**



If you were asked to complete a task using software you had never used before and were unsure how to proceed, what steps would you take to figure it out?



We look forward to hearing from you and reviewing your submission.

Project Scope

* Shaded outdoor seating / entrance area

* Consideration of privacy between rooms and neighbouring properties

* Good use of the available site

* Contemporary architectural appearance suitable for an East African residential environment

* Basic exterior 3D visualisations showing the proposed finished appearance



The building should feel modern, practical, attractive and buildable, rather than being designed purely for visual effect.



Required Deliverables

    * Overall dimensions

When Applying

* Architectural judgement

* Communication

Project Type
