title: Controller (Remote, Full-Time Contractor)
description:
# Controller — NetSuite and Inventory Accounting



**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time

This is a fixed overnight shift for Philippines-based applicants. Apply only if you can sustain this schedule long-term.



**Compensation:** $2,500 USD per month, paid semi-monthly via Wise



## About the Role



MeetBookkeepers is a US-based outsourced accounting firm. We are hiring a Controller to own the full accounting function for a premium wine retail client in New York.



This is a hands-on, single-account role responsible for the client’s financial operations from daily transaction processing through monthly financial reporting. The position includes full responsibility for accounts payable, bank and credit card reconciliations, inventory accounting, month-end close, cash monitoring, and financial statement preparation.



You will report to MeetBookkeepers, not directly to the client.



## Responsibilities



* Perform daily bank reconciliations for three bank accounts and one credit card account in NetSuite.

* Own the complete accounts payable process, including reviewing invoices, entering bills, confirming coding and supporting documentation, resolving discrepancies, and preparing payment queues.

* Verify vendor information and payment instructions before payments are released.

* Monitor outstanding bills, payment due dates, vendor statements, credits, and aging reports.

* Investigate duplicate bills, altered payment instructions, unusual vendor requests, and other potential payment issues.

* Communicate with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice, payment, and documentation discrepancies.

* Maintain complete and accurate accounts payable records, including invoices, approvals, payment confirmations, and vendor documentation.

* Own the monthly close process, including journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and completion of the close checklist according to a fixed calendar.

* Prepare monthly financial statements, including the Profit and Loss Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Statement, delivered on schedule and ready for review.

* Maintain inventory accounting integrity, including cost of goods sold, inventory valuation, shrinkage, adjustment entries, and reconciliation of the inventory subledger to the general ledger.

* Maintain the integrity of the NetSuite general ledger, including the chart of accounts, vendor and customer records, and subledger tie-outs.

* Monitor the client’s cash position daily and immediately flag potential liquidity concerns to firm management.

* Identify and correct posting errors, synchronization discrepancies, reconciliation differences, and process gaps without waiting to be asked.

* Maintain accurate accounting documentation and provide clear explanations for transactions, adjustments, reconciliations, and financial results.

* Communicate significant accounting issues, unusual transactions, payment risks, and unresolved discrepancies to firm management.



## Requirements



* Expert-level NetSuite proficiency is non-negotiable. You must be fluent in the general ledger, accounts payable, subledgers, inventory modules, reconciliation tools, financial reporting, and saved searches. You will be asked to explain your NetSuite experience in detail.

* Five or more years of progressive accounting experience, including full ownership of a monthly close.

* Hands-on accounts payable experience, including invoice processing, vendor reconciliation, payment preparation, expense coding, and discrepancy resolution.

* Hands-on inventory accounting experience, including cost of goods sold, valuation methods, inventory reconciliation, and adjustment entries in a product-based business.

* Experience with liquor, wine, spirits, or beverage distribution businesses is strongly preferred. Familiarity with alcohol-industry purchasing and inventory practices is a significant advantage.

* Proven experience preparing complete financial statement packages, including cash flow statements.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, duplicate transactions, and unusual payment activity.

* Excellent written and spoken English. You will communicate directly with firm management regarding financial matters.

* Reliable overnight availability, stable internet, and a backup power solution.

* Prior experience working at an outsourced accounting firm or BPO serving US clients is preferred.



## How to Apply



Send a short cover note in English that includes:



* Specific details about your NetSuite experience, including the modules you have used, close processes you have owned, and reports or saved searches you have built.

* A description of your inventory accounting experience.

* A description of your hands-on accounts payable experience, including invoice volume, payment processing, and vendor reconciliation.

* The size and complexity of the largest accounting function for which you have been responsible.

* Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.



Applications submitted without the required cover note will not be reviewed.

We are looking for a thoughtful, proactive, and relationship-focused VA Success Manager to support Virtual Assistants before and after they are placed with clients.

This role is responsible for helping VAs succeed through onboarding, readiness training, healthcare training, coaching, engagement check-ins, performance follow-up, documentation, and escalation support.

This is not a recruiting or sourcing role. Talent acquisition is handled separately.

The ideal candidate has experience supporting or training VAs in healthcare, dental, medical, or healthcare-adjacent roles. This person should be comfortable coaching remote tea
mbers, identifying performance risks early, and helping VAs understand the communication, professionalism, documentation, and service standards expected in healthcare client environments. This role requires strong judgment, curiosity, emotional intelligence, and the ability to balance empathy with accountability.

Identify early warning signs such as disengagement, poor responsiveness, missed expectations, communication issues, or role mismatch

Help create recovery or improvement plans when concerns arise

Track whether coaching and action plans are improving performance

Escalate concerns or recommend replacement when performance thresholds are not being met

Support strong VA retention by improving readiness, role clarity, communication, and support



Client Success Team Partnership

Partner with Client Success Managers to understand client feedback, expectations, and performance concerns

Coordinate coaching priorities based on client feedback

Help determine whether an issue is related to training, communication, performance, role fit, or expectation mismatch

Support structured recovery and action plans when client or VA concerns arise

Communicate risks, trends, and recommendations clearly to the internal team

Work cross-functionally with Client Success, Recruitment, Operations, and Leadership to improve outcomes



Documentation & Follow-Through

Attendance

Evaluations

Recordings

Coaching notes

Engagement check-ins

Escalation logs

Exit notes

Recommendations

Track follow-up items until resolved

Keep records organized and easy for leadership and the client success team to review

Provide monthly summaries to leadership on VA status, risks, coaching needs, and recommendations

Ensure no performance concern, follow-up, or escalation falls through the cracks



Program Improvement

Recommend improvements to orientation, onboarding, healthcare training, hiring filters, communication standards, and lifecycle processes

Help improve playbooks, templates, trackers, training materials, and coaching workflows

Use dashboards, documentation, AI tools, or automation to improve visibility, productivity, and retention over time



Required Experience

Experience supporting, coaching, training, or managing Virtual Assistants or remote tea
mbers

Healthcare, dental, medical, orthodontic, or healthcare-adjacent training experience required

Experience helping tea
mbers understand healthcare client expectations, communication standards, professionalism, and documentation requirements

Strong written and spoken English communication

Strong documentation and follow-up habits

Reliable, responsive, organized, and highly professional



What This Role Is Not

This role is about preparing, supporting, coaching, and retaining VAs, especially those serving healthcare-related clients. mber in a healthcare-related role

title: CRM & Marketing Operations Specialist (GoHighLevel)
description:
About the Role

We are a Texas-based real estate investment firm. We are building the systems behind our investor

relationships and need a capable, hands-on operator to build and run them.



This is a build-and-operate role, not a data-entry role. The first ninety days are a defined build project with clear deliverables.

If that goes well, this becomes a long-term position with more hours, more responsibility and higher compensation.

Website and funnel design are handled by a separate designer. You own the CRM, the automation and the data.



First 90 Days — Deliverables

1. Migrate, clean and deduplicate our full contact database into GoHighLevel.

2. Build the investor pipeline: stages, tags, custom fields and segmentation (existing investors, prospects, referral sources,

capital partners).

3. Build the core automated sequences: new lead nurture, post-meeting follow-up, and ongoing investor updates.

4. Build a separate pipeline for family offices, RIAs and JV/institutional capital groups, with fields for check size,

geography, strategy, structure and contact history.

5. Build a reporting dashboard: new contacts by source, pipeline movement, engagement, and database growth.

6. Document how everything works, so it is maintainable by someone other than you.

Ongoing Responsibilities



GoHighLevel & CRM

• Build and maintain pipelines, workflows, triggers and automations.

• Keep contact records accurate: import, clean, deduplicate and enrich.

• Build forms and booking workflows that feed the correct pipelines.

• Troubleshoot workflows and integrations.

• Identify repetitive work and automate it.



 & Investor Communication

• Build and schedule campaigns, newsletters and investor updates.

• Segment audiences by interest, engagement and investor profile.

• Track opens, clicks, replies and meetings booked.

• Maintain list hygiene and deliverability.



Research & Database Building

• Research family offices, RIAs, capital partners and referral sources, and document their investment criteria.

• Enrich CRM records with accurate contact and organizational information.

• Build prospect lists for the principals and the Investor Growth Manager.



Content Support

• Draft and edit
s, newsletters and landing-page copy.

• Turn notes, transcripts and recordings from leadership into polished written content.

• Use AI tools to work faster, but edit everything. We can tell when you have not.

• Create basic graphics in Canva.



Reporting

Maintain a simple dashboard showing where relationships are actually coming from and what is converting. Activity is not

the goal; relationships are.



Additional Responsibilities

We are a lean company. You may occasionally help with research, transaction coordination, data-room organization or

presentation preparation. Your core focus remains CRM and marketing operations.



Tools

Required: GoHighLevel (strong hands-on experience), Google Workspace, spreadsheets.

Helpful: Zapier or Make, Canva, ChatGPT or Claude,
 marketing platforms, LinkedIn.

Not required: Google Ads, video editing, web design. We have those covered.



You Are a Strong Fit If You

• Have built GoHighLevel workflows and pipelines yourself, not merely used them.

• Write clearly in English.

• Use AI daily and understand its limits.

• Are extremely organized and detail-oriented.

• Work independently and tell us promptly when something is broken.

• Learn new software quickly.

• Want a long-term role that grows in scope and pay.



Real estate experience is helpful but not required.



Please Do Not Apply If You

• Have only data-entry experience in GoHighLevel.

• Need step-by-step instruction for every assignment.

• Send unedited AI-generated content.

• Consider yourself exclusively a social media manager.

• Routinely miss deadlines or require repeated follow-up.



Schedule

20–25 hours per week to start, with a clear path to more. We are based in Texas on U.S. Central Time and need several hours

of daily overlap for meetings and collaboration. This is intended as a long-term position, not a short freelance project.

Compensation

$700–$1,100 USD per month for 20–25 hours per week, depending on experience and demonstrated skill.

Strong performers will move to additional hours and higher compensation after the initial build period. Exceptional

GoHighLevel and automation specialists may command more.



How to Apply



Begin your application with the words “BUILD THE MACHINE” so we know you read the full description.



Please include:

1. Your GoHighLevel experience, with screenshots of workflows or pipelines you have built.

2. One automation you designed and the problem it solved.

3. A writing sample — an
 or newsletter you wrote yourself.

4. The AI tools you currently use in your work.

5. Your desired monthly rate and available hours.

6. Your time zone and normal working hours.

title: SMS and Marketing Manager for US Land Investment Company
description:
JMW Land Co. buys vacant land in the US directly from owners and resells it to builders. Marketing brings us our deals. This seat owns it.



This is a full time role, main working hours 9 to 5 US Eastern.



You start with SMS, which is our biggest channel today. As you get strong there, this role grows into our other channels: direct mail,
, and potentially our website. The right person ends up running marketing for the company, not just running texts.



On SMS you build and send the campaigns, keep our numbers healthy, and personally work every reply until a qualified seller agrees to a call with our sales team. Everything runs in our CRM (we use GoHighLevel).



We are hiring a person, not a task doer. The best people in this seat are warm, curious, and genuinely likeable, and they are also disciplined with data. If you are one without the other, this is not the right role.



WHAT YOU OWN



- Building and launching campaigns from our cleaned lists, on schedule

- Deliverability: delivery rates, opt outs, number rotation, message variation

- Working every reply within 2 minutes. You are the assistant and analyst, not a salesperson. You never quote a price. We give you the full playbook.

- Valuing the lot before you hand it off. You will learn to comp a property: what similar lots are listed at, what they actually sold for, and what the land is worth to a builder. If you have never done this, we will teach you. You do need to be able to learn it fast and apply it the same way every time.

- Handing a confirmed call to our sales team immediately, with complete notes

- A one page end of day report, and a current KPI tracker

- Over time, our direct mail,
, and web marketing as we expand into those channels



WHAT WE MEASURE



Speed to first reply - 2 minutes or less

Qualified out of positive replies - 50 percent or better

Replies that reach a call ask - 40 percent or better

End of day report - every working day



WHAT WE NEED



- Great personality. Warm, human, curious, easy to talk to. You are texting real American property owners, not running a script.

- Someone who likes being on calls. We run daily Zoom with our team, and you should be comfortable on camera and willing to hop on a call with a seller when a call is what wins the deal. If you would rather hide behind a keyboard, this is not the seat.

- A strong data background. Clean spreadsheets, careful numbers, and the discipline to never guess a figure. Solid Google Sheets required.

- Real estate experience. Land, wholesaling, acquisitions support, or agent side work. This is the single strongest thing you can bring and we will pay more for it.

- Willingness to learn property valuation. We teach comping. We do not teach attention to detail.

- A real team player. You work hand in hand with our sales team every day, hand off leads cleanly, take feedback without ego, and speak up when something is not working.

- Excellent written and spoken English, warm and human, not corporate.

- Real experience running SMS or cold outreach at volume, and real CRM experience. GoHighLevel strongly preferred.

- Understanding of SMS deliverability and opt out handling.

- Ambition to grow into a broader marketing role. Direct mail,
, or web experience is a real plus.

- Steady temperament. You will get rude replies and you answer every one graciously.

- Reliable internet, a working webcam, and your own computer.

- Availability to work 9 to 5 US Eastern, full time. This as your only full time role.



COMPENSATION



600 USD per month base, full time salary, paid every month regardless of how many deals close.



DEAL BONUS on top of base. You earn a bonus on every deal our team closes, and the rate goes up as the month gets better.



Deals 1 to 10 - 25 USD each

Deals 11 to 15 - 50 USD each

Deals 16 and up - 100 USD each



The tiers stack, they do not replace each other. A 20 deal month pays 25 each on the first ten, 50 each on the next five, and 100 each on the last five.



10 deals - 600 base + 250 bonus = 850 USD

15 deals - 600 base + 500 bonus = 1,100 USD

20 deals - 600 base + 1,000 bonus = 1,600 USD

25 deals - 600 base + 1,500 bonus = 2,100 USD



The more deals our sales team closes, the more you make. Every one of those deals starts with a campaign you sent and a conversation you handled. This is a team sport and you are paid like part of the team. As you take on more channels, your pay grows with the role.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer these three questions. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.



1. An owner replies to our text with only "How much?" Write your exact next message, word for word. Remember we do not quote prices.



2. What is your real estate background, and what SMS platforms and CRMs have you worked in? Describe one campaign you built yourself, roughly how many messages went out, and your reply rate. Tell us about any direct mail,
, or web marketing you have run.



3. Delivery on one of our sending numbers drops from 95 percent to 60 percent overnight. What do you check first, and what do you tell us?



Also confirm you can work 9 to 5 US Eastern full time, that you are comfortable on Zoom calls, and that you are not committed to another full time client.

title: Experienced Credit Repair Disputer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Disputer / Virtual Assistant to assist with the credit repair side of our company.



This is not an entry-level credit repair position. While we provide training on our company's specific dispute process, applicants must already have hands-on experience with credit repair disputing and must be familiar with DisputeFox.



The primary responsibility of this position will be preparing, reviewing, and submitting dispute rounds for clients while following our internal processes and maintaining accurate client records.



Responsibilities



* Prepare and submit credit dispute rounds for clients

* Review client credit reports and identify accounts/items that need to be disputed

* Create and process disputes through DisputeFox

* Follow our company's dispute procedures, timelines, and documentation requirements

* Keep client files and dispute statuses organized and updated

* Review previous dispute results before preparing the next dispute round

* Upload and maintain supporting documentation when necessary

* Contact Equifax, Experian, TransUnion, creditors, or other applicable organizations by phone when certain disputes require call-ins or additional follow-up

* Document the outcome of calls and any actions taken

* Communicate with our team regarding client files, dispute results, missing information, or issues that require additional attention

* Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive consumer and credit information



Required Experience



Applicants must have previous credit repair disputing experience



You must also have:



* Previous experience using DisputeFox

* Experience reviewing consumer credit reports

* Understanding of the credit dispute process

* Experience preparing and submitting credit bureau disputes

* Strong attention to detail

* Good written communication skills

* Strong organization and record keeping skills

* Ability to follow an established dispute process

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple client files

* Reliable internet connection and computer

* Professional English communication skills



Phone Communication



You must be comfortable speaking professionally on the phone.



Certain client situations may require calling credit bureaus or other organizations directly, so applicants should be confident communicating with representatives, asking questions, documenting responses, and following our procedures for call-in disputes.



Work Schedule



This position offers some flexibility, but you must have availability during U.S. Eastern Time hours and be available until at least 12:00 PM EST on scheduled workdays.



This availability is important because some credit bureau and creditor calls must be completed during U.S. business hours.



Compensation



This position is paid per completed dispute round submitted rather than hourly.



Compensation and expected workload will be discussed with qualified applicants.



There may be an opportunity for additional workload and responsibilities as the company and credit repair department continue to grow.



Application Attention Check



We receive applications from people who apply to positions without fully reviewing the job description.



To show that you have read the entire listing, please begin your application with the words:



"DisputeFox Ready"



Then, at the very end of your application, tell us one specific part of this position that you believe you would be particularly good at and why.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



Quality Expectations



Because this position is paid per completed dispute round, we want to be clear that quality and accuracy are more important than speed.



Each client file should be properly reviewed before a dispute round is submitted. We are looking for someone who pays attention to account details, previous dispute results, documentation, and our established procedures rather than simply processing as many files as possible.



Dispute rounds that are incomplete, incorrectly prepared, improperly documented, or do not follow our process may need to be corrected before they are considered completed.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can consistently produce accurate, well-documented dispute rounds.



Training



We have an established dispute process and will train you on how we want disputes handled within our company.



However, this training is intended to teach you our process, not the fundamentals of credit repair.



Applicants should already understand credit reports, credit disputing, dispute rounds, and how to work inside DisputeFox.



To Apply



Please answer each of the questions below in your application:



1. How many years or months of credit repair disputing experience do you have?

2. How long have you used DisputeFox?

3. Briefly describe your normal process for reviewing a client's credit report before preparing a dispute.

4. Are you comfortable making phone calls to credit bureaus when required?

5. What hours are you normally available to work in Eastern Time?



Please do not apply if you do not have previous credit repair disputing experience or have never worked inside DisputeFox.

READ THIS FIRST



This is an hourly, billable-hours role — not a monthly salary. You report your own hours in your daily end-of-shift report. You bill for hours actually worked. We pay for hours actually worked. There's no separate time-tracking software to install or run — we trust your report.



To be clear about what that means: 25 hours per week is guaranteed, not a ceiling you have to earn. We are not going to quietly cut your hours. The schedule is fixed and the work is there.



It cuts both ways:



- You are not expected to be "on" outside your shift. When the shift ends, you're done.

- You are expected to be present for every scheduled shift, on time, for the full window. This is live coverage. If you're not there, our customers aren't covered.



At ?426/hour and 25 hours a week, this pays roughly ?46,000/month — comparable to or better than most full-time VA roles on this board, for 25 hours instead of 40. We're paying above market on purpose, because we'd rather have one excellent person than two average ones.



---



THE SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday, Philippine time. Your weekends are yours.



Period - Your shift (Philippine Time) - Your days



March – November - 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM - Monday through Friday

November – March - 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM - Monday through Friday



The one-hour change happens twice a year when the US clocks shift. We'll give you plenty of notice, but you need to be able to absorb it.



*Why these hours matter so much: our order cutoff with our production partner falls at roughly 12:40 PM your time (1:40 PM during the November–March period). Every size change, cancellation, and address correction that reaches us before that cutoff can still be fixed before the shirt goes to print. Everything after it can't. Your shift exists to catch those. This is the single highest-value window in our entire day.



Weekend coverage is handled by a separate part-time role. You will not be asked to work weekends.



---



WHAT THIS JOB ACTUALLY IS



We're being specific on purpose. A vague job post attracts vague applicants.



1. All customer service — you own it



You are the relationship between our brand and our customers. Not a ticket-closer. The owner.



That means genuinely understanding the whole buyer journey and what a customer experiences at each step:



- How Shopify and Printify talk to each other — and, critically, where they don't

- What happens between "order placed" and "shirt at the door"

- Production windows, shipping windows, carrier behavior, tracking quirks

- Which problems can still be fixed, which can't, and where the cutoff sits on each



You'll handle: where-is-my-order, sizing questions and size changes, cancellations, address changes, damaged and misprinted items, wrong items, lost packages, refunds, exchanges, and the occasional genuinely strange one.



We provide detailed SOPs, response templates, and custom AI tools covering most routine scenarios. Your job is judgment, accuracy, warmth, and escalating the tricky stuff — not inventing policy from scratch.



2. Product publishing



Publishing products from Printify to our Shopify store, and using our in-house tools to generate and match mockups to the correct products, colors, and variants.



This is detail work. A mockup matched to the wrong color variant is a customer complaint waiting to happen.



---



THE THING WE CARE ABOUT MOST: FOLLOWING THE PROCESS EXACTLY



Please read this section twice.



Our workflows have steps that are not optional and not obvious. A real example we can share:



> When a customer asks to change their shipping address, updating it in Shopify is not enough.  Shopify does not push that change to our production partner. If you update only Shopify, the shirt prints and ships to the "old" address. We eat the cost, the customer is upset, and it is unrecoverable.



That's one of many. Most of our SOPs contain a step like it.



*A missed step in a workflow equals money lost. Not "a little sloppy."  Money, directly out of a small business.



There's a second reason this matters here more than at most brands: our helpdesk, Shark Support, is a tool we built ourselves.  There's no public documentation for it, no YouTube tutorial, no previous job where you picked it up. Everything you know about how it works will come from our SOPs and our training — which means reading them carefully isn't a nice habit, it's the whole job. We'll teach you all of it, and we've built the training for someone starting from zero.



So we're not looking for fast. We're looking for someone who:



- Reads the full SOP before acting, every time — including the parts they think they already know

- Completes every step, in order, even when a step feels redundant

- Verifies the result instead of assuming the action worked

- Says "I'm not sure" out loud instead of guessing

- Tells us immediately when they've made a mistake, before we find it



If you're the kind of person bothered by a typo, an inconsistent format, or an unchecked checklist item — we will get along very well.



---



END OF SHIFT REPORT — required, every shift



At the close of every shift you send a written EOD report in Slack. Non-negotiable, and it takes about 10 minutes:



- Hours worked — start, end, total

- Tickets touched — count, plus anything notable

- Refunds issued — count and total amount

- Exchanges / replacements created — count

- Products published — count

- Issues encountered — bullet list. Anything that went wrong, got stuck, or surprised you.

- SOP updates needed — anything unclear, outdated, or missing from our documentation

- Questions — anything you're blocked on



We read these. They're how we spot patterns, fix broken processes, and d
 what to improve. A thoughtful EOD report is one of the most valuable things you'll produce here.



---



AVAILABILITY & TIME OFF



- You'll maintain a shared availability calendar we can both see.

- Time off is requested in advance, not announced. We're reasonable — we just need notice to arrange coverage.

- Outside approved time off, you're expected to be present for your scheduled shift.

- If something urgent comes up and you can't make a shift, tell us as early as you possibly can. Things happen. Silence is the only unacceptable response.



---



COMPENSATION





Rate: ?426 per hour worked

Guaranteed hours:  25/week (5 hours × 5 days) — approximately ?46,000/month

Time tracking: None required — your daily EOD report records hours worked.

Payment:  Via Wise. Weekly for the first 8 weeks, then biweekly.

Paid training: Yes — onboarding hours are billable from day one.

Trial:  Paid trial week before a long-term offer.

Rate reviews:  Performance-based, at 6 months and annually.

Growth: Clear path to more hours as the business grows.



Rates are quoted and paid in pesos, not dollars, so exchange-rate swings never quietly cut your pay.



---



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE — non-negotiable



Applications missing any of these four will not be considered:



1. Hands-on Shopify experience — orders, refunds, customer profiles, basic product management

2. Hands-on Printify experience (or another POD platform — Printful, Gelato, etc.)

3. At least 1 year of e-commerce customer support with a real brand

4. Strong written English that does not need editing before it goes to a customer



---



TOOLS WE USE



Shark Support (our proprietary helpdesk — full training provided) · Shopify · Printify · Slack · Gmail · Google Drive/Sheets · Loox



---



REQUIREMENTS



- Stable internet (speed test screenshot required)

- Backup internet or a reliable mobile hotspot — this is a live coverage role

- Unlimited data plan

- Laptop or desktop with working webcam and microphone

- Able to reliably work Monday–Friday mornings, Philippine time

- Looking for long-term, stable work



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit everything as one single OnlineJobs.ph message. Read the entire post before applying.



A) BASIC INFO

- Full name, city/province

- Internet speed test screenshot

- Your desired hourly rate in PHP

- LinkedIn or portfolio link (if applicable)



B) AVAILABILITY — be honest, we will verify

1. Confirm you can commit to 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM Philippine Time, Monday through Friday (shifting to 9:00 AM – 2:00 PM from November to March).

2. Are you currently working with other clients or employers? List each: type of work, weekly hours, how long you've been with them.

3. Given those commitments, what is your **realistic** weekly capacity for us?

4. If this role grew to more hours over time, what is your maximum weekly availability?

5. Do you have backup internet? Describe it.



C) EXPERIENCE — 3–6 sentences each. Be specific; we can tell when answers are generic.

1. Shopify. Walk us through your most relevant Shopify role. What store, and what did you own end-to-end?

2. Printify / POD. What platform, what brand, what tasks? Order issues, reprints, variant management, uploads? Give a specific example.

3. Process discipline. Describe a multi-step workflow you personally owned. What was the step people most commonly missed — and what did you do to make sure you never missed it?

4. A mistake you made. Tell us about a time you got something wrong at work. How did you find out, what did you do, and what changed afterward? (We're not looking for "I have no weaknesses." We're looking for how you handle being wrong.)

5. Self-starter. A time you saw a problem and fixed it without being asked.



D) FIT

1. Why this role specifically? Not flattery — genuine fit.

2. What would make you leave a job like this one? (Honest answers only. There are no wrong answers, but there are unbelievable ones.)

3. Where do you want to be professionally in 2 years?



E) CUSTOMER SCENARIO



A customer
s:



> "I ordered the shirt in size M based on your size chart and it's WAY too small. I'm 5'4", 140lbs and the chart said M would fit. I'm so frustrated. I want a full refund AND I want you to know your sizing is misleading."



Write the reply you'd send. 4–7 sentences. Don't promise anything outside standard policy — show us your judgment, your tone, and how you de-escalate.



F) SAMPLE EOD REPORT



Write a short sample End of Shift report for an imaginary 5-hour shift. Make up the numbers. We want to see how you organize and communicate information — not how impressive the fake numbers are.



G) DOCUMENTS



Attach your CV or resume.



H) ATTENTION TO DETAIL



Include the word "tidewater" as the first word of your application — but not in the subject line. Applications missing this word are deleted unread.



---



NEXT STEPS



1. We review every application that follows the instructions above.

2. Shortlisted candidates get a one-way recorded video interview, done on your own time.

3. Final candidates do a paid trial week before a long-term offer.



---



FINAL NOTE



We're a small team — a husband-and-wife business, not a call center. We're direct, we're respectful, and we're genuinely invested in the people we hire. Good work gets noticed here because there aren't many of us; there's nowhere for it to hide, in either direction.



If you want a long-term home where you'll be trusted with real ownership and treated like a teammate, we'd love to hear from you.



If you're looking for a job to coast in, this isn't it.

title: Amazon FBA Launch Specialist
description:
We are specifically looking for someone who has personally helped start an Amazon FBA business from the ground up. You must have previous hands-on experience taking an FBA business from product research and sourcing through launch and ongoing operations. SmartScout experience is required.

Amazon FBA Launch & Product Research Specialist – SmartScout Experience Required

We are looking for an experienced Amazon FBA specialist to help us build and launch a new Amazon FBA business from the ground up.

This is NOT an entry-level Amazon VA position. We want someone who has previously worked with successful Amazon FBA businesses and understands the entire process from product research and sourcing through launching products and managing Seller Central.

SmartScout experience is REQUIRED.

Responsibilities

Help develop our Amazon FBA business from the startup stage

Conduct detailed product and niche research using SmartScout

Identify profitable products and opportunities based on real data

Analyze:

Demand and estimated sales

Competition

Seller count

Pricing history

Profit margins

Amazon/FBA fees

ROI

BSR

Market saturation

Brand and category restrictions

Research competitors, brands, sellers, and categories

Identify suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers, or sourcing opportunities

Help evaluate Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, and/or Private Label opportunities

Assist with setting up and managing Amazon Seller Central

Help with product listings, keywords, inventory, FBA shipments, and launch strategy

Create organized spreadsheets showing researched products and recommendations

Explain why a product should or should not be pursued

Help us build systems and SOPs that can eventually be delegated to additional team members

Required Experience

You should have:

2+ years of hands-on Amazon FBA experience preferred

Experience helping launch or grow an Amazon FBA business

Strong experience with SmartScout

Strong understanding of Amazon Seller Central

Experience with Amazon product research and sourcing

Understanding of FBA fees, margins, ROI, Buy Box, BSR, competition, and sales velocity

Ability to identify bad opportunities and potential risks before money is invested

Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills

Good written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

Ability to work independently

Experience with Keepa, SellerAmp, Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar Amazon tools is a plus.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can do more than follow instructions.

We want someone who can look at an opportunity, analyze the numbers, and tell us:

“This is a good product and here's why.”

or

“Don't invest in this product and here's what the data is showing.”

You should be comfortable helping an owner who is building a new Amazon business and providing guidance based on your previous experience.

There is an opportunity for this position to grow into an Amazon FBA Manager / Operations Manager role as the business grows.

Hours & Compensation

Starting: 20 hours per week

Pay: $6–$8 USD/hour depending on experience

Schedule: Flexible

Opportunity for increased hours, raises, and performance bonuses based on results.

How to Apply

Please answer ALL of the following:

How many years of Amazon FBA experience do you have?

Have you ever helped build or launch an Amazon FBA business from the beginning? Explain what you did.

How long have you used SmartScout?

Which SmartScout tools/features do you use most?

What other Amazon research tools have you used?

Walk us through how you determine whether a product is worth selling on Amazon.

Give an example of a profitable product or opportunity you discovered and explain how you found it.

Which Amazon FBA model do you have the most experience with: Wholesale, Online Arbitrage, Retail Arbitrage, or Private Label?

Are you comfortable helping create SOPs and systems as the business grows?

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “SMARTSCOUT FBA” so we know you read the entire job description.

Please also include your resume and, if possible, screenshots or examples of previous Amazon product research with any confidential information removed.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
About Crisp



Crisp is the #1 law firm growth company in the U.S. We are on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.



Crisp has helped thousands of attorneys and law firms build their brands, attract better cases, and generate millions in new revenue. We have been recognized on the Inc. 5000 and featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.



About the Role



We are looking for an exceptional Senior Recruiter to join our growing team. This is a full-cycle recruiting position supporting both Crisp's internal hiring and recruitment for our U.S.-based law firm clients.



We are looking for a recruiter with extensive U.S. recruiting experience, excellent English communication skills, and a highly professional and confident presence. Your ability to communicate naturally and professionally with U.S. candidates, hiring managers, and clients is extremely important.



Experience recruiting for law firms or within the legal industry is a major plus. Experience using Greenhouse ATS is also a plus.



What We're Looking For



You must have strong experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and Indeed, along with proven full-cycle recruiting experience from sourcing through hire. You should be highly proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of independently managing multiple recruiting searches.



We want someone with excellent communication skills who is confident speaking with candidates and clients, presents themselves professionally, and knows how to build trust throughout the recruiting process.



Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, candidate evaluation, follow-up, and pipeline management skills are essential. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, and does not need to be constantly told what to do.



Most importantly, we want a recruiter with a strong recruiter presence who understands how to identify top talent, sell opportunities, conduct high-quality interviews, and represent Crisp and our clients at a high professional level.



Why Crisp?



You will be joining a fast-growing company with a large Filipino team working alongside professionals across the United States. We believe in building a team of the best of the best and creating an environment where high-performing people can grow and make a meaningful impact.



Schedule



Monday–Friday | 8:55 AM–5:00 PM EST



How to Apply



If you believe you are one of the best recruiters in your field, we want to hear from you.



Please record yourself through our Willo assessment:







Please record your video professionally, sound confident, and speak naturally. Do not read your answers. We want to see your communication skills, confidence, professionalism, critical thinking, and recruiter presence.



After completing the video, please send your updated resume to:







Subject line: Crisp Recruiter



We are looking for the best of the best. If that sounds like you, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: DJ / Audio Editor Needed to Turn Wedding Playlist Into One Seamless Mix
description:
We are looking for an experienced DJ or audio editor to take our selected wedding playlist and turn it into one seamless, professionally mixed DJ set.



We will provide the songs and the general order. Your job is to mix them together so the entire playlist feels like one continuous DJ set instead of individual songs starting and stopping.



What we need:



Smooth transitions between songs

Professional beat matching where appropriate

Clean fades, cuts, and transitions

Good energy and flow throughout the mix

Adjust song lengths when needed so songs don't play too long

Keep the important/best parts of each song

Consistent volume throughout

Final mix delivered as a high-quality audio file

Ability to make revisions based on our feedback



This mix will be played at our wedding, so we want someone who understands how to build energy and make the music flow naturally for a wedding/dance floor.



Ideal candidate:



Experience as a DJ or creating DJ mixes

Experience with Serato, Rekordbox, Traktor, Ableton, Logic, FL Studio, or similar software

Good understanding of song structure, BPM, transitions, and crowd energy

Strong attention to detail

Reliable communication

Able to complete the project before our deadline



To apply, please send:



A short introduction about your DJ/audio mixing experience

Links to 1–3 examples of mixes you have created

What software you use



Please start your application with the words “WEDDING DJ MIX” so we know you read the full job post.



This is a one-time project, but we are looking for someone who can make the final result sound like a real DJ professionally mixed the entire wedding playlist from beginning to end.

description:

Nurse Next Door is seeking a detail-oriented Registered Nurse – Clinical Billing & Coding Specialist to support the administrative and financial operations of our growing home health agency. This position focuses on ensuring accurate clinical documentation, OASIS review, coding, billing compliance, and coordination with the clinical team to maximize reimbursement while maintaining the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance.



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of home health billing, ICD-10 coding, OASIS documentation, Medicare regulations, and reimbursement guidelines.

Qualifications:



Required:

-Active Registered Nurse (RN) license.

-Degree or certification in Medical Billing & Coding.

-Experience with OASIS documentation and review.

-Strong knowledge of ICD-10 coding principles.

-Experience working in home health or hospice.

-Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

-Strong written and verbal communication skills.

-Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic medical record systems.



Preferred:

-Certified OASIS Specialist (COS-C) or equivalent certification.

-Home health coding certification (HCS-D or similar).

-Experience with Medicare home health reimbursement and PDGM.

-Previous Quality Assurance or Clinical Documentation Review experience.



Knowledge & Skills:

-Home Health Medicare Conditions of Participation

-OASIS-E documentation and review

-ICD-10-CM coding

-PDGM reimbursement

-Medicare and Medicaid billing

-Claims management and denial resolution

-Regulatory compliance

-Clinical documentation improvement

-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

-Ability to work independently while collaborating with interdisciplinary teams



Monday-Friday United States PST time zone; possible weekends

title: Sales Data & Reporting Auditor
description:
Why This Role Exists



Zion currently manages ~15 sales reps across multiple offers while also running recruiting, interviews, call reviews, and data integrity. Data integrity is the piece with the lowest skill ceiling and the highest time cost.



Per Josh's Framework 6 (Pipeline Management), this is a named, separate seat for a reason:



Josh once had sales managers audit the CRM daily — chasing reps for missed forms, unmarked show-ups, blank fields. It completely destroyed his capacity model for sales management. The fix was a dedicated CRM Admin owning the tech and data side, so managers spend 30 minutes in the CRM and know everything is where it's supposed to be.



The purpose of this role is to protect the sales manager's capacity. Every hour it buys back gets redeployed into call reviews, rep coaching, and client acquisition — the things that actually move revenue.



The Two Audit Paths



Every issue this person finds falls into one of two buckets. They are handled differently. This distinction is the entire job.



Path 1 — Data Accuracy ? the Auditor fixes it



Data that is wrong or missing because of a system gap, not a rep behavior problem.

- Booked call on the calendar with no lead source attribution.

-Lead in CRM with no meeting date attached.

-Duplicate leads or duplicate calendar events

-Calendar event missing setter initials

-Disposition logged but revenue field blank

-Timezone or date errors on booked calls



Action: fix it directly, log it in the daily report as a count.



Path 2 — Rep Non-Compliance ? the Auditor tags, never cleans

-Data that is wrong because a rep didn't do their job.

-Call happened, no disposition logged

-Show / no-show never marked

-Post-call form not completed

-Lead marked lost with no attempt history

-Deal closed with no payment terms entered

-

Action: tag the rep, create the task, escalate in the daily report.  Do not fix it for them.



Non-negotiable, per Josh: "CRM admins audit — they don't clean. Cleaners create lazy reps."



The 
nt reps learn someone downstream cleans up after them, compliance collapses permanently and the data problem becomes structural. The Auditor's job on Path 2 is to make non-compliance visible, not invisible.



Daily Responsibilities



Morning — booked call audit (start of day)Pull every call on the calendar for the current day and produce:



1. Total booked calls today, by closer

2. Source attribution on every booked call — Ads (self-booked) / Phone Setter / DM Setter / Triage / Reschedule / Referral

3. Setter attribution by initials on every setter-sourced call

4. Confirmation status per the calendar color convention:

          Unmarked = unconfirmed

          Red = no answer

          Yellow = text confirmation received

          Light green = same-day confirmation received

5. Exception list — every call with no confirmation touch at all. This is the highest-value output of the morning report. Every unconfirmed call is a booked call at risk, and it is actionable before the call, not after.



End of day — outcome audit

1. Live calls (showed) vs. booked calls, by closer and by setter.

2. Show rate for the day, and rolling 7-day

3. No-shows and cancellations, with reschedule status: rescheduled / attempted, not reached / no attempt made

4. "No attempt made" list — every no-show nobody has touched. Escalate by name.

5. Missing dispositions — every call with no outcome logged, tagged to the rep.

6. Cash collected logged against calls, where applicable



Weekly — rollup

1. Show rate by setter, trended

2. Booked calls by source, trended — which channel is actually producing.

3. Data-accuracy issue counts by type, trended (are the same issues recurring?).

4. Rep non-compliance counts, by rep name



Metrics This Role Owns



Metrics & Definition:



Booked calls / day = Total on calendar, by closer

Source attribution % = % of booked calls with a source recorded. Target: 100%

Confirmation coverage = % of tomorrow's calls with a confirmation touch logged

Live calls / day = Calls that showed

Show rate = Live ÷ booked, daily and rolling 7-day

Reschedule capture rate = % of no-shows with a documented reschedule attempt

Disposition compliance = % of completed calls with an outcome logged

Data accuracy issues = Count found, count fixed, by category



Show rate belongs to the setter and confirmation layer. It is never a closer metric. This role reports it against setters, not closers.



Explicitly NOT This Role

- Not a sales role. 

- No dialing, no setting, no closing, no prospect contact.

- Not a call reviewer. Call quality grading stays with Zion.

- Not a coach. They report data on reps. They never give reps feedback or direction.

- Not a cleaner for rep non-compliance. See Path 2 above.

- Not the person who d
 what the numbers mean. They report accurately and flag anomalies. Interpretation and action are Zion's.



Required Skills:

-Must have



- High-volume, detail-heavy data work with near-zero error tolerance

- CRM competence — Close CRM strongly preferred; HubSpot / Salesforce / GHL acceptable

- Google Sheets: pivot tables, lookups, conditional formatting

- Google Calendar

- Slack

- Written English clear enough to write a report a manager reads in 60 seconds

Overlap with US Eastern business hours



Nice to have

- Zapier or Make

- Experience inside a sales team (understands what a booked call, show rate, and disposition actually are)

- Prior audit or QA role



Disqualifying

- Needs to be told the same thing twice

- Reports numbers without flagging when a number looks wrong



Reporting Cadence



When - What - Where



Daily, by 9:00 AM ET - Morning booked-call audit + unconfirmed exception list - Slack

Daily, within 30 min of last call - EOD outcome audit + no-attempt list - Slack

Weekly, Monday AM - Rolling rollup - Slack + Sheet



Format requirement: every report is scannable in under 60 seconds. Number first, exception list second, everything else omitted. Nobody reads a wall of data — the exception list is the product.



30-Day Ramp



Week 1 — observe and document



Shadow the current manual process. Document it as they learn it — that document becomes the role's SOP and its first deliverable.



Week 2 — morning report only



Own the morning booked-call audit. Zion verifies against source data daily. Accuracy before scope.



Week 3 — add EOD report



Both daily reports running. Auditor begins flagging Path 1 data-accuracy issues and fixing them.



Week 4 — full scope



Weekly rollup added. Path 2 rep tagging goes live. Zion spot-checks weekly instead of daily.



Ramp gate: the role is not considered ramped until Zion has spot-checked a full week of reports against source data and found zero discrepancies. Wrong data is worse than no data — it produces confidently wrong decisions.



Documentation Requirement



Every process this person runs gets documented as they run it, not after. By day 30 there should be a complete SOP covering: where each number is pulled from, how each is calculated, the report template, and the escalation path for each issue type.



Per Josh: document while doing, not before delegating. If this person leaves, the replacement should be productive in a week off the SOP alone. The right sequence: hire this person to run it manually and document the exact logic while doing it. That documentation becomes the automation spec. Once the reports are automated, the role shifts from producing the data to auditing it — which is the seat Josh actually describes, and it scales.



Hire for the manual work. Scope the job so it produces the automation.



How to Apply

To be considered for this role, you must include the word "Sesquipedalian" in your
 subject line or within the very first sentence of your message. Applications lacking "Sesquipedalian" will automatically be skipped out.



We are reviewing applications on a rolling, fast-track basis to fill this seat immediately with the right candidate. Qualified applicants will receive prompt outreach for an initial interview.

• Excellent organizational, communication, and time management skills.

title: Direct Response Copywriter — Long-Form Meta Ads for Health/Supplement Brand ($2,000/mo)
description:
We are a $600K/month oral health supplement brand selling to women 50+ in the United States through Meta 
/Instagram) ad funnels. We are hiring a full-time Direct Response Copywriter and Creative Strategist to produce our primary ad format — what we call native ads.



WHAT A NATIVE AD IS:



A native ad is a single-image
 ad with long-form direct response copy in the primary text. The copy is typically 1,500 to 4,000 words. It reads like a real person writing a story or personal experience — not a sales pitch, not a brand ad, not a product description. The image looks organic and editorial — like content, not advertising. Think x-ray images, doctor/lab visuals, handwritten sticky notes, screenshots, or low-fi photos. The ad clicks through to a long-form advertorial landing page.



If you have never written a
 ad longer than 
 words, this role is not for you.

If you do not know what an advertorial funnel is, this role is not for you.

If you think "native ad" means a short caption with a pretty product photo, this role is not for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY:



Scan Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, and other spy tools across health and supplement niches — not just oral health. You will study what is spending money in vision, joint pain, tinnitus, hair loss, weight loss, skincare, gut health, and any other health vertical where long-form native ads are running.

Identify winning native ads and understand WHY they work — the story structure, the hook, the mechanism, how the product is introduced, the emotional arc, the proof elements.

Rebuild those winning structures for our brand, our product, our mechanism, and our audience. Same story skeleton. Different angle, different product, different landing page.

Produce the full ad — both the long-form copy AND the image. You will use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to assist with copy production and Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools for image creation.

Ship 4 to 6 unique ad concepts per day once you are fully ramped (after your first 1-2 weeks of onboarding and training).

Come up with new angles and concepts on your own — from customer reviews, Reddit threads, competitor research, and our internal research documents. You are not just cloning. You are also generating original concepts.

Identify what is working from our existing ads and iterate on it — new hooks, new story frames, new angles on the same mechanisms.



WHAT YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE:



Direct response copywriting experience. You understand hooks, mechanisms, belief installation, objection handling, proof stacking, and emotional arcs. You have written long-form copy that was used in paid advertising — not blog posts, not SEO articles, not social media captions.

Experience in the health, supplement, or wellness niche specifically. You have written ads or copy for products sold to people dealing with real health concerns — pain, aging, weight, skin, teeth, vision, hearing, joints, gut, hair, or similar. You understand how this buyer thinks, what she is afraid of, what she has already tried, and why she is skeptical.

Fluent, perfect English. Non-negotiable. Your copy must read as if it was written by or for an American woman between 50 and 75 years old. Not polished corporate English. Natural, conversational, emotional American English. If your writing sounds like a textbook or a press release, you will not pass the screening.

Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your production workflow. You use AI to move faster — not to think for you. You can read AI output and immediately identify when the hook is weak, the voice is off, the mechanism is unclear, or the story lost the reader. You edit and improve AI output with your own judgment. You do not copy-paste blindly.

Experience using ad spy tools. You already spend time in Meta Ad Library, GetHooked, BrandSearch, AdSpy, or similar platforms studying what is running in health markets. This is something you already do — not something you are willing to learn.

Ability to create ad images. You can use Canva, Higgsfield, or similar tools to produce the single image that accompanies the ad copy. The image must look organic and editorial — not like a branded product ad.



STRONG PREFERENCES (not required but will put you ahead):



You can name 3 to 5 health or supplement brands running long-form native ads on
 right now and explain specifically what they are doing well.

You have worked with a DTC (direct-to-consumer) brand or performance marketing agency, not just freelance gig platforms.

You understand advertorial funnels — you know the difference between an ad that sends traffic to a product page versus an ad that sends traffic to an editorial-style landing page, and you know why the second one converts better on cold traffic.

You have produced native ads yourself — not just written copy, but chosen the image, matched the copy to the image, and shipped the complete ad.



THIS ROLE IS NOT:



Social media management

Brand advertising or brand awareness campaigns

Graphic design

Short-form copywriting (under 500 words)

Blog writing or SEO content

 marketing

Video editing or video ad production

A junior or entry-level position where you will learn on the job



If your portfolio is short captions, product descriptions, social posts, or brand ads, please do not apply.



TOOLS WE USE:



Claude and/or ChatGPT for AI-assisted copy production

Higgsfield for AI image and video generation

Canva for image creation and editing

Meta Ad Library for competitor research

GetHooked and BrandSearch for ad spy and research

Google Docs for production organization



You do not need to know all of these before starting. But you must already be using AI tools and ad spy tools in your current workflow.



COMPENSATION AND DETAILS:



$2,000 USD per month

Full-time, 40 hours per week

Fully remote — work from anywhere

Flexible schedule — we do not require specific hours, but we do require daily output and a daily end-of-day check-in via WhatsApp and a short Loom video recap of what you produced

2-week paid trial period — Week 1 is onboarding and training with the founder. Week 2 is independent production. If the quality and volume meet our standard, the role becomes permanent.

title: Social Media Manager: Content Strategy & Calendar (Botanical Gray Market Industry)
description:
We have three business brands plus our CEO personal brand posting. We need someone who owns why, when, and what next.



Rebel X Brands is a botanical house. We build and hold consumer brands across kratom, kava, and alcohol-alternative wellness, including GRHKratom, King K, and GÜD Tonics. Each brand has its own voice and its own audience. We need a social media manager who owns the full picture: strategy, calendar, and craft.



We need a Social Media Manager who can build the content calendar and strategy for all three brands and work directly with our Marketing Manager, our Graphic Designer, and our Video Editor to get the content made. Paid social experience is a nice-to-have here, not a requirement.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Content calendars and strategy for GRHKratom, King K, and GÜD Tonics, each with its own voice, content pillars, and posting cadence

- Creative briefs for our Graphic Designer and Video Editor, covering static posts and quick-turn video

- Platform strategy that accounts for the fact that Meta and TikTok both restrict kratom and kava content; you'll need to know or learn the workarounds (code words, visual language, avoiding flagged terms) that keep our accounts live

- Weekly and monthly reporting tied to engagement and growth, not just vanity metrics



**Nice to have: planning and running paid social campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other channels



OUR CEO'S PERSONAL BRAND

You'll also build the content plan and strategy for our CEO's personal brand and account, working with the same Graphic Designer and Video Editor on his static posts and short-form video

This calendar runs alongside the brand calendars, coordinated with our Marketing Manager and, where relevant, a separate Personal Branding/PR Strategist who handles our CEO's outreach and press



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

- You'll report to our Marketing Manager for cross-brand priorities and approvals

- Our Graphic Designer, for static creative

- Our Video Editor, for short-form and quick-turn video

- A separate Personal Branding/PR Strategist for our CEO: you own his content calendar, they own his outreach and opportunities



REQUIREMENTS

- A track record building and executing content calendars and strategy for more than one brand at a time

- Experience or comfort working in a restricted advertising category (supplements, CBD, kratom, kava, alcohol alternatives, or similar); you understand platforms restrict certain words and topics, and you know how to plan around it

- Direct experience briefing and collaborating with designers and video editors, not just posting what's handed to you

- Understanding that in our category we make zero medical claims, ever



**Nice to have: hands-on graphic design or video editing skills (Canva, Adobe Suite, CapCut, or similar) — you don't need to be the primary creative, but being able to jump in and create or edit content yourself is a plus



**Nice to have: experience running paid social ads (Meta and TikTok) with real budget and real results



TO APPLY

Skip the generic proposal. Include:

- A content calendar or strategy you built across more than one brand, and how you sequenced it

- If you have one, a paid social campaign you ran with real numbers (spend, CAC, ROAS, whatever you tracked)

- Anything you see yourself working on when you look at our social media pages?

- Answer this: "Instagram just flagged one of your posts and quietly reduced its reach because it contains a restricted keyword. What do you check first, and what do you change going forward?"

title: short-form video editor- true crime TikTok
description:
I'm looking for a reliable and creative short-form video editor/content assistant for a True Crime TikTok page.

This is intended to be LONG-TERM, consistent work. My goal is to post approximately 1 video every day.

I will provide the story/script and instructions. Your job is to turn it into a FINISHED video that is ready for me to post.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

• Edit approximately 60–90 second vertical videos

• Find relevant photos, footage and B-roll for each story

• Add/create voiceovers when requested

• Add accurate captions/subtitles

• Add background music and appropriate sound effects

• Use zooms, transitions and effects when they improve the video

• Create an attention-grabbing first 2–3 seconds

• Keep viewers engaged with good pacing and storytelling

• Export finished videos in 9:16 format

The content will focus on true crime, criminal investigations, disappearances, mysteries and unusual real cases.

Accuracy is important. Do not invent facts or present AI-generated material as real evidence.

I want someone who understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts and knows how to edit for VIEWER RETENTION — not simply make a video look nice.

WORKLOAD:

Approximately 1 video per day / 7 videos per week.

There may be additional work as the page grows.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Strong short-form video editing skills

• Good English comprehension

• Ability to find appropriate B-roll/photos independently

• Understand hooks, pacing and storytelling

• Reliable and able to meet deadlines

• Comfortable working with true-crime content

• Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar software

• Ability to create AI voiceovers is a plus

PAY:

Please tell me YOUR PRICE PER COMPLETED 60–90 SECOND VIDEO.

I'm looking for a good combination of affordable pricing, quality and reliability. Consistent long-term work will be available for the right person.

PAID TEST:

I will select a few applicants to create the SAME paid test video. The best editor will be offered ongoing work.

HOW TO APPLY:

Start your application with the word "CRIME" so I know you read the entire posting.

Then answer:

What is your price per completed 30-60 second video?

How many videos can you complete per week?

What is your normal turnaround time?

What editing software do you use?

Can you find B-roll, photos and other visuals yourself?

Can you create AI voiceovers?

Send links to your 3 BEST short-form videos.

Have you edited true-crime/storytelling content before?

PLEASE DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT EXAMPLES OF YOUR PREVIOUS WORK.

I'm looking for someone dependable who wants consistent, long-term work.

title: Experienced Remote Appointment Setter
description:
Company: TMS Media Inc.

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Hours: Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Pacific Time (USA)

Employment Type: Full-time



About Us

TMS Media Inc. is a fast-growing media and education company. We help businesses build personal brands and get seen on social media. We offer an array of info products that come in the form of video courses and live coaching.

Our students have already taken the first step by joining one of our entry-level programs. Your job is to reach out to those students and help them take the next step into our premium coaching program.

This is warm outreach, not cold calling. Every person you speak to is an existing customer.

We're looking for reliable, friendly, and driven people who want a long-term opportunity with room to grow.



Compensation

$10.00 USD per hour base pay

+ $2.00 USD bonus for every qualified call you book

Opportunities for raises based on performance

The more appointments you set, the more you earn. Strong setters do very well here.



Responsibilities

Make outbound phone calls to existing customers using our system (GoHighLevel)

Follow a provided script

Book qualified appointments for our closers

Accurately update customer information and call notes in GoHighLevel

Maintain a professional, warm, and positive attitude on every call

Meet daily appointment-booking goals



We are looking for someone with extensive appointment-setting experience who can take the lead on building a sales team within the company. This means having the ability to manage other appointment setters, review work call recordings and logs, and optimize scripts and other material to increase effectiveness. 



Requirements:



30 calls an hour minimum (40 calls per hour is expected)



Comfortable with double dialling and lots of following up with prospects.



Experience with GoHighLevel CRM



Previous appointment-setting experience (required)

Excellent English speaking skills

Clear speaking voice with minimal background noise

Reliable high-speed internet

Computer with headset

Quiet work environment

Dependable and punctual

Ability to work independently while following directions



Preferred (Not Required)

Experience in the creator, coaching, or online-education space

Sales or customer service background

Familiarity with GoHighLevel or similar CRMs



We provide:

Call scripts

Ongoing coaching

Continuous support to help you succeed



Schedule

Monday–Friday

9:00 AM – 5:30 PM (Pacific Time)

30-minute unpaid lunch break



Success in This Position

Our goal is to book qualified students onto calls with our closer so they can learn about our premium program. We're looking for people who are positive, coachable, and genuinely enjoy talking to people.

Because you're calling existing customers, the right person will be warm, personable, and good at building rapport quickly. If you're dependable and willing to learn, we'd love to have you on our team.



How to Apply

To help us find the best candidates, please include ALL of the following:

Your resume

Your internet speed test results (from Speedtest.net)

A short video or voice recording of yourself reading the following:

We are hiring immediately and look forward to meeting you!
